sources.said: Art. 45. — Les dispositions de l’article 136 bis du code du timbre, sont modifiées, complétées et rédigées comme suit : « Art. 136 bis. — La délivrance du passeport ............ (sans changement jusqu’à) qui équivaut à la somme de six mille dinars algériens (6.000 DA). Concernant le passeport comportant 48 pages, le droit de timbre est fixé à neuf mille dinars algériens (9.000 DA). Le passeport est délivré à la demande de nos ressortissants établis à l'étranger, suivant la procédure accélérée dans un délai, maximum, de cinq (5) jours de la date du dépôt de la demande, contre le paiement d'un droit de timbre de vingt-cinq mille dinars algériens (25.000 DA) pour le livret de 28 pages et quarante-cinq mille dinars algériens (45.000 DA) pour le livret de 48 pages. En cas de perte ou de détérioration de ce document, la délivrance d'un nouveau passeport donne lieu à la perception, en plus du droit de timbre dû selon le type de document, d'une taxe de dix mille dinars algériens (10.000 DA). La délivrance du passeport à la faveur des mineurs et des étudiants ……(sans changement jusqu’à) trois mille dinars algériens (3.000 DA). Le montant du timbre est fixé à quatre mille cinq cents dinars algériens (4.500 DA) pour le passeport contenant 48 pages délivré à cette frange de citoyens. Le passeport est délivré pour les mineurs et les étudiants membres de la communauté algérienne établie à l'étranger, suivant la procédure accélérée dans un délai, maximum, de cinq (5) jours de la date du dépôt de la demande, contre le paiement d'un droit de timbre de douze mille dinars algériens (12.000 DA) pour le livret de 28 pages et vingt-deux mille cinq cents dinars algériens (22.500 DA) pour le livret de 48 pages. ... La contre-valeur en monnaie étrangère des droits de timbre visés dans le présent article, est fixée annuellement par arrêté conjoint du ministre chargé des affaires étrangères et du ministre chargé des finances, conformément au cours du dinar face aux devises étrangères.

sources.title: Zerkalo, on ID cards and biometric passports in Belarus from 1 September 2021 (31 August 2021)
sources.said: За картой нужно обращаться в подразделение по гражданству и миграции по месту регистрации. Гражданам, находящимся за пределами страны, нужно идти в ближайшее диппредставительство или консульство Беларуси. ID-карта будет готова через 15 рабочих дней после того, как человек подал заявление. Если процедура проходит в ускоренном порядке, это займет десять рабочих дней, в срочном — пять. ... детям до 14 лет платить за ID-карту не нужно. Пенсионерам, инвалидам I и II группы она обойдется в 1 базовую (сейчас это 29 рублей), для остальных — в 1,5 базовой (43,5 рубля). ... Срок действия идентификационной карты — 10 лет. sources.title: Govern d'Andorra, Ministeri de Justícia i Interior, La nacionalitat andorrana d'origen
sources.said: Es andorrà l’infant nascut al Principat d’Andorra, si almenys un dels pares és andorrà. ... És andorrà l’infant nascut a l’estranger si compleix alguna d’aquestes condicions: a) Almenys un dels pares és andorrà i nascut al Principat d’Andorra. b) Almenys un dels pares és andorrà i, al seu torn, fill d’una persona de nacionalitat andorrana nascuda al Principat d’Andorra. c) Almenys un dels pares és andorrà i, al seu torn, fill d’una persona de nacionalitat andorrana que hagi residit al Principat d’Andorra durant, com a mínim deu anys. ... Es andorrà l’infant nascut al Principat d’Andorra, si almenys un dels pares és nascut al Principat d’Andorra, a condició que el progenitor o els progenitors sota l’autoritat del qual o dels quals està legalment sotmès tinguin la seva residència principal i permanent al Principat d’Andorra a la data del naixement de l’infant i l’hagin tingut durant l’any anterior al naixement. ... És andorrà l’infant nascut al Principat d’Andorra de pare i mare estrangers si almenys un dels seus progenitors, sota l’autoritat del qual o dels quals està legalment sotmès, té la residència principal i permanent al Principat d’Andorra a la data de naixement de l’infant i l’hagi tinguda durant els darrers deu anys que han precedit aquest naixement. Si l’esmentat període de deu anys no s’ha complert el dia del naixement de l’infant, la nacionalitat andorrana se li atribueix a títol provisional.

Subject to paragraph 2 the qualifications for naturalisation of an alien who applies therefor are— (a) that he has resided in Guyana throughout the period of twelve months immediately preceding the date of the application; (b) that during the seven years immediately preceding the said period of twelve months he has resided in Guyana for periods amounting in the aggregate to not less than five years; (c) that he is of good character; and (d) that he intends in the event of a certificate being granted to him to reside in Guyana.

sources.title: Constitution of the Co-operative Republic of Guyana, Cap. 1:01 (L.R.O. 1/2012, Parliament of Guyana), arts. 43, 44, 46(1)
sources.said: 43. Every person born in Guyana after the commencement of this Constitution shall become a citizen of Guyana at the date of his or her birth: Provided that a person shall not become a citizen of Guyana by virtue of this article if at the time of his or her birth – (a) his or her father or his or her mother possesses such immunity from suit and legal process as is accorded to an envoy of a foreign sovereign power accredited to Guyana and neither of them is a citizen of Guyana; or (b) his or her father or his or her mother is an enemy alien and the birth occurs in a place then under occupation by the enemy. 44. A person born outside Guyana after the commencement of this Constitution shall become a citizen of Guyana at the date of his or her birth if at that date his or her father or his or her mother is a citizen of Guyana otherwise than by virtue of this article. ... 46. (1) If the President of Guyana is satisfied that any citizen of Guyana has any time after 25th May 1966, acquired by registration, naturalisation or any other or other voluntary and formal act (other than marriage) the citizenship of any country other than Guyana, the President may by order deprive that person of his or her citizenship.

sources.said: Со потекло стекнува државјанство на Република Северна Македонија дете на кое: 1) во моментот на раѓањето двата родители се државјани на Република Северна Македонија; 2) во моментот на раѓањето едниот родител е државјанин на Република Северна Македонија, а детето е родено во Република Северна Македонија, доколку родителите спогодбено не определат детето да го добие државјанството на другиот родител и 3) ... едниот родител е државјанин ..., а другиот родител е непознат или со непознато државјанство, односно без државјанство, а детето е родено во странство. ... sources.said: La République reconnaît, au sein du peuple français, les populations d'outre-mer, dans un idéal commun de liberté, d'égalité et de fraternité. entries.sought: Mauritania's citizenship: the years of residence its ordinary naturalisation asks, whether other citizenships must be given up, and whether its citizens lose it on taking another

sources.title: Codes usuels de Mauritanie 2026, Tome 01 : Droit civil, 4.2.1 Code de la nationalité mauritanienne (Loi n°1961-112 consolidated to Loi n°2021-016), Ministère chargé du Secrétariat Général du Gouvernement, pp. 171-173
sources.said: Art.8.- Est mauritanien : • 1° l'enfant né d'un père mauritanien ; • 2° l'enfant né d'une mère mauritanienne et d'un père sans nationalité, ou de nationalité inconnue ; • 3° l'enfant né en Mauritanie d'une mère mauritanienne et d'un père de nationalité étrangère, sauf la faculté de répudier cette qualité dans l'année qui précède sa majorité. ... Art.10.- Est mauritanien l'enfant nouveau-né trouvé en Mauritanie et dont les parents sont inconnus. ... Art.13.- (Loi n°2010-23) Peut opter pour la Nationalité Mauritanienne dans l'année précédant sa majorité, l'enfant né à l'étranger, d'une mère mauritanienne et d'un père de nationalité étrangère. ... Art.18.- (Loi n°1971-057, Loi n°1973-186, Loi n°2010-23) Nul ne peut être naturalisé s'il n'a, depuis dix ans au moins, sa résidence habituelle en Mauritanie au moment de la présentation de la demande. Toutefois, ce délai peut être réduit à cinq ans pour ceux qui sont nés en Mauritanie ou mariés conformément à la Chariaa à un mauritanien ou à une mauritanienne ou qui ont rendu à la Mauritanie des services exceptionnels. Art.19.- (Loi n°2010-23) Nul ne peut être naturalisé : • 1° s'il n'est reconnu sain de corps et d'esprit ; • 2° s'il ne parle couramment l'une des langues nationales ... • 3° s'il n'est de bonne vie et mœurs

sources.title: Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie n° 1492, 30 août 2021, Loi n° 2021-016 du 6 août 2021 (p. 628)
sources.said: Article 30 (nouveau) : Perd la nationalité mauritanienne suite à l'acquisition d'une nationalité étrangère, le Mauritanien majeur qui est : Autorisé par décret à renoncer à sa nationalité mauritanienne; Qui nuit aux intérêts ou à la renommée de la Mauritanie, et qui, de ce fait, a été condamné par une décision judiciaire définitive des tribunaux mauritaniens. Article 31 (nouveau) : Le Mauritanien, ayant acquis une autre nationalité, garde sa nationalité mauritanienne.

sources.said: 10. (1) An alien or a stateless person, being a person of full age and capacity, on making application therefor to the Minister in the prescribed manner, may be granted a certificate of naturalisation as a citizen of Malta if he satisfies the Minister - (a) that he has resided in Malta throughout the period of twelve months immediately preceding the date of application; and (b) that, during the six years immediately preceding the said period of twelve months, he has resided in Malta for periods amounting in the aggregate to not less than four years; and (c) that he has an adequate knowledge of the Maltese or the English language; and (d) that he is of good character; and (e) that he would be a suitable citizen of Malta

sources.title: Maltese Citizenship Act, Cap. 188, art. 5(1)-(3)
sources.said: Provided further that in the case of a person born on or after the 1st August, 1989 such person shall not become a citizen of Malta by virtue of this subarticle unless at the time of his birth, his father or his mother was or is: (a) a citizen of Malta; or (b) a person referred to in article 44(4)(a) or (b) of the Constitution; ... Provided further that if the person mentioned in the second proviso, has not become a citizen of Malta but proves that he is a descendant in the direct line of an ascendant born in Malta of a parent likewise born in Malta, that person shall be entitled, upon making an application as may be prescribed and upon taking the oath of allegiance, to be registered as a citizen of Malta. ... (2) A person born outside Malta on or after the appointed day shall be deemed to have become or shall become a citizen of Malta at the date of his birth: ... (b) in the case of a person born on or after the 1st August, 1989, if at the date of such person’s birth, his father or mother is a citizen of Malta otherwise than by virtue of this subarticle, subarticle (3) of this article or subarticle (2) or (3) of article 3.

sources.said: 2. ދިވެހިރައްޔިތަކަށް ވާންއެދޭ ބޭރުމީހާ ތިރީގައި މިވާ ޝަރްޠުތައް ފުރިހަމަވެފައިވާ ނަމަ ... މުސްލިމަކު ކަމުގައިވުން. އުމުރުން 21 އަހަރުވެ، ބުއްދި ސަލާމަތުން ހުރި މީހަކު ކަމުގައިވުން. މެދުކެނޑުމެއްނެތި ރާއްޖޭގައި 12 އަހަރު ވަންދެން އުޅެމުން އައިސްފައިވާ މީހަކު ކަމުގައިވުން. މި މުއްދަތުގެ ތެރޭގައި ރާއްޖޭން ބޭރަށް ފުރައިގެން ދިޔަ ނަމަވެސް، މިއިން އެއްވެސް ފަހަރަކު 6 މަސް ދުވަހަށް ވުރެ ދިގު މުއްދަތެއް ރާއްޖޭން ބޭރުގައި ނުވުމާއެކު، ރާއްޖޭގައި ހުރި ދުވަސްތަކުގެ ޖުމްލަ 10 އަހަރަށްވުރެ ގިނަނަމަ، މި ޝަރްޠު ފުރިހަމަވީ ކަމަށް ބެލޭނެއެވެ. ... އެމީހެއްގެ އަސްލު ސިޓިޒެންޝިޕް ދޫކޮށްލާނެ ކަމަށް އިޤްރާރުވުމާއެކު، އެ ސިޓިޒެންޝިޕުން ތަނާޒުލްވުމާމެދު އިޢްތިރާޟެއް ނެތްކަމުގެ ރަސްމީ ލިޔުމެއް، އެމީހެއްގެ ޤައުމުގެ ސަރުކާރުން ހޯދައި ހުށަހެޅުން.

sources.title: Dual Citizenship, Department of Immigration, Republic of Malawi
sources.said: On 12th December, 2018, the Malawi National Assembly passed the Malawi Citizenship Amendment Bill to amend the 1966 Citizenship Act, allowing persons of full age and capacity to hold citizenship of another country in addition to their Malawi citizenship. The dual citizenship bill was assented into law in March 2019 and operationalization of dual citizenship regulations were gazetted in November 2021 ... Only Malawians by birth or descent are eligible to acquire dual citizenship. Persons who were naturalized, registered or conferred the citizenship of Malawi are NOT eligible for the Malawi dual citizenship. ... A person of full age who to his/her knowledge has obtained the citizenship of another country, is required to submit an application of notice and registration for the acquisition of a Malawi dual citizenship.

sources.title: Renunciation and Restoration of Citizenship, Department of Immigration, Republic of Malawi
sources.said: Renunciation Of Other Citizenship A person should make a declaration in a set of forms to the Lawyer of his intention to renounce that other citizenship.

sources.said: يلغى قانون الجنسية العمانية المشار إليه ... ويعمل به من اليوم التالي لتاريخ نشره. ... المادة (٥) لا يجوز الجمع بين الجنسية العمانية وأي جنسية أخرى إلا بمرسوم سلطاني، بناء على توصية الوزير. ... المادة (١٢) يكون عمانيا بصفة أصلية وفقا لأحكام هذا القانون: ١ – من يولد في سلطنة عمان أو خارجها لأب عماني بصفة أصلية. ... المادة (١٥) ... ٢ – من يولد في سلطنة عمان أو خارجها من أم عمانية، ولم يثبت نسبه شرعا لأب. ... المادة (١٧) يجوز للأجنبي التقدم بطلب الحصول على الجنسية العمانية إذا توفرت فيه الشروط الآتية: ١ – أن يسبق طلبه إقامته في سلطنة عمان إقامة مشروعة متواصلة مدة لا تقل عن (١٥) خمسة عشر عاما، ولا يحول دون اعتبار إقامته متواصلة غيابه خلال العام الواحد مدة لا تزيد على (٩٠) تسعين يوما. ... أن يقر كتابة برغبته في التنازل عن جنسية الدولة التي يحمل جنسيتها، وبأنه لا يحمل جنسية دولة أخرى عدا الدولة التي سيتنازل عن جنسيتها. ... المادة (٢٣) يفقد العماني جنسيته العمانية بحكم القانون، إذا اكتسب جنسية دولة أخرى بالمخالفة لأحكام هذا القانون.

entries.sought: Panama's citizenship: the years of residence its ordinary naturalisation asks, whether other citizenships must be given up, and whether its citizens lose it on taking another

sources.title: Constitución Política de la República de Panamá (texto único, Gaceta Oficial 25176 de 15 de noviembre de 2004), edition of the Ministerio Público – Procuraduría General de la Nación (2016), arts. 9, 10, 13
sources.said: ARTICULO 9. Son panameños por nacimiento: 1. Los nacidos en el territorio nacional. 2. Los hijos de padre o madre panameños por nacimiento nacidos fuera del territorio de la República, si aquellos establecen su domicilio en el territorio nacional. 3. Los hijos de padre o madre panameños por naturalización nacidos fuera del territorio nacional, si aquellos establecen su domicilio en la República de Panamá y manifiestan su voluntad de acogerse a la nacionalidad panameña a más tardar un año después de su mayoría de edad. ARTICULO 10. Pueden solicitar la nacionalidad panameña por naturalización: 1. Los extranjeros con cinco años consecutivos de residencia en el territorio de la República si, después de haber alcanzado su mayoría de edad, declaran su voluntad de naturalizarse, renuncian expresamente a su nacionalidad de origen o a la que tengan y comprueban que poseen el idioma español ... ARTICULO 13. La nacionalidad panameña de origen o adquirida por el nacimiento no se pierde, pero la renuncia expresa o tácita de ella suspenderá la ciudadanía. La nacionalidad panameña derivada o adquirida por la naturalización se perderá por las mismas causas. La renuncia expresa de la nacionalidad se produce cuando la persona manifiesta por escrito al Ejecutivo su voluntad de abandonarla; y la tácita, cuando se adquiere otra nacionalidad o cuando se entra al servicio de un Estado enemigo.

sources.said: Artículo 146. De la nacionalidad natural Son de nacionalidad paraguaya natural: 1) las personas nacidas en el territorio de la República; 2) los hijos de madre o padre paraguayo quienes, hallándose uno o ambos al servicio de la República, nazcan en el extranjero; 3) los hijos de madre o padre paraguayo nacidos en el extranjero, cuando aquéllos se radiquen en la República en forma permanente, y 4) los infantes de padres ignorados, recogidos en el territorio de la República. ... Artículo 149. De la nacionalidad múltiple La nacionalidad múltiple podrá ser admitida mediante tratado internacional o por reciprocidad de rango constitucional entre los Estados del natural de origen y del de adopción. Artículo 150. De la pérdida de la nacionalidad Los paraguayos naturalizados pierden la nacionalidad en virtud de ausencia injustificada de la República por más de tres años, declarada judicialmente, o por la adquisición voluntaria de otra nacionalidad.

sources.said: มาตรา ๗ บุคคลดังต่อไปนี้ย่อมได้สัญชาติไทยโดยการเกิด (๑) ผู้เกิดโดยบิดาหรือมารดาเป็นผู้มีสัญชาติไทย ไม่ว่าจะเกิดในหรือนอกราชอาณาจักรไทย (๒) ผู้เกิดในราชอาณาจักรไทย ยกเว้นบุคคลตามมาตรา ๗ ทวิ วรรคหนึ่ง ... มาตรา ๗ ทวิ ผู้เกิดในราชอาณาจักรไทย โดยบิดาและมารดาเป็นคนต่างด้าว ย่อมไม่ได้รับสัญชาติไทย ถ้าในขณะที่เกิดบิดาตามกฎหมายหรือบิดาซึ่งมิได้มีการสมรสกับมารดาหรือมารดาของผู้นั้นเป็น (๑) ผู้ที่ได้รับการผ่อนผันให้พักอาศัยอยู่ในราชอาณาจักรไทยเป็นกรณีพิเศษเฉพาะราย (๒) ผู้ที่ได้รับอนุญาตให้เข้าอยู่ในราชอาณาจักรไทยเพียงชั่วคราว หรือ (๓) ผู้ที่ ... มาตรา ๑๐ คนต่างด้าวซึ่งมีคุณสมบัติครบถ้วนดังต่อไปนี้ อาจขอแปลงสัญชาติเป็นไทยได้ (๑) บรรลุนิติภาวะแล้วตามกฎหมายไทยและกฎหมายที่บุคคลนั้นมีสัญชาติ (๒) มีความประพฤติดี (๓) มีอาชีพเป็นหลักฐาน (๔) มีภูมิลำเนาในราชอาณาจักรไทยต่อเนื่องมาจนถึงวันที่ยื่นคำขอแปลงสัญชาติเป็นไทยเป็นเวลาไม่น้อยกว่าห้าปี (๕) มีความรู้ภาษาไทยตามที่กำหนดในกฎกระทรวง ... มาตรา ๒๒ ผู้ซึ่งมีสัญชาติไทยและได้แปลงสัญชาติเป็นคนต่างด้าว หรือสละสัญชาติไทย หรือถูกถอนสัญชาติไทย ย่อมเสียสัญชาติไทย

sources.said: 46 Citizenship by Birth (1) Subject to subsections (3) and (4), a person born in Tuvalu on or after the date on which this Constitution took effect is a citizen of Tuvalu by birth. (2) A person born outside Tuvalu on or after the date on which this Constitution took effect is a citizen of Tuvalu by birth if on the date of his birth either of his parents is, or would but for his death have been, a citizen of Tuvalu. (3) ... a person does not become a citizen of Tuvalu by virtue of subsection (1) if at the time of his birth – (a) neither of his parents was a citizen of Tuvalu; and (b) his father had the privileges and immunities of an envoy to Tuvalu ...

sources.said: Under the Citizenship Act 2004, you can become a Samoan citizen in four ways: by birth, by descent, by permanent residence, or by marriage. By birth Anyone born in Samoa is a citizen if at least one parent was a Samoan citizen at the time of their birth. By descent Anyone born outside Samoa is a citizen by descent if, at the time of their birth, at least one parent was a Samoan citizen other than by descent. sources.title: Les services de l'État en Guyane (prefecture), Entrée en Guyane : fin de l’obligation de visa de court séjour pour les Brésiliens
sources.said: les ressortissants brésiliens pourront désormais, à compter du 31 juillet 2026, se rendre en Guyane sans visa pour des séjours n’excédant pas 30 jours sur une période de 180 jours. Cette mesure ... est mise en œuvre pour une période renouvelable de six mois, jusqu’au 31 janvier 2027. ... cette exemption de visa ne s'applique pas aux personnes se rendant en Guyane dans le cadre d'une activité commerciale.

sources.title: La France au Brésil (Embassy), Information importante : La France suspend l'obligation de visa de court séjour pour les ressortissants brésiliens se rendant en Guyane
sources.said: Arrêté du 31 juillet 2026 relatif aux documents et visas exigés pour l'entrée des ressortissants brésiliens sur le territoire de la Guyane ... Cette mesure entrera en vigueur le 31 juillet 2026 . Elle s'applique exclusivement aux séjours n'excédant pas 30 jours sur une période de six mois .

sources.title: Arrêté du 26 juillet 2011 relatif aux documents et visas exigés pour l'entrée des étrangers sur le territoire de la Guadeloupe, la Guyane, la Martinique, La Réunion et de la collectivité de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon (JORF n°0173 du 28 juillet 2011; last modified 2025-06-19) — read from DILA's LEGI open-data dump (https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/LEGI/Freemium_legi_global_20250713-140000.tar.gz), article LEGIARTI000051759462 (Annexe II, en vigueur depuis 2025-06-19)
sources.said: 1. Liste des pays ou des entités administratives dont les titulaires de passeport sont dispensés de visa pour entrer sur le territoire de la Guadeloupe, la Guyane, la Martinique, La Réunion et de la collectivité de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon afin d'y effectuer des séjours dont la durée n'excède pas 90 jours sur toute période de 180 jours ... Dominique | Pour la Guadeloupe, la Martinique et de la Guyane : dispense de visa pour des séjours d'une durée inférieure ou égale à quinze jours, dans la limite de cent vingt jours cumulés sur une période de douze mois. ... Equateur | Pour entrer sur les territoires des départements de la Guadeloupe, la Martinique et la Guyane : dispense s'étendant à tout type de passeport. ... Sainte-Lucie | Pour la Guadeloupe, la Martinique et la Guyane : dispense de visa pour des séjours d'une durée inférieure ou égale à quinze jours, dans la limite de cent vingt jours cumulés sur une période de douze mois.

sources.title: Migration.gv.at (Österreichische Bundesregierung), Sonstige Niederlassungsformen: „Niederlassungsbewilligung – Künstler“
sources.said: Die „Niederlassungsbewilligung – Künstler“ berechtigt zur Ausübung einer selbständigen oder unselbständigen Tätigkeit, die überwiegend aus künstlerischer Gestaltung besteht. Bei unselbständiger künstlerischer Betätigung müssen ausländische Künstler neben dem Nachweis der Erfüllung der allgemeinen Erteilungsvoraussetzungen den Antrag auf Erteilung einer "Niederlassungsbewilligung – Künstler" gemeinsam mit einer schriftlichen Erklärung des Arbeitgebers, die im Antrag angegebenen Beschäftigungsbedingungen einzuhalten, einbringen.

sources.title: WKO (Wirtschaftskammer Österreich), Beschäftigung ausländischer Künstler:innen
sources.said: Solche ausländischen Künstler:innen dürfen entweder einen Tag oder acht Wochen im Rahmen einer künstlerischen Gesamtproduktion ohne Beschäftigungsbewilligung beschäftigt werden. Zweck dieser Beschäftigung muss die Sicherung eines Konzerts, einer Veranstaltung, einer Vorstellung, einer laufenden Filmproduktion oder einer Rundfunk- oder Fernsehlivesendung sein. … Ist eine Beschäftigungsbewilligung für die Beschäftigung ausländischer Künstler:innen erforderlich, darf diese nur abgelehnt werden, wenn die Beeinträchtigung der öffentlichen Interessen unverhältnismäßig schwerer wiegt als die Beeinträchtigung der Freiheit der Kunst … Ausländische Künstler:innen, die länger als ein halbes Jahr in Österreich zu arbeiten beabsichtigen, müssen eine Aufenthaltsbewilligung an der für ihren Wohnsitz zuständigen Aufenthaltsbehörde beantragen.

sources.title: JUSLINE, § 3 AuslBG (consolidated text)
sources.said: Ausländer, die Konzert- oder Bühnenkünstler oder Angehörige der Berufsgruppen Artisten, Film-, Rundfunk- und Fernsehschaffende oder Musiker sind, dürfen a) Litera a einen Tag oder b) Litera b acht Wochen im Rahmen einer künstlerischen Gesamtproduktion zur Sicherung eines Konzerts, einer Veranstaltung, einer Vorstellung, einer laufenden Filmproduktion, einer Rundfunk- oder Fernsehlivesendung ohne Beschäftigungsbewilligung beschäftigt werden.

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), Exemption from the requirement of a work permit
sources.said: As a rule, a foreign national, who will be working in Denmark, must have a work permit. However, artists, musicians, performers, etc. and associated staff can be exempted from the requirement of a work permit, if they are of importance for a significant artistic event. The artist, musician, performer etc. must, as a rule, be the focal point or main attraction of the event, or at least be of major significance for the artistic event. ... The event must have a short-term character, normally with a duration of less than 14 days.

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), Special individual qualifications – artist and performers (last updated 2 September 2026)
sources.said: If you have been offered work as a creative or performing artist, you can apply for a residence and work permit in Denmark. Normal processing time 2 months If further information is needed, the processing time can be up to 3 months Processing fee DKK 6,810,- … It is a condition that you have special individual qualifications that mean that others cannot immediately take on the artistic work offered. … It is a condition that your job offer is with a company that performs artistic work. This could be in an orchestra, an opera house, a theatre, a circus or a ballet company. … Your salary and terms of employment must correspond to Danish standards. … If SIRI has any doubts on whether your terms of employment correspond to Danish standards, we can ask one of the Regional Employment Councils to assess your terms of employment. … You can be granted a residence and work permit that is valid for 1 year at a time during the first 2 years of your stay – however, the validity cannot exceed the length of your job contract. Hereafter, you can be granted a permit valid for a maximum of 2 years, and after 4 years, valid for a maximum of 3 years at a time. … If your employment contract is extended, you must apply for an extension of your residence and work permit. … Your employer must start by completing the first part of the application. … If you have granted your employer power of attorney to handle the application on your behalf, your employer must use the AR6 application. … You must have your biometric features recorded no later than 14 days after you have submitted your application.

entries.foundInPart: Niue's Immigration Act 2011 (published by the Immigration Department) requires everyone not exempt to hold a permit to remain, and names the work permit, for anyone intending to undertake employment or provide any services in Niue, applied for on arrival with any applicable fee, references, a police report, health clearances and, where the guidelines require, a sponsor; New Zealand citizens born in Niue need none and may undertake any activity (s 4). But the Act leaves exemptions for other persons or classes to regulations (s 7(2)), and its purpose confirms the right of other New Zealand citizens to remain; the Immigration Regulations 2011, which would say whether a New Zealand passport needs the permit, aren't reachable, so the rule by passport isn't settled and Niue's work rule stays unkept.

sources.title: Niue, Immigration Act 2011 (2011/309, 7 April 2011), as consolidated in the Niue Legislation Act 2019, published by the Niue Immigration Department (Ministry of Finance)
sources.said: s7(1) every person must hold a valid permit to remain in Niue. s14(7) 'There are the following types of temporary permits: (a) work permits for persons intending to undertake employment or provide any services in Niue; (b) student permits ...'; s14(2) grant is at the Chief Immigration Officer's discretion; s14(4) the permit states its expiry and conditions; s14(9) valid until the earlier of departure or the stated expiry. s15(1) apply on arrival to the Immigration Officer 'together with any applicable fee'; s16 further temporary permits applied for in Niue 'with any applicable fee'; s16A two character references, a police report and health clearances; s17 a sponsor acceptable to the Chief Immigration Officer if the temporary entry guidelines require. s2(a) and (b) the Act achieves its purpose through 'confirming the inalienable right of New Zealand citizens born in Niue to travel to and remain in Niue; confirming the right of all other New Zealand citizens, except those who are prohibited persons, to travel to and remain in Niue'. s4(3) 'No New Zealand citizen born in Niue shall require a visa to travel to, or require a permit in order to remain, or undertake any activity, in Niue.' s7(2) 'Cabinet may make regulations under this Act to exempt any person or class of persons from the requirement to hold a permit, or types of permit, in order to remain in Niue'.

sources.title: Journal officiel de la République algérienne no. 28, 14 July 1981 (French translation), Loi no. 81-10 du 11 juillet 1981 relative aux conditions d'emploi des travailleurs étrangers, pp. 683-684 (transcribed from page images; no text layer)
sources.said: Une autorisation de travail temporaire est délivrée aux travailleurs étrangers appelés à exercer une activité salariée d'une durée inférieure ou égale à trois mois, sur demande motivée de l'organisme employeur après consultation des représentants des travailleurs. … Elle ne peut être renouvelée plus d'une fois dans l'année. … le poste de travail à occuper ne peut, en aucun cas, être pourvu par un travailleur national, que ce soit par voie de promotion interne ou par voie de recrutement externe, y compris la main-d'œuvre nationale émigrée, … Le dossier du permis de travail ne saurait être reçu par les services compétents du ministère du travail s'il n'est pas accompagné du rapport motivé de l'organisme employeur et assorti de l'avis des représentants des travailleurs. … Sont exclus de l'obligation de l'autorisation de travail temporaire prévue à l'article 8 ci-dessus, les travailleurs étrangers appelés, à titre exceptionnel, pour effectuer des travaux n'excédant pas quinze (15) jours et sans que le total cumulé des durées de présence n'excède trois (3) mois dans l'année. … La durée du permis de travail ne peut être supérieure à deux (2) ans. … La délivrance du permis de travail ou de l'autorisation de travail temporaire donne lieu à l'apposition d'un timbre fiscal à la charge du bénéficiaire. … Le travailleur étranger régi par la présente loi perçoit un salaire afférent à l'indice de poste auquel peut prétendre son homologue algérien de même niveau

sources.title: Journal officiel n° 56 (28 décembre 1982), Décret n° 82-510 du 25 décembre 1982 fixant les modalités d'attribution du permis de travail et de l'autorisation de travail temporaire aux travailleurs étrangers, pp. 1917-1919
sources.said: La notification de la suite réservée par les services de l'emploi compétents, à la demande prévue à l'article 8 ci-dessus, est faite à l'organisme employeur dans les quarante cinq (45) jours qui suivent le dépôt de cette demande. Passé ce délai, l'avis favorable des services de l'emploi est réputé acquis. … Le permis de travail est délivré conformément aux dispositions de l'article 6 ci-dessus, dans les quinze jours qui suivent l'avis favorable.

entries.foundInPart: Only the show's side: the Ministry of Communication, Culture, Arts and Tourism's communiqué of 11 November 2025, as Burkina 24 reports it, holds that running live shows needs the Ministry's licence of a live-show entrepreneur or an authorisation for occasional practice (decree no. 2014-643/PRES/PM/MCT of 29 July 2014; order no. 2014-0121/MCT/SG/DAS of 24 September 2014), and that every professional live show be declared to the regional culture directorate at least 15 days before it. That binds the promoter, not the performer, and the decree and order weren't reached; the foreign performer's own visa and work permit stay unfound, so Burkina Faso's work rule stays unkept.

sources.title: Burkina 24, 'Spectacles vivants au Burkina Faso : Le MCCAT rappelle les promoteurs à l'ordre' (11 November 2025), reporting the communiqué of the Ministry of Communication, Culture, Arts and Tourism (whose site, culture.gov.bf, doesn't answer this client)

sources.title: BEAC, Architecture de la tarification des services bancaires dans la CEMAC (mai-juin 2011)
sources.said: Le système bancaire centrafricaine compte 4 banques en activité au 31 décembre 2010. Il s'agit de Banque Populaire Marocco-Centrafricaine (BPMC), Banque Sahélo-Saharienne pour le Commerce et l'Investissement en Centrafrique (BSIC –Centrafrique), Commercial Banque Centrafrique (CBCA) et Ecobank Centrafrique. ... La Banque Agricole et Commerciale (BAC) et la Banque Sahelo-Saharienne pour l'Investissement en Centrafrique (BSIC-Centrafrique) ne prélèvent plus les frais de tenue de compte. Cependant, il convient de relever que BSIC-Centrafrique retranche un montant forfaitaire à l'occasion du paiement mensuel des salaires des fonctionnaires ... Dans l'ensemble des banques de la sous-région, les frais de tenue de compte ne sont plus prélevés aux particuliers.

entries.foundInPart: The BEAC's 'Architecture de la tarification des services bancaires dans la CEMAC' (May-June 2011) names the Central African Republic's four banks at 31 December 2010 (BPMC, BSIC-Centrafrique, CBCA and Ecobank Centrafrique) and says BAC and BSIC-Centrafrique no longer charge an account-keeping fee and that across the zone's banks individuals are no longer charged one. It is the regulator's fifteen-year-old survey, not a bank's own current tariff, so no bank is written.

sources.title: BBVA, ¿Qué es el pago mínimo y el pago para no generar intereses en una tarjeta de crédito? (24 August 2026)
sources.said: Banco de México (Banxico) definió tres criterios para determinar el importe del pago mínimo, predominando aquel en el que el monto resulte mayor. Criterio 1. entries.foundInPart: Banque Atlantique Guinée-Bissau's harmonised tariff for individuals, second half of 2026 (linked from the bank's conditions-of-banking page), prices a credit card, the Mastercard Atlantique Premium, held in euros and priced in francs CFA: 98,395 to acquire the main card and 65,600 a secondary one, under the heading of the yearly renewal or subscription (2.2.2.1; 2.2.2.4 sends renewal to the acquisition price), a credit line of 655,960 to 6,559,570, a one-time arranging charge of 50,000 to 75,000, withdrawals at 4% (at least 10 euros), and a 'Taxa de juro' of 1.50%. The table doesn't say over what period the 1.50% runs, so it can't be written as a rate, and the card stays unkept, as Tanzania's Gold card did (the lead's ruling, 2026-11-03). Its 'Comissões sobre saques 13,00%' and 'Comissões nas compras 11%' aren't explained.

entries.foundInPart: Read on 2026-11-03: ANZ's own page says ANZ American Samoa closed all accounts in October 2022, and the Territorial Bank of American Samoa's Account Types and Products (effective 1 October 2024) offer checking and savings accounts with the TBAS Mastercard Debit Card and no credit card. entries.foundInPart: Samoa's Credit Information Register Act 2026 (No. 4, assented 25 August 2026), read in full on 2026-11-03: the Central Bank of Samoa will keep a national Credit Information Register; lenders report at intervals prescribed or approved by the Central Bank (s.16(1)(b)); a debtor's default stays five years from the date of default and must then be removed (s.20(2)(d)). But the Act commences only on a date the Minister nominates (s.1(2)), and no commencement notice was found on the Central Bank's or Parliament's site on 2026-11-03, so it isn't yet the rule and isn't written. When it commences, Samoa's file would be the Register, keep 5, the days to report the game's reading. Until then the only bureau is the private Data Bureau (Samoa) Ltd, whose site resets the connection and whose terms weren't found.

sources.title: Credit Information Register Act 2026 (No. 4), Samoa, English text, linked from the Legislative Assembly's Bills, Acts and Regulations page (served from palemene.sharepoint.com)
sources.said: AN ACT to provide for the establishment of a national Credit Information Register to be administered by the Central Bank of Samoa. [25th August 2026] ... (2) This Act (except for items 2 to 6 of the Schedule) commences on a date to be nominated by the Minister. ... (b) at the prescribed reporting intervals or, if none is prescribed, at the reporting intervals approved by the Central Bank. ... 20. Retention of credit information-(1) The Central Bank may retain information on the Register for the periods set out in subsection (2) and must remove information at the expiry of those periods. ... (d) for credit default information relating to default by the debtor, 5 years from the date of default

sources.said: 2. Qu'est-ce que le Bureau d'Information sur le Crédit (BIC)? Le Bureau d'Information sur le Crédit (BIC) est un organe de la Banque de la République d'Haïti (BRH) appelé à remplir le rôle du bureau de crédit. ... 10. Quelle est la durée de vie de ces informations? Tout bureau d'Information sur le Crédit assure l'archivage des renseignements sur le crédit pendant une période de dix (10) ans à partir de la date de réception du dernier élément d'information.

sources.title: BRH, Circulaire No. 105-2 aux institutions financières (Port-au-Prince, 15 septembre 2025; in force 15 October 2025, repealing Circulaire 105-1 of 3 April 2017)
sources.said: 2.- Les institutions financières sont tenues de transmettre au BIC, au plus tard le dix (10) de chaque mois, les informations du mois précédent concernant tous les crédits accordés à leurs clients (personne physique ou morale). (page 1 of the scan, read from its image) ... 12.- La présente circulaire abroge la circulaire 105-1 en date du 3 avril 2017 et entre en vigueur le 15 octobre 2025.

entries.foundInPart: Found: the bureau is the Banque de la République d'Haïti's own Bureau d'Information sur le Crédit (BIC), launched 21 October 2014 and operating from 1 October 2015 (its BIC page); Circulaire 105-2 (15 September 2025, in force 15 October 2025, repealing 105-1 of 3 April 2017) has every financial institution send the BIC the previous month's information on all its credits by the 10th of each month, which the engine would write as 30 days, as it writes the BCEAO's monthly rule for Burkina Faso. Still missing: how many years a late payment stays on the record. The BRH's FAQ (question 10, 'durée de vie de ces informations') says a bureau archives credit information for ten years from the date it received the last item; that is how long the data is archived, not how long a late payment shows on a report, and the circular (OCR read in full for 'ans', 'archiv', 'conserv', 'durée') states no period, so the keep stays blocked and no record is written.

entries.sought: The credit records of Bermuda: the bureau that keeps them, when a late payment is reported, and how long it stays

attempts.tried: The Bermuda Credit Association's own site (bca.bm: home, about, services, credit, debt, terms and privacy pages) and the Bermuda Monetary Authority's home page (bma.bm)
attempts.result: The Association, founded in 1957 and incorporated by the Bermuda Credit Association Act in 1961, runs Bermuda's credit bureau; its credit-reporting page rates a consumer A (no debts), B (debts paid in full) or C (debts outstanding) and lists paid and outstanding debts and court phases, but no page states when a missed payment is listed or how long a record stays. The Monetary Authority's home page links no credit-reporting rule.

attempts.tried: The Laws of Bermuda (bermudalaws.bm): the Debt Collection Act 2018 and the Debt Collection (General) Regulations 2020, read in full; a search for the Bermuda Credit Association Act 1961
attempts.result: The Act's s.22 limits who may obtain information from a credit reporting agency's files, and is marked 'Not In Force'; s.49(2)(d) lets the Minister make regulations on conditions and restrictions for credit reporting agencies; neither the Act nor the 2020 Regulations sets a reporting delay or a retention period. The 1961 Act isn't on the site (404 at its consolidated path; not in the search results).

entries.foundInPart: The Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands says there are no permanent residents in the Territories and no right to enter or remain without its permission; the people there (mid-teens in winter, around 30 in summer) are mostly Government Officers, BAS scientists and support staff. entries.sought: The credit records of Djibouti: the bureau that keeps them, when a late payment is reported, and how long it stays

sources.title: Banque Centrale de Djibouti, Instruction n° 2018-01 sur la Centrale des Risques de la Banque Centrale de Djibouti (scanned; read by eye)
sources.said: Les déclarations sont effectuées selon une périodicité mensuelle. Les données déclarées sont arrêtées au dernier jour ouvrable de chaque mois et doivent parvenir à la Banque Centrale, sur tout support de transmission électronique tel que prévu par la circulaire n°01/BCD/2012 sur la transmission des états périodiques, au plus tard le dix (10) du mois suivant celui de l'arrêté des situations comptables. ... La Banque Centrale de Djibouti met à la disposition des établissements participants des rapports de crédits ou de solvabilité contenant les montants des concours enregistrés au nom de chaque bénéficiaire ayant fait l'objet d'une déclaration ainsi que d'autres informations complémentaires, notamment l'existence ou non d'incidents de remboursement durant les deux dernières années. ... Les informations collectées sur le crédit ainsi que toutes les données et documents qu'elles ont servi à produire doivent être conservés sous forme nominative pendant une durée de cinq (5) ans par la Centrale des risques, à compter de leur date de mise à disposition par les établissements déclarants. ... Les informations négatives relatives aux clients des établissements participants ne peuvent être retracées dans les rapports de solvabilité les concernant au terme du délai de conservation des données.

sources.title: Loi n°119/AN/15/7ème L portant création d’un système d’information sur le crédit, promulgated 16 July 2016 (Banque Centrale de Djibouti copy; scanned; read by eye)
sources.said: Le système d'information sur le crédit conserve sous forme nominative dans ses bases de données, les informations relatives aux crédits des emprunteurs pour une durée qui ne peut excéder 7 ans. Au-delà de cette durée, les informations ne peuvent être conservées que sous forme anonyme. ... La Banque Centrale détermine les durées maximales de restitution des données, ou catégories de données, qui apparaissent sur les rapports de crédit.

sources.title: Banco Central de São Tomé e Príncipe, Norma de Aplicação Permanente (NAP) n.º 22/2009, Sistema Central de Riscos de Crédito, issued 31 December 2009, in force 1 January 2010
sources.said: As entidades participantes do SCRC devem encaminhar as informações actualizadas sobre seus clientes até o 10.º (décimo) dia seguinte ao mês de referência. ... As informações registadas no SCRC serão conservadas em suporte informático por um período de cinco anos, após o qual deverão ser eliminadas. ... Os créditos abatidos e não recebidos devem ser informados no prazo de cinco anos, contados da data do vencimento do contrato ou operação, devendo o registo ser retirado do sistema depois de decorrido esse prazo. ... sources.title: Cook Islands Statistics Office, Cook Islands 2015-16 Household Income and Expenditure Survey report, section 3 (Income and expenditure distribution) and Table 65
sources.said: we’ve ranked HHs by their level of per capita total annual income and created five groups. The 20 percent of HHs with the lowest annual income are grouped into quintile 1, while the 20 percent of HHs with the highest income are put into quintile 5. ... The highest quintile has a HH average income of NZD 73,710 per annum, while the lowest quintile amounts NZD 24,810 per annum. ... Table 65: Gini coefficient, by strata Urban 0.329 Rural 0.386 Total 0.360

entries.foundInPart: The Cook Islands Statistics Office's 2015-16 Household Income and Expenditure Survey ranks households by per capita total annual income into quintiles and states only the two ends, in New Zealand dollars a year per household: the lowest quintile's average income 24,810 and the highest's 73,710 (the middle three are charted without figures), with a Gini of 0.360. That is per household, not per adult, gross (with imputed rent and home production), not after tax, and gives no wealth, so the means aren't written.

entries.sought: The means of a family in La Réunion: average net wealth and post-tax income per adult by band of the population

sources.title: Insee Analyses La Réunion n° 38, 'Les inégalités de patrimoine à La Réunion en 2015' (Coralie Ramaye, février 2019)
sources.said: à La Réunion les 10 % les plus pauvres possèdent 1 200 euros de patrimoine en moyenne contre 1 million d'euros pour les 10 % les plus riches ... Les 40 % les plus modestes ont ainsi trois fois moins de patrimoine qu'en province : 9 000 euros en moyenne contre 27 000 euros ... la moitié des ménages réunionnais disposent d'un patrimoine inférieur à 107 000 euros ... Lecture : En 2015, les 10 % des ménages les plus riches (supérieur à D9) disposent en moyenne d'un patrimoine de 1 034 milliers d'euros à La Réunion ... En moyenne, les ménages réunionnais possèdent 212 000 euros de patrimoine ... les 10 % des Réunionnais les plus riches détiennent 29 % de l'ensemble des revenus. Source : Insee, enquête patrimoine 2014-2015.

attempts.tried: WebSearch #1 'INSEE patrimoine des ménages Guadeloupe Martinique Guyane La Réunion Mayotte déciles patrimoine net revenu disponible' and #2 'INSEE Filosofi DOM revenu disponible par unité de consommation déciles Guadeloupe Martinique Réunion Guyane Mayotte' and #18 'INSEE enquête Histoire de vie et Patrimoine 2021 DOM Martinique Réunion Guyane Mayotte patrimoine net moyen par décile'
attempts.result: INSEE pages on DOM poverty (2017 income deciles), the 2010 Guadeloupe and 2015 Réunion patrimoine studies, and the national 2021 wealth survey (France hors Mayotte). None gives average net wealth and average post-tax income per adult for the bottom 20/40/60/90/99% and top 1% in Mayotte.

attempts.tried: Press and secondary pages among the results of searches #1, #2 and #18
attempts.result: Among #1 and #2 results: INSEE Budget de famille 2017 says 10% of Mayotte's people have more than 1,800 euros a month (a cut point, not a band average); Mayotte is outside the national wealth survey (search #18). No band averages of wealth.

attempts.tried: archive.org's Wayback availability API (bin/wb.sh) for https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/4622377; https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/8262354; https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/1290500
attempts.result: https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/4622377: snapshot 20261009153904; https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/8262354: no snapshot listed; https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/1290500: snapshot 20231001222648. web.archive.org, which serves the snapshots, is refused by this environment's egress, so none could be read.

attempts.tried: INSEE, Insee Analyses Mayotte 25, "Les inégalités de niveau de vie se sont creusées" (https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/4622454), curl
attempts.result: 200: deciles D4 to D9 of niveau de vie per consumption unit from Budget de famille 2017-2018 (the first three not shown, "soumis à aléas"); no band averages and no wealth.

attempts.tried: the World Inequality Database bulk download of 15 October 2026 (https://wid.world/bulk_download/wid_all_data.zip, saved), its country file list and a search of it for WID_data_YT.csv; CASD, the secure data centre that holds INSEE's Histoire de vie et Patrimoine survey, https://www.casd.eu/source/enquete-histoire-de-vie-et-patrimoine/, curl
attempts.result: The bulk download has no file for YT: the database publishes no series for it, so no average net wealth (ahwealj992) or post-tax disposable income (adiincj992) by percentile. Answered (200): the survey is listed as restricted microdata; no published table of net wealth by band for any overseas department.

attempts.tried: WebSearch #2 "Insee La Réunion niveau de vie moyen par décile patrimoine net ménages Réunion 2021 enquête"; WebSearch #3 "Insee Mayotte Guadeloupe Martinique Guyane enquête Budget de famille 2017 revenu disponible moyen par quintile patrimoine des ménages"; WebSearch #21 "Martinique Guadeloupe Guyane patrimoine des ménages inégalités 10 % les plus riches détiennent étude Insee Analyses patrimoine"
attempts.result: INSEE regional studies: decile cut points and medians of niveau de vie (Réunion 2023, Mayotte 2018, Guyane and Guadeloupe 2017), gross household wealth by decile from the 2014-2015 survey for La Réunion and 2011 for Guadeloupe; no average net wealth and post-tax income per adult for the bottom 20/40/60/90/99 percent and top 1 percent.

attempts.tried: Eurostat (an international body publishing INSEE's regional accounts), API https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/nama_10r_2hhinc?geo=FRY1..FRY5&unit=EUR_HAB&na_item=B6N&direct=BAL&time=2022, curl
attempts.result: Answered (200): the households' disposable income per inhabitant in 2022, provisional, is one average for each region (Guadeloupe 17,900, Martinique 19,700, Guyane 12,000, La Réunion 18,200, Mayotte 7,700 euros); no bands and no wealth.

attempts.tried: archive.org's availability API (bin/wb.sh) for https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/4622377, then the raw snapshot (id_) from web.archive.org
attempts.result: Snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261009153904/https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/4622377 listed by the availability API; web.archive.org reset the connection on every try (two passes of five tries, the second with pauses of 18 to 50 seconds; last status 000), so it was not read.

attempts.tried: World Inequality Database bulk download, https://wid.world/bulk_download/wid_all_data.zip, the release of 30 October 2026 (Last-Modified), its zip central directory read by an HTTP range request
attempts.result: A newer release than the 15 October file the register read. The archive's central directory (848 files) holds no WID_data_YT.csv: the database publishes no series for it.

attempts.tried: INSEE, 'Patrimoine et endettement des ménages en 2021 et en séries longues', https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/8262354 (curl, 200), and IEOM, https://www.ieom.fr/ (curl, 200)
attempts.result: INSEE's page gives the 2021 survey's national tables (France without Mayotte) and no table by overseas department; IEOM's home page carries no household wealth or income distribution.

attempts.tried: WebSearch #2 (round 3, ws-4): "Insee Mayotte niveau de vie déciles revenu disponible patrimoine des ménages Mayotte"
attempts.result: Insee Analyses Mayotte n°25 'Les inégalités de niveau de vie se sont creusées. Revenus et pauvreté à Mayotte en 2018' (insee.fr/fr/statistiques/4622454) and older Insee notes; no Mayotte wealth (patrimoine) results.

attempts.tried: Insee, https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/4622454, curl 200, saved as files/ws-4/insee4622454.html
attempts.result: Figure 2 gives decile limits of monthly niveau de vie per consumption unit, Mayotte 2018 (Budget de famille 2017-2018): D4 140, D5 260, D6 410, D7 740, D8 1,090, D9 1,780 euros (2011: 180, 300, 440, 590, 820, 1,200); D1-D3 not published ('particulièrement faibles et soumis à aléas'). Decile limits, not band averages; per consumption unit, not per adult; no wealth.

attempts.result: The release holds no WID_data_YT.csv; the blocker stands.

sources.said: Άρθρο 69 Μέλη καλλιτεχνικών συγκροτημάτων (τίτλος διαμονής τύπου «Ζ.2») 1. Σε πολίτες τρίτων χωρών που επιθυμούν να εισέλθουν στη χώρα ως μέλη καλλιτεχνικών συγκροτημάτων, χορηγείται εθνική θεώρηση εισόδου που τους επιτρέπει τη διαμονή για εργασιακούς λόγους, εφόσον προσκομίσουν οι ίδιοι με αυτοπρόσωπη παρουσία ή αποστείλουν με ηλεκτρονικό ταχυδρομείο ή με συστημένη επιστολή στην αρμόδια ελληνική προξενική αρχή: α) επικυρωμένο αντίγραφο της σύμβασης εργασίας με θεωρημένο το γνήσιο της υπογραφής του εργοδότη από δημόσια υπηρεσία ή αντίγραφο σύμβασης παροχής υπηρεσιών ή έργου, β) αποδείξεις για την ανωτέρω ιδιότητα, μεταξύ των οποίων βεβαίωση της αρμόδιας υπηρεσίας της χώρας προέλευσης για την επίσημη καταχώριση του συγκροτήματος. 2. Η θεώρηση εισόδου είναι ισόχρονη με τη διάρκεια των παραστάσεων ή εκδηλώσεων, δεν μπορεί να υπερβαίνει το ένα (1) έτος και παρέχει δικαίωμα πρόσβασης στην αγορά εργασίας αποκλειστικά για την παροχή της συγκεκριμένης εργασίας, λαμβανομένης υπόψη της ενιαίας δομής του καλλιτεχνικού συγκροτήματος. Άρθρο 70 Πνευματικοί δημιουργοί (τίτλος διαμονής τύπου «Ζ.3») Σε πολίτες τρίτων χωρών που επιθυμούν να εισέλθουν στη χώρα ως πνευματικοί δημιουργοί που παράγουν έργα πνευματικού περιεχομένου και ιδίως συγγραφείς, λογοτέχνες, σκηνοθέτες, ζωγράφοι, γλύπτες, ηθοποιοί, μουσικοί, τραγουδιστές, χορογράφοι, σκηνογράφοι και μέλη κινηματογραφικών συνεργείων, χορηγείται εθνική θεώρηση εισόδου που τους επιτρέπει τη διαμονή για τον σκοπό αυτό, εφόσον προσκομίσουν οι ίδιοι με αυτοπρόσωπη παρουσία ή αποστείλουν με ηλεκτρονικό ταχυδρομείο ή με συστημένη επιστολή στην αρμόδια ελληνική προξενική αρχή, σύμβαση διάρκειας μεγαλύτερης των τριών (3) μηνών με επιχείρηση ή οργανισμό, το αντικείμενο του οποίου συνίσταται σε δραστηριότητες εκμετάλλευσης ή δημιουργίας προϊόντων πνευματικής ιδιοκτησίας.

entries.sought: How banks in Nigeria number their accounts: the account number's structure and the bank's place in it

sources.title: Central Bank of Nigeria, Revised Standards on Nigeria Uniform Bank Account Number (NUBAN) for Banks and Other Financial Institutions (2019)
sources.said: The NUBAN format shall consist of 16 digits with the following structure: ABCDEFGHIJKLMNO-P where ... ABCDEF is the 3-digit Financial Institution code assigned by the CBN, with 3 leading zeros ... Step 1: Calculate A*3+B*7+C*3+D*3+E*7+F*3+G*3+H*7+I*3+J*3+K*7+L*3+M*3+N*7+O*3 Step 2: Calculate Modulo 10 of your result i.e. the remainder after dividing by 10 Step 3: Subtract your result from 10 to get the Check Digit Step 4: If your result is 10, then use 0 as your check digit ... Therefore, the NUBAN code for this illustration is 0000014579 ... The NUBAN account number advised to a customer shall be 10 digits

sources.said: Artigo 3 (Estrutura do IBAN) O IBAN tem a seguinte estrutura: MZ+59+NIB MZ 59 xxxx xxxx xxxxxxxxxxx xx 1 2 3 4 5 6 Onde: 1 – Código que referencia o país (Moçambique); 2 – Dígitos de controlo do IBAN; 3 – Código da instituição de crédito; 4 – Código do balcão; 5 – Número de conta; 6 – Dígitos de controlo do Número de Identificação Bancária (NIB). ... sources.said: Nº da Conta à Ordem / Current Account Number 152157402 NIB / Interbank Identification Number 0001 0000 0015 2157 4025 7 ... IBAN / IBAN MZ59 0001 0000 0015 2157 4025 7 Código Swift / Swift code BIMOMZMXXXX

entries.foundInPart: Progress (2026-11-03): the Banco de Moçambique's Aviso n.º 18/GBM/2013 (Boletim da República, I série, n.º 104, 6.º suplemento, 31 December 2013; LexLink's copy) sets the IBAN as MZ, 59 and the NIB, and lays the NIB out as four digits for the credit institution, four for the branch (balcão), eleven for the account and two NIB control digits: 21 digits; it puts the IBAN's check under NM ISO 13616-1 but doesn't state the NIB's own control digits' algorithm. Millennium bim's account letter (NIB 0001 0000 0015 2157 4025 7, IBAN MZ59 0001 0000 0015 2157 4025 7) is one in that form. A fixed 59 under ISO 13616's check means every NIB reads 1 mod 97, which ISO 7064's MOD 97-10 gives (the bim NIB does), but it leaves the two digits open in three cases of 97 (00 or 97, 01 or 98, 02 or 99), so the algorithm isn't held as stated. Still missing: the Banco de Moçambique's statement of the NIB's control digits.

entries.foundInPart: Progress (2026-11-03): three RIBs of the Union, each on the account holder's or the bank's own document, show one layout: 24 characters, the bank's code five (the country's two ISO letters, then three digits: SN000 the BCEAO's Dakar office, CI059 Ecobank Côte d'Ivoire, BJ185 BIIC Benin), the branch's (guichet) five digits, the account twelve digits and the key two digits; the IBAN is the country's letters, two check digits and the 24 characters, 28 in all (BJ66 BJ18 5011 0000 1400 0247 0305, CI93 CI05 9010 5612 0981 5090 0192). Worked over all three, the key is the French RIB key (97 less the 22 characters' hundredfold read mod 97, the two letters first turned to digits by the French table, A and J 1 to I and R and Z 9), and the IBAN check digits verify on the two IBANs; that rule and the layout itself rest on the examples only, no BCEAO or Commission text stating either was read. Still missing: the BCEAO's or the Union's own text of the RIB's parts and its key. Nothing is held in the game until it is read (the engine's number can't yet fix the country's letters or work a key over them).

sources.title: Government of New Brunswick, Driver's licences
sources.said: A person may apply for a Class 7 driver's licence (Graduated Licence Program) at age 16 with parental consent. ... A person may apply for a class 5 driver’s licence, after completing a minimum of 24 months at level 1 and 2 (combined), with a minimum of 12 months in level 2. ... Fees as of August 1st, 2026 ... Class 1-9 Licence is valid for four years $100

sources.title: Government of New Brunswick, Photo identification card
sources.said: Any resident of New Brunswick may apply for a photo identification card. There is no age restriction. ... Photo ID $48.00

sources.title: Government of New Brunswick, Driver's licences for new residents
sources.said: Drivers from Canadian provinces or the United States may exchange their licence class for class, including Class 7, without taking any driver’s test or submitting a medical ... The countries below have reciprocity with Canada and their nationals can exchange their licence without testing for a Class 5 or motorcycle ... Austria, Australia, Belgium, Denmark, England, France, Germany, Isle of Man, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Netherlands (Holland), New Zealand, Norway, Portugal, Scotland, Republic of Korea (South Korea), Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan*, Ukraine* and Wales.

sources.said: Be 15 years of age or older ... Must hold a Learner’s licence (Class 7) for at least one year ... sources.title: GNWT Driver and Vehicle Services, Get an identification card for the first time
sources.said: General identification cards (GIC) are valid for five years ... Clients that are 12 years of age or older are eligible to obtain a GIC. ... New card: $54

sources.said: 第十三条 机动车驾驶证有效期分为六年、十年和长期。 ... 申请小型汽车、小型自动挡汽车、残疾人专用小型自动挡载客汽车、轻便摩托车准驾车型的，在18周岁以上； ... 机动车驾驶人在机动车驾驶证的六年有效期内，每个记分周期均未记满12分的，换发十年有效期的机动车驾驶证

sources.said: The national number shall be one unique number for each citizen made up of twelve (12) digits. ... entries.sought: How someone from abroad can come to live in Albania: each residence route's fee, time, term and what it allows

sources.title: Ligji nr. 79/2021 "Për të huajt", consolidated with Law 43/2025 (State Police, asp.gov.al)
sources.said: b) leje qëndrimi ose leje unike e tipit “B”, e ripërtëritshme, e cila lëshohet me afat të përcaktuar ... I huaji, i pajisur me vizë të tipit “D”, si dhe i huaji i cili nuk ka nevojë për vizë me motiv qëndrimi bëjnë kërkesë on-line për leje qëndrimi. ... I huaji brenda 30 ditëve pas hyrjes në territorin e Republikës së Shqipërisë dhe brenda afatit të qëndrimit të ligjshëm në territor për të huajt që hyjnë pa vizë bën kërkesë për lëshimin e lejes së përkohshme të qëndrimit dhe brenda 60 ditëve përpara përfundimit të afatit të lejes ekzistuese të qëndrimit bën kërkesë për ripërtëritjen e saj ... Shqyrtimi i kërkesës dhe lëshimi i lejes unike të qëndrimit kur plotësohen kriteret e kërkuara nga legjislacioni në fuqi bëhen brenda 4 javësh nga dita e aplikimit. ... Leja unike si punëmarrës jepet për kohëzgjatjen e kontratës/ofertës së punës, përveç rasteve kur parashikohet ndryshe në këtë ligj. ... i huaji kryen punë tjetër nga ajo për të cilën është lëshuar leja unike, me përjashtim të të huajve, të cilët kanë një leje të përhershme qëndrimi; ... i huaji ndërpret kontratën e punës për arsye të ndryshme dhe largohet nga vendi i punës për të cilin ka marrë lejen. ... Shtetasit e vendeve të Bashkimit Evropian kanë të drejtën e qëndrimit në territorin e Republikës së Shqipërisë pa leje qëndrimi apo leje unike për periudha qëndrimi më të gjata se tre muaj, nëse: a) janë punëmarrës ose të vetëpunësuar; ... kanë detyrimin të regjistrohen on-line pranë autoritetit përgjegjës për kufirin dhe migracionin, në territorin e së cilës kanë vendqëndrimin, jo më vonë se tre muaj nga data e mbërritjes. ... Shtetasit e vendeve të Bashkimit Evropian, që kanë banuar ligjërisht për një periudhë të vazhdueshme prej pesë vjetësh në Republikën e Shqipërisë, kanë të drejtën e qëndrimit të përhershëm. ... shtetas të vendeve anëtare të Bashkimit Evropian dhe të zonës Shengen ... të cilët gëzojnë të drejtën e punësimit sikurse edhe shtetasit shqiptarë, ... I huaji bën kërkesë për pajisje me leje të përhershme qëndrimi të tipit “C” pranë autoritetit përgjegjës rajonal për kufirin dhe migracionin ku ka vendqëndrimin 60 ditë para mbarimit të afatit të lejes së qëndrimit. ... me leje qëndrimi të përhershme bëhet brenda 60 ditëve në rast se rezulton të jenë përmbushur ... ka qëndruar në mënyrë të ligjshme dhe të vazhdueshme si banor në Republikën e Shqipërisë për të paktën 5 vjet nga paraqitja e parë e kërkesës për leje qëndrimi, ... mund të punësohet, të vetëpunësohet ose të merret me veprimtari biznesi të drejtpërdrejtë, pa pasur nevojë të pajiset me leje punësimi.

O Visto de Trabalho é concedido pelas missões diplomáticas e consulares e destina-se a permitir a entrada em território angolano ao seu titular, a fim de nele exercer actividade profissional remunerada. ... 2. sources.title: Décret n° 2018-454 du 09 mai 2018 relatif au Registre National des Personnes Physiques (scan published by ONECI under Textes de loi)
sources.said: Article 8 : Un numéro national d'identification est attribué à chaque personne lors de son enregistrement au RNPP. Ce numéro est unique, inintelligible et non répétitif. Il est attribué à vie. Le numéro national d'identification est exclusivement connu de l'ONI et de la personne concernée. ... La détermination de la composition du numéro national d'identification est précisée par décret pris en Conseil des Ministres. Article 7 : Sont inscrites au RNPP : les personnes inscrites aux registres d'état civil ...; les personnes résidant ou de passage en Côte d'Ivoire; les étrangers vivant de façon temporaire ou permanente en Côte d'Ivoire.

Still missing: the entry number's length, and the form of the unique number (NINU) of the decree that replaced the 2005 card's in 2020, which isn't read. The tax number's ten digits (a Canadian embassy officer's report of 2008, by the same Board) are a lead only: no Haitian text was named for them.

sources.title: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada, Response to Information Request HTI103582.FE (30 September 2010): Haiti: information appearing on the national identification card (CIN), including the meaning of the digits in the national identification number
sources.said: from left to right, the first two digits are the department code; the following two digits refer to the city; the next two refer to the country; the next four and the next two indicate, respectively, the year and the month of birth; finally, the last digits represent the entry number in the national identification registry ( registre national d'identification ) (Haiti 9 Sept. 2010). ... As for countries, code 99, which appears on the CIN, refers to the Republic of Haiti, while code 00 refers to the Dominican Republic

entries.foundInPart: Found in part (2026-11-03): Décret n° 2016-1536 of 29 September 2016 (the ECOWAS biometric card), art. 1, gives the card's own number as seventeen digits (sex, 1 or 2; region, 2; date of birth, 8, year, month, day; 5 generated; a last check digit, its algorithm not stated) and puts the NIN on the back of the card without its form. The Ministry of the Interior's communiqué of July 2012, as the APS dispatch quotes it, made the NIN alphanumeric: once the civil-status centres' codes ran from 001 to 999, a letter takes the first place of the centre's code (its examples: 1 G01 1985 00654, 2 B01 2010 02565). Still missing: the NIN's form in the 2016 decree or the Ministry's or DGID's own words for the biometric card. The held reading of decree 2005-787 (research/held/papers/numbers/SN.w16.json) is updated to admit the letter.

Numéro d’identification national (NIN).

entries.foundInPart: Progress (2026-11-03): the Banque Extérieure d'Algérie's RIB for the 'COVID 19 ALGERIE' accounts (published by the Consulate General of Algeria in Nantes, April 2020) gives three numbers in one layout: the institution (3 digits, 002), the branch (guichet, 5), the account (10) and a key (2), 20 digits. Worked on all three, the key is 97 less the branch's and the account's fifteen digits with two noughts after them read mod 97 (46, 43, 40); over all eighteen it fails. That rule rests on the examples only; the Banque d'Algérie's Instruction 06-2004 wasn't read. Still missing: the Banque d'Algérie's own text of the RIB and its key.

sources.title: ՀՀ օրենքը Օտարերկրացիների մասին (ARLIS, as consolidated on 2026-10-30)
sources.said: բ) սույն օրենքի համաձայն՝ աշխատանքի թույլտվությունը ... ե) ձեռնարկատիրական գործունեությամբ զբաղվելը. ... 2. Ժամանակավոր կացության կարգավիճակը տրվում է մինչև 1 տարի ժամկետով՝ յուրաքանչյուր անգամ 1 տարով երկարաձգելու հնարավորությամբ: ... 2. Մշտական կացության կարգավիճակը տրվում է 5 տարի ժամկետով` յուրաքանչյուր անգամ նույն ժամկետով երկարաձգելու հնարավորությամբ: ... Ժամանակավոր և մշտական կացության կարգավիճակ տալու կամ մերժելու մասին որոշում կայացնում է միգրացիայի և քաղաքացիության բնագավառում պետական կառավարման լիազոր մարմինը՝ դիմումը ներկայացնելու օրվանից 30-օրյա ժամկետում, բացառությամբ սույն օրենքի 15-րդ հոդվածի 1-ին մասի «բ» և «զ.1» կետերի հիմքերով կացության կարգավիճակի տրամադրման դեպքերի:

sources.title: ՀՀ օրենքը «Օտարերկրացիների մասին» օրենքում փոփոխություններ և լրացումներ կատարելու մասին, ՀՕ-11-Ն (ARLIS)

entries.foundInPart: Yemen's Law No. 23 of 2003 (art. 2, adding arts. 6 bis and 6 bis (1) to Republican Decree-Law No. 23 of 1991 on Civil Status and the Civil Register; a secondary copy, the University of Minnesota Human Rights Library) has the national number assigned in sequence and centrally to every citizen, given on entry in the civil register, carried on every certificate, document and the personal card, kept for life and after death, never replaced, given to another or repeated. The law states no length, characters or check digit, and no reachable text of the Civil Status and Civil Registration Authority gives them, so the number's shape stays unkept.

sources.title: Republican Decree-Law No. 23 of 1991 on Civil Status and the Civil Register, with Law No. 23 of 2003 amending it (Official Gazette no. 7/1 of 1991; the amendment in no. 5 of 2003), as the University of Minnesota Human Rights Library reproduces it

entries.foundInPart: Law No. 105-З of 4 January 2010 on the legal status of foreign citizens and stateless persons, on the National Legal Internet Portal (last amended by Law No. 130-З of 2 February 2026), gives the temporary residence permit for the stay, no more than one year unless a legislative act sets another, on grounds including work under an employment contract (art. 48); permanent residents may work and run a business as citizens do, temporary residents may not run an individual business (art. 11); and the permanent permit after five years' continuous living on a temporary one, among other grounds (art. 53). The state duty for each permit (the Tax Code's annex 23), the decision times and the renewal weren't read, so the routes aren't whole and Belarus's residence stays unkept.

sources.title: National Legal Internet Portal of the Republic of Belarus, Закон Республики Беларусь от 4 января 2010 г. № 105-З «О правовом положении иностранных граждан и лиц без гражданства в Республике Беларусь», arts. 11, 48 and 53
sources.said: Art. 48: Разрешение на временное проживание выдается иностранцам: ... на срок пребывания, но не более одного года, если иной срок не установлен законодательными актами ... если они прибыли в Республику Беларусь для занятия или занимаются трудовой деятельностью по трудовым договорам. Art. 11: Постоянно проживающие в Республике Беларусь иностранцы имеют право заниматься трудовой и индивидуальной предпринимательской деятельностью ...; временно проживающие ... не вправе осуществлять в Республике Беларусь индивидуальную предпринимательскую деятельность. Art. 53: ... прожили в Республике Беларусь после получения разрешения на временное проживание в течение последних пяти лет непрерывно.

entries.foundInPart: Syria's Law No. 2 of 2014 on the entry, residence and exit of Arabs and foreigners, read in full in a secondary copy (mohamah.net; the People's Assembly's text and Refworld's copy weren't reachable), sorts residence into five kinds: special (five years: over fifteen years' lawful residence, or five with work useful to the economy or scientific, cultural or artistic service, scholars and men of letters, art, thought, industry and economy named by the Minister, and Syrians' wives after two years), ordinary (three years), temporary (one year: students, scholars and artists, refugees, Syrians' spouses, patients, visiting relatives, investors, property owners), tourist (up to three months) and work residence (up to a year, on the Ministry of Labour's approval) (arts. 17 to 21). A holder may not act outside the permit's purpose without the Minister's consent (art. 23); it covers the spouse and minor children (art. 24); special and ordinary residence lapse after more than a year abroad (art. 22). But art. 29's fees (15,000 SYP for a special or work card, artists' work residence included; 10,000 ordinary; 5,000 a year temporary) were amended in 2016 and by Law No. 12 of 2022, whose text wasn't read, and whether the authorities since December 2024 keep the law in force wasn't established, so Syria's residence routes stay unkept.

sources.title: محاماة نت: نصوص ومواد القانون رقم 2 للعام 2014 بشأن دخول أي شخص إلى الجمهورية العربية السورية أو الخروج منها
sources.said: المادة (17) تصنف إقامات العرب والأجانب وفق الآتي: أ- الإقامة الخاصة.. تمنح لمدة خمس سنوات. ب- الإقامة العادية.. تمنح لمدة ثلاث سنوات. ج- الإقامة المؤقتة.. تمنح لمدة سنة. د- الإقامة السياحية.. تمنح لمدة أقصاها ثلاثة أشهر. ه- إقامة العمل.. تمنح لمدة أقصاها سنة بعد أخذ موافقة وزارة العمل. ... المادة (21) تمنح إقامة العمل للعرب والأجانب الحاصلين على موافقة وزارة العمل وفقا للقوانين النافذة. ... المادة (23) يحظر على العربي أو الأجنبي المرخص له بالدخول أو الإقامة لغرض معين أن يخالف هذا الغرض إلا بموافقة الوزير ... المادة (29) أ- تستوفى عند إصدار بطاقات الإقامة بشتى أنواعها الرسوم الآتية: 1- خمسة عشر ألف ليرة سورية عن بطاقة الإقامة الخاصة. 2- خمسة عشر ألف ليرة سورية عن بطاقة الإقامة بقصد العمل بما فيه إقامة عمل الفنانين. 3- عشرة آلاف ليرة سورية عن بطاقة الإقامة العادية. 4- خمسة آلاف ليرة سورية عن كل سنة إقامة لحاملي بطاقة الإقامة المؤقتة لمدة سنة أو كسورها. ... المادة (22) أ- تجدد الإقامة الخاصة والعادية بإذن من المدير إذا تجاوزت مدة غياب صاحب الإقامة خارج الجمهورية العربية السورية ستة أشهر ولم تزد على سنة.

sources.title: BIOT Supreme Court, R (Mandarin and others) v HM Commissioner for the British Indian Ocean Territory, judgment of 31 March 2026
sources.said: No person shall enter the Territory or be present there unless he is in possession of a permit issued under section 7 or his name is endorsed on a permit under section 9. ... An immigration officer, acting in his entire discretion, may issue or renew a permit or may cancel a permit before its expiration ... A permit shall, unless cancelled, remain in force for a period of four years from the date of issue or for such shorter period as is stated in it. ... I quash and will declare that Section 9 of the Constitutional Order 2004 is unlawful and/or Wednesbury unreasonable, especially in light of the current circumstances. ... Section 5 of the Immigration Order 2004 remains valid. ... Any future decisions of the Defendant in relation to the grant of permits need to take into account all the circumstances including heritage rights and the right of abode of any Chagossian entitled to them.

entries.sought: The Democratic Republic of the Congo's category B driving licence (permis de conduire): the age it is issued from, its fee and term, from the Ministry of Transport or the Code de la route and the order of 2 August 2023.

attempts.tried: https://www.mtpt.gov.cd/, https://www.transports.gouv.cd/ (its WordPress posts and pages searched for "permis"), https://www.primature.gouv.cd/
attempts.result: mtpt.gov.cd timed out; transports.gouv.cd answers but its posts have nothing on the licence and its pages only "Structures sous tutelles"; the Prime Minister's site has no licence page.

attempts.tried: https://www.leganet.cd/; https://www.journalofficiel.cd/ (its search routes /actes?search=, /recherche?q=, /search?q= for "permis de conduire")
attempts.result: leganet.cd timed out; the Journal officiel's site answers but its search routes give 404 or 502 to a plain request.

attempts.tried: "RDC permis de conduire biométrique coût 2026 durée de validité âge minimum catégorie B arrêté ministère des transports"
attempts.result: Mostly France's rules; for the DRC, press on the biometric licence (bankable.africa, allafrica, infos.cd); no ministry page or the order's text.

attempts.tried: https://bankable.africa/en/news/2511-550-dr-congo-otojuste-starts-issuing-biometric-driving-licenses (read)
attempts.result: Bankable (25 November 2024) quotes the joint order of the Ministers of Transport and Finance of 2 August 2023 setting $71.5 for category B, but gives no age and no term, so a licence (whose age the form needs) can't be written from it.

attempts.tried: bash bin/wb.sh https://www.leganet.cd/
attempts.result: A snapshot of 2026-07-01 exists (not readable here).

attempts.tried: https://www.dgrad.cd/ (the revenue authority that collects the fee), https://www.cnpr.cd/ (road safety commission)

https://web.archive.org/web/20241118033839/https://www.leganet.cd/Legislation/DroitPenal/Roulage/Loi.078.022.30.08.1978.pdf (the Code de la route, Law 78-022, read in the archive, saved dl/w16l1/wa-cd-code.pdf)
attempts.result: The 1978 code's text (two-column scan) says the licence "a une durée de validité de 5 ans" and mentions eighteen years for foreign licences; it predates the biometric licence of the 2 August 2023 order, so whether its term and age still hold wasn't settled, and no current text was found.

attempts.tried: permis de conduire biométrique RDC catégorie B âge minimum validité arrêté ministère des transports, limited to transports.gouv.cd, primature.gouv.cd, acp.cd, radiookapi.net, journalofficiel.cd, leganet.cd, presidence.cd
attempts.result: Radio Okapi and ACP on the biometric licence; snippets say the Ministry's 2025 communiqués ask for 18; the 2012 interministerial order 107/CA (35,000 FC, old). No reachable ministry page.

attempts.tried: https://www.radiookapi.net/2023/11/02/emissions/okapi-service/comment-obtenir-le-nouveau-permis-de-conduire-biometrique, https://acp.cd/economie/rdc-le-controle-des-permis-de-conduire-desormais-effectif-sur-lensemble-du-territoire/, https://www.mediacongo.net/

sources.said: Le visa professionnel autorise le titulaire à effectuer au Bénin, pour une activité professionnelle, un séjour d'une durée ne pouvant excéder douze (12) mois. Ce visa est renouvelable pour la même durée de séjour. Le visa d'étude autorise le titulaire à effectuer au Bénin, pour des raisons d'étude ou de formation, un séjour d'une durée ne pouvant excéder douze (12) mois. Ce visa est renouvelable pour la même durée de séjour. ... Article 18 : Conditions de bénéfice de statut de résident privilégié Peut bénéficier du statut de résident privilégié, l'étranger, résident ordinaire, qui a obtenu deux (02) fois le renouvellement de sa carte de résident et qui justifie d'un emploi ou d'une activité permanente ... Article 19 : Durée de validité des cartes de résident La durée de validité de la carte de résident ordinaire est de trois (03) ans. La durée de validité de carte de résident privilégié est de dix (10) ans. Les cartes de résident sont renouvelables.

sources.said: Portail numérique officiel des titres de séjour ... LOI 04-058 AN RM — Conditions d'entrée, de séjour et d'établissement des étrangers au Mali ... Tout étranger âgé de plus de 18 ans doit, à l'expiration d'un délai de trois mois, depuis son entrée sur le territoire du Mali, se faire délivrer une autorisation de séjour temporaire par l'Autorité en charge de l'immigration. L'autorisation de séjour temporaire accordée à l'étranger non immigrant, donne lieu à la délivrance d'un visa de séjour. Le visa de séjour est valable au plus pour un an, à compter de la date de sa délivrance. Il est apposé sur le passeport du titulaire. Il est renouvelable. ... L'autorisation de séjour temporaire est accordée de plein droit : ... 1. à l'étranger marié depuis au moins trois mois, avec un ressortissant de nationalité malienne ... L'autorisation de séjour accordée à l'étranger immigrant donne lieu à la délivrance d'une carte de résident. La carte de résident est valable pour cinq ans, à compter de la date de sa délivrance. Elle est renouvelable. ... L'étranger ne peut exercer aucune activité professionnelle salariée au Mali sans y avoir été autorisé conformément à la législation en vigueur. ... DÉCRET 05-322 P RM — Conditions d'établissement et de séjour des étrangers au Mali ... Toute demande d'autorisation de séjour égal ou supérieur à six mois doit être formulée, postérieurement à l'entrée au Mali, auprès de l'autorité en charge de l'immigration. ... Le visa de séjour est délivré contre paiement d'un droit de timbre conformément aux dispositions du Code général des impôts. Le renouvellement du visa de séjour donne lieu au versement du même droit de timbre. ... L'étranger désireux de s'établir au Mali, pour y exercer une activité salariée, doit, en plus des pièces énumérées à l'article 23 ci-dessus, produire un contrat de travail revêtu du visa de la Direction nationale du travail.

entries.foundInPart: Read 2026-11-03 in the University of Minnesota Human Rights Library's copy of the Traffic Law (Presidential Decree-Law No. 46 of 1991, as published in the Official Gazette, issue 7/7 of 1991, with its amendments in issue 21 of 2000 and issue 6 of 2002): art. 2, the licensing and registration authority is the Director General of Traffic or whoever acts for him; art. 22(b), the licence for private cars of up to ten passengers besides the driver; art. 26(4), a driving licence runs five years from the year of issue, ending on 31 December of its fifth year. The Law sets no age for it (art. 34 speaks of 'the age conditions' that no article states) and its fee is 'the prescribed fee', so the licence isn't held.
