entries.sought: The figures the director's engine needs that no source gives: how a director's attributes turn into a film's parts, how short schedules and cuts cost, how far a festival's rate moves with quality, what reads as a debut finding an audience, how a pitch moves a second feature's odds.
entries.why: R-4613 gives the DGA's terms, the CNC's shooting days, festivals' counts and the second-feature rates; it gives no pages-per-day or set-ups rate, no casting or rehearsal period, no third-feature rate, no SXSW submission count, no 2026 Basic Agreement text (its blockers). The game reckons the rest, and tells the player these are its own until the owner balances them.

value.partSkill: a part's skill is the plain mean of its broad attributes' components, each read through its facets (facetSkill: 75% own, 25% tied components)
value.quality: the finished film is the plain mean of story, performances, images (as shot) and the cut

shootNeeded.atPace50: the trade's schedule (32 days a feature, the DGA's guaranteed shooting days an episode)

value.featureShootAppliedToEveryBudget: the CNC's 32-day mean (French fiction features, mean budget EUR 5.66M) is the base for a feature of any budget

cutNeeded.reading: the sideletter's and the Basic Agreement's own ratios read as the footage's need, the game's reading

value.halfHourCutDays: 2: one day and the up to one more the BA allows, read at its most
value.audience: a debut chosen by any festival modeled is read as one that found an audience (Follows's 1,000+ IMDb votes)
value.laterFeatures: a third feature and after need no backing: no source gives a third feature's odds (shortcut until one is found)
value.notModeled: non-network and High Budget SVOD episodes, pilots, episodic hiring (series-affiliated against career-track), SXSW (no submission count), Sundance's episodic section, a feature's pay at $3M or less (left to negotiation: no fee), deals above scale, payment into the ledger (recorded only, as the screenwriter's sale)

entries.sought: The figures the actor's model needs that no source gives: an audition-to-booking ratio, how a part's quality and an audition's are made of the actor's components, what a credit adds, the working days in a non-SAG-AFTRA week, and the rate in force past an agreement's term.
entries.why: R-4614's blocker: SAG-AFTRA's 2022 survey, ACTRA Toronto's 2025 survey, Equity UK, casting platforms and the trade press publish no audition-to-booking ratio (agents' columns say 1 in 6 to 1 in 50, without data); no source weighs an actor's skills into a performance; the agreements' next rates are not yet read. The game reckons them until the owner balances them, and says so (proposed line acting.model).

value.creditIs: the best quality among parts played, 0 to 100; booking chance times (1 + 0.5 * credit / 100)
value.linesAsk: memorise-lines where the part has any lines
value.componentWeights: every component a part asks counts equally
value.spread: the screenwriter's: 3 points either side at 100, 18 at 0 (person.work.model, reused, not copied)
value.practiseDays: an audition teaches one day; a part teaches the days it works
value.selfTapeShareOutsideUS: SAG-AFTRA's 0.92 applied to every agreement (ACTRA Toronto: 'most' first rounds; Equity UK: no share published)
value.rateAfterTerm: the last agreed rate is kept past an agreement's term or its last read year (Pact/Equity after 2025-04-05, UK Theatre after its 2025-26 year, ACTRA after 2027, SAG-AFTRA after 2030-06-30)
value.rateAcrossAStep: an engagement is paid all at the rate in force the day it starts

entries.sought: How a producer's attributes decide the material optioned, how near the need a schedule comes, how financiers and the market take a package, how far a shoot slips, and how far a film and its campaign move the published release and recoupment rates
entries.why: What stands on sources is theirs (R-4612): the WGA's option terms, the CNC's 32 shooting days (2024, R-4613, shared with the director), the BFI's fee line, funding rate, award share and most, its ten months left on an option, the UK's credits, the EAO's financing shares, the BFI's release and recoupment rates by budget, the PGA's two features in seven years; the components and facets read (R-4609). No source gives how well a producer's eye reads a script, how far a script's need sits from the average or a plan from the need, how far a shoot slips where the team falters, how often the market closes a deal, how much a package, a record or a campaign moves a published rate, or who covers what the named sources leave: the game reckons those, balanced later at the owner's word, so that a producer at 100 throughout gets the top of what's real and lower levels correspondingly worse, and the player is told the reckoning is the game's own.

value.material: a script read a day, each worth 0 to 100 uniformly; the producer's judgement off by up to 100 points either side at 0 in choosing the material, none at 100; the one judged best optioned
value.need: a script's shooting days the CNC's 32 within 25% either side
value.plan: the plan's days off the need by up to 30% either side at 0, none at 100 (detailed plan 50%, production costs 50%)
value.directCosts: the BFI's 7 to 8% read as 7.5%, of a budget taken as direct costs plus the fee alone
value.coreSpend: all of a budget counted as UK core spend for the credit
value.bfiAward: the 22% average award share held as every award's, up to the Impact fund's £1.25m; no debut rate, no Discovery band
value.pitch: 30% the pitch, 20% arranging finance, 10% the financing strategy, 20% the network, 10% communication, 10% negotiation
value.factor: 0.5 + (half the material, half the pitch)/100, plus 0.1 for each film released in cinemas in the PGA's seven years, up to its two: 0.5 to 1.7, multiplying the BFI's 13% and the market's daily chance
value.market: a chance a day of closing the next source, 1 in 30 times the factor; broadcasters and pre-sales at the EAO's 18% and 14% of budget, equity closing the rest; the producer's own investment the EAO's 18%, carried last, the project financed when the rest is closed
value.shoot: the needed days slipping by up to 50% at 0 (team: crew and lead equally; crew 40% hiring, 20% each coordination, time, detail; lead 40% leading the team, 20% each stress, problems, change), none at 100; the days past the schedule at the budget over the scheduled days; the overrun taken from the producer's fee first
value.quality: the film half the material, half the team, within the screenwriter's spread (3 at 100, 18 at 0)
value.release: the BFI's rate for the budget times 0.5 + (half the film, half the campaign: 70% marketing plans, 30% communications and media)/100; recoupment the same factor on the BFI's rate for those released
value.practice: option the days read (Development); plan one day (Production, Financing); the BFI one day (Development, Financing, Dealmaking); raising its days (Financing, Dealmaking); the shoot its days (Production, Leadership); the release one day (Marketing)
value.zone: the option's months counted in Europe/London

sources.title: Interagency Language Roundtable Language Skill Level Descriptions - Speaking
sources.said: Speaking 0 (No Proficiency) Unable to function in the spoken language. … Speaking 1 (Elementary Proficiency) Able to satisfy minimum courtesy requirements and maintain very simple face-to-face conversations on familiar topics. … Speaking 2 (Limited Working Proficiency) Able to satisfy routine social demands and limited work requirements. … Speaking 3 (General Professional Proficiency) Able to speak the language with sufficient structural accuracy and vocabulary to participate effectively in most formal and informal conversations in practical, social and professional topics. … Speaking 4 (Advanced Professional Proficiency) Able to use the language fluently and accurately on all levels normally pertinent to professional needs. … Speaking 5 (Functionally Native Proficiency) Speaking proficiency is functionally equivalent to that of a highly articulate well-educated native speaker and reflects the cultural standards of the country where the language is natively spoken. … The "plus level" designation (coded 06, 16, 26, etc.) will be assigned when proficiency substantially exceeds one base skill level and does not fully meet the criteria for the next "base level."

sources.title: USC Annenberg Inclusion Initiative, Inequality in 1,800 Popular Films (2025)
sources.said: Gender. 4,401 speaking or named characters were coded across the 100 top-grossing movies of 2024. Of these characters, 66.2% were male, 33.6% were female, and <1% (.18) were non-binary. … The percentage of films with a female protagonist (lead/co lead) was at a historic high in 2024 (55%). … In terms of speaking characters’ age, gender balance was observed in 2024 with 0-to 12-year-olds (males=54.9%, females=45.1%) and 13- to 20-year-olds (females=54.6%, males=44.8%). Turning to 21- to 39-year-olds, women only accounted for 37.6% of all speaking roles. The results were even more problematic for women 40 years of age or older. Here, women only accounted for 23.8% of older characters. … Total 76% 24% … Of the 3,803 speaking or named characters that were coded for apparent race/ethnicity, 63.6% were white, 13.2% Black, 3.1% Hispanic/Latino, <1% American Indian/Alaskan Native, 13.5% Asian, <1% Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, 1.3% Middle Eastern/North African (MENA), and 4% multiracial/multiethnic. … Only 25% of all leads/co leads were from underrepresented backgrounds in 2024.

sources.title: Center for the Study of Women in Television and Film (San Diego State University), It's a Man's (Celluloid) World 2025
sources.said: The percentage of female characters in speaking roles increased slightly to 38% in 2025, up 1 percentage point from 37% in 2024. The percentage of major female characters declined 3 percentage points, from 39% in 2024 to 36% in 2025. … The percentage of major female characters dropped precipitously from 32% in their 30s to 15% in their 40s. In stark contrast, the percentage of major male characters increased as they aged from their 30s (22%) to their 40s (29%). Just 28% of major female characters were 40 and older, whereas 59% of males were 40+. … accounting for just 2% of all major female characters. Men aged 60 and older comprised 8% of all major male characters.

sources.title: Center for the Study of Women in Television and Film (SDSU), Boxed In 2025-26

Males comprised 56% (55.7%), and transgender characters less than one half of 1% (0.1%) of speaking characters … In 2025-26, females comprised 46% (46.3%) of all speaking characters appearing on broadcast network programs. … In 2025-26, females accounted for 43% (43.0%) of all speaking characters on streaming programs. … On broadcast and streaming programs, 38% of females were in their 30s but 15% were in their 40s. In contrast, the percentage of male characters declined only slightly from their 30s (30%) to their 40s (28%).

sources.title: Stephen Follows, What percentage of Hollywood film professionals are nepo babies?, 10 Aug 2026
sources.said: Of the people I studied, roughly a quarter had a family member already in the film or TV industry before they joined. Top-billed actors lead on 28%. Directors are close behind on 26%. Writers come out lower, on 18% … 30% of top films have no nepo baby anywhere in their core team. 36% carry exactly one, 23% carry two, and 11% have three or more. … Connected directors get their first film made younger (a median age of 33 against 35), and those who eventually reached the top 100 climbed faster (a median of 8 years from first feature against 10). Most of all, they get more chances. 72% went on to a second feature against 66% of everyone else, and their median career is three features against two. … Films directed by industry-family directors have a median adjusted domestic gross of $84m, compared with $87m for films directed by everyone else.

value.suggestionThresholdRule: a language is suggested where at least 10% of the people of the place one grew up or was born speak it (share >= 10), where one grew up first
value.playingAgeYoungRule: under 18 the playing age is the age one year either way (Spotlight's example, 9-11 at ten, taken as the rule for every age under 18; 18 is the game's line), and never below 0
value.headshotSessionPriceRule: every US session is priced at Thumbtack's average ($304) as the session's own price; no other country has a price (null)
value.birthDateToday: the latest birth date taken is today's date in Kiribati's Line Islands (UTC+14), the latest anywhere, so no one born today anywhere is refused

entries.sought: Who a casting breakdown is written for in every market (gender, ethnicity, age range, language) and who may be seen for it; the share of breakdowns by age within each gender; the language level a part asks.
entries.why: R-4620 gives breakdown shares by gender and ethnicity only for US television (Sowa, 2017), the age of major characters only for top US films (2025), and no count of breakdowns by language or by age within gender (blocker parts-by-language-and-accent); no source says what language level a part asks, or how a breakdown's gender is read against a performer's sex and billing.

value.breakdown shares outside US television: the 2017 SAG-AFTRA television shares (gender and ethnicity) are applied to every agreement: Pact/Equity, UK Theatre and ACTRA as well as SAG-AFTRA film
value.ethnicity shares as weights: the published shares sum to 105.7; each is drawn in proportion (open 33.9/105.7 ...)
value.under-30 split: a child's part one tenth, a teenager's one tenth, an adult's under 30 eight tenths of the under-30 share
value.under-30 share: 100 less the 30s and 40-or-older shares of 2025's major film characters: women 40, men 19
value.film ages applied to breakdowns: 2025's major film characters' ages are used for every breakdown, film, television and stage
value.open or non-binary part's ages: men's and women's band weights averaged
value.gender fit: a part written for men is an actor's and one for women an actress's, as Billed As reads (the owner, 2026-11-01: "Actor (Male) Actress (Female) and for They/Them it could be either or"); an open part is anyone's
value.non-binary part: open to a person whose pronouns are they/them
value.market language: English for Pact/Equity, UK Theatre and ACTRA (the US's English is sourced)
value.market zone for the age: SAG-AFTRA America/Los_Angeles, Pact/Equity and UK Theatre Europe/London, ACTRA America/Toronto
value.language level: C1 or better in the part's language
value.one audition per breakdown: a breakdown answered once is not auditioned for again
value.headshot: every submission, taped or for the room, goes out under a headshot (the platforms' rule, R-4622, read for both)
value.work and the union at the shoot: acting.perform refuses a part in a country none of the person's citizenships may work in without a permit (papers.work; agreements' countries: SAG-AFTRA US, Pact/Equity and UK Theatre GB, ACTRA CA), and a SAG-AFTRA part from the thirtieth day after the first to a non-member (Taft-Hartley, union security)

entries.sought: How the life's own work, as the engines record it, meets each union's joining route, where R-4621 gives the rule but not its reading against a part, a sale or a film.
entries.why: The unions publish their routes in their own terms (a principal day, a qualifying permit, units, bona fide employment by a signatory); the engines record parts, sales and films. Each reading below maps one to the other, the game's own, so the player is told.

value.sag_aftra_counting_budget_reading: Ultra Low Budget and below (the acting engine's SAG_TIERS.ultra, $300,000, and its Micro-Budget tier) are read as the 'Ultra Low Budget, Student, or Short Films' that don't count; every part the acting engine records is a principal (it has no background work).
value.sag_aftra_sister_route: ACTRA only: a Full ACTRA card held a year (to the same date the next year) and a part played under ACTRA. AEA as SAG-AFTRA's sister is reachable only through SAG-AFTRA itself; AGMA and AGVA aren't built.
value.taft_hartley_first_job: the first part played under the SAG-AFTRA agreement (its work.at); membership required from 30 x 86,400 seconds after it.
value.equity_uk_earnings: every pay the engines record (a part's minimum, a script's fee, a film's DGA minimum), each in pounds as papers' rates estimate it on the day paid; a pay in pounds is taken as it is; one in a currency without a rate that day isn't counted.
value.equity_uk_band_income: the mean of the pay recorded in the three UK tax years (6 April to 5 April) before the one joined in; a band runs up to and including its ceiling (£40,000, £80,000, £120,000, £240,000).
value.equity_uk_subsidised_ages: 10 to 17 and 66 on, by age on the day in Europe/London, with that mean under £40,000; graduation isn't held.
value.actra_permits: each part played under the ACTRA agreement is one qualifying permit; Apprentice from 1, Full from 3; the Apprentice's $75 recorded as its initiation, no yearly dues named.
value.caea_experience_reading: three years' paid professional experience is read as a part played, under any agreement, on or before the same date three years earlier.
value.aea_sibling_route: a SAG-AFTRA card held a year and a part played under SAG-AFTRA (any budget); the Equity-contract and Open Access routes need US stage parts, which the acting engine has none of.
value.wga_units_reading: a sale counts only where it paid the MBA minimum (a fee recorded), as a sale to a signatory; a feature as a feature-length screenplay (24); a pilot and an episode, an hour each, as a teleplay of 30 through 60 minutes (8; the WGA West's chart, R-4621); the story's units not added; a short, sold without an MBA minimum, earns none.
value.wga_window: a sale on or after the same date three years before the day of joining.
value.dga_route_and_fee: every film or episode the directing engine records is DGA-covered employment (it is held to the DGA's terms); the fee is the category of the latest one: $5,000 for a feature of $11,000,000 or less, $15,703 otherwise.
value.dga_fee_outside_its_year: the July 2026 - June 2027 table is used for any date until the next is read.
value.dues_recorded: the yearly base: SAG-AFTRA $246.14, ACTRA $195, CAEA $200 ($212 from 2028-05-01), AEA $176, WGA $25 x 4 = $100, DGA $50 x 4 = $200; Equity UK its band.

entries.why: No source says what loving a genre does, nor places the game's 149 genres in the BFI's 18 primary genres or the spec trackers' 13, nor counts the spec scripts written by genre; the game reads them.

value.lovedGenres: the genres one loves are the genres one's work is in: script.write and producing.option refuse any other (the game's reading of the Genres page)
value.boxOffice: a film's chance of earning twice its budget (producing.release, RECOUP x the campaign's factor) is multiplied by its BFI group's gross per release over all films' (2023: £994.3m from 900 releases); the BFI's gross is for UK and Ireland, read as the producer's UK market
value.boxOfficeSmallSamples: a BFI group of fewer than 30 releases in the year counts as the average release (factor 1): Family's two releases gave 26.84 times the average, Fantasy's seven 5.33, Thriller's four 0.02; the threshold of 30 is the game's

entries.sought: How a family in the business moves a debut director's chance of a second feature within five years, and what it gives a screenwriter getting read, from Follows (10 Aug 2026) and Gorji, Carney and Prakash (2020), R-4622.
entries.why: Follows's 72% against 66% is measured on 1,804 directors whose debut since 2000 has at least 10,000 IMDb ratings, with no time window ('a noticed first film'), so it can't stand as the game's chance, which is Follows's earlier 25.3% of all debuts within five years (45% where it found an audience; R-4613). The game keeps those rates and scales each by its side's rate over the directors' mean, weighted by Follows's own 26% of directors with family in film or TV ('Directors are close behind on 26%'), so the two sides average back to the sourced rate of all debuts; an unweighted mean would treat half of all directors as connected where Follows finds about a quarter. It scales the debut that found no audience as well as the one that did, on Follows's words: family ties 'buy you another roll of the dice when a film disappoints'. Gorji et al. give no figure (abstract only, full text paywalled): one contact from the first day is the game's reading of 'third-party network sponsorship'. The contact's trade is not copied into the career slice: it is the family's, held once in Person.family (CLAUDE.md, no second copy of a fact), and a screen naming the contact reads it there through inTheBusiness.

value.scaledCases: both the debut that found no audience and the one that did
value.familyContactFrom: the first day: counted among the contacts every time a script is sent out
value.tradesInTheBusiness: acting, directing, writing, producing and music (identity's inTheBusiness) each start a writer with a contact; for a director's second feature only the trades in film or TV count (Follows's split), so a family in music is outside it

sources.title: Trend, Foreigners now able to get work permits in Azerbaijan even faster (20 November 2019); rests on the State Migration Service's Administrative Regulation on work permits and the Law on State Duty
sources.said: with reference to Azerbaijan’s State Migration Service. Now this permission can be obtained within 10 working days. … In accordance with the previous regulation, the state duty to obtain a work permit for paid labor activities of a foreigner and stateless person in Azerbaijan was set at 350 manat ($206.3) for a period of up to three months, 600 manat ($353.6) - up to six months, and 1,000 manat ($589.3) -up to one year. In accordance with the new regulation, depending on the size of the paid state duty, services will be provided within different periods. Thus, in order to obtain a work permit within 10 working days for a period of up to three months, it will be necessary to pay a state duty in the amount of 700 manat ($412.5), up to six months – 900 manat ($530.4), up to one year – 1,400 manat ($825.1). In order to get the specified permission within 15 working days, it is necessary to pay the state duty in the amount of 500 manat ($294.7), 700 manat ($412.5) and 1,200 manat ($707.3), respectively.

sources.title: Емине Иляз, Научно-образователен анализ на правния режим на достъпа до пазара на труда на граждани на трети държави (Стратегии на образователната и научната политика, 2024); rests on Закон за трудовата миграция и трудовата мобилност, чл. 15 (consolidated text on the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy's site) and Закон за чужденците в Република България, чл. 24и (official text not reachable: lex.bg 403, 2026-11-01)
sources.said: От 01.06.2021 г. разрешението за работа се издава от Министерството на вътрешните работи МВР съгласно чл. 24и от ЗЧРБ, като АЗ дава единствено писмено становище по заявлението във връзка с изискванията на ЗТМТМ и ППЗТМТМ. След положителното становище на АЗ Дирекция „Миграция“ към МВР издава и самото разрешение за работа. То се издава на граждани на трети държави, които кандидатстват за разрешение за пребиваване с цел работа. Единно разрешение за пребиваване и работа се издава за срок от 3 години или за срока на трудовия договор, с който ще бъде нает гражданинът на трета държава, ако същият е по-кратък.

sources.title: Закон за трудовата миграция и трудовата мобилност (consolidated to ДВ бр. 52 от 27.06.2025), on the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy's site
sources.said: Чл. 15. (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 21 от 2021 г., в сила от 01.06.2021 г.) (1) Достъп до пазара на труда с Единно разрешение за пребиваване и работа се разрешава от Министерството на вътрешните работи след получено положително писмено становище от изпълнителния директор на Агенцията по заетостта. (2) В случаите по ал. 1 условието по чл. 7, ал. 1, т. 1 не се прилага за работа на: … 3. артисти-изпълнители по смисъла на чл. 74 от Закона за авторското право и сродните му права с доказана професионална компетентност - след потвърден от Министерството на културата интерес от наемането им; … 2. предлаганите условия на труд и заплащане не са по-неблагоприятни от условията за българските граждани за съответната категория труд;

sources.title: Service Public (DILA), Carte talent : carte de séjour pluriannuelle d'un étranger en France — Profession artistique et culturelle (vérifié le 1er juin 2026)
sources.said: Dans le cadre de votre activité salariée, votre employeur n'a pas à demander d'autorisation de travail et est exonéré du paiement de la taxe pour l’emploi d’un ressortissant étranger. … Vous pouvez obtenir une carte de séjour «talent-profession artistique et culturelle» si vous êtes artiste-interprète ou auteur d'œuvre littéraire ou artistique et si vous remplissez les conditions suivantes : Justifier de ressources au moins égales à 70 % du SMIC brut à temps plein par mois de séjour en France, soit 1 306,91 € dont au moins 51 % provenant de votre activité d'artiste-interprète ou d'auteur d'une œuvre littéraire ou artistique Si vous exercez une activité salariée : justifier d’1 ou plusieurs contrats de travail pour une durée totale cumulée de 3 mois ou plus sur une période de 12 mois, conclus avec 1 ou plusieurs entreprises ou établissements dont l’activité principale est la création ou l’exploitation d’œuvres de l’esprit. … Si la durée de votre séjour est inférieure à 12 mois , le consulat vous délivre un visa de long séjour valant titre de séjour portant la mention "talent". … Si la carte de séjour vous est attribuée, vous devez régler 350 € (droit de timbre de 50 € + taxe de 300 € ) par timbres fiscaux . … La carte est valable pour une durée identique à celle du contrat de travail dans la limite d'une durée maximale de 4 ans. … Vous devez déposer votre demande de titre de séjour sur internet au plus tôt 4 mois et au plus tard 2 mois avant la fin de validité de votre document de séjour si vous êtes titulaire d’un visa long séjour valant titre de séjour (VLS-TS) ou d’un titre de séjour … Si la préfecture n'a pas répondu au bout de 4 mois , il s'agit d'un refus implicite.

entries.sought: The work permit a foreign performer needs in Brazil: who applies, its fees, processing, term, union consultation, eligibility, pay and exemption

sources.title: Lei nº 13.445, de 24 de maio de 2017 (Lei de Migração), publicação original (Câmara dos Deputados), arts. 13–14
sources.said: IV - atividades artísticas ou desportivas; e V - outras hipóteses definidas em regulamento. § 1º É vedado ao beneficiário de visto de visita exercer atividade remunerada no Brasil. § 2º O beneficiário de visto de visita poderá receber pagamento do governo, de empregador brasileiro ou de entidade privada a título de diária, ajuda de custo, cachê, pró-labore ou outras despesas com a viagem, … j) atividades artísticas ou desportivas com contrato por prazo determinado;

sources.title: Decreto n.º 9.199, de 20 de novembro de 2017 (regulamenta a Lei de Migração), publicação original, Câmara dos Deputados Legislação Informatizada
sources.said: Art. 46. O visto temporário para atividades artísticas ou desportivas poderá ser concedido ao imigrante que venha ao País para participar de exposições, espetáculos, apresentações artísticas, encontros de artistas, competições desportivas e outras atividades congêneres, com intenção de permanecer no País por período superior a noventa dias, com contrato por prazo determinado, sem vínculo empregatício com pessoa física ou jurídica sediada no País. … § 5º Para fins da concessão do visto de que trata o caput , será solicitada, junto ao Ministério do Trabalho, autorização de residência prévia à emissão do visto, ressalvadas as hipóteses definidas em resolução do Conselho Nacional de Imigração. § 6º A concessão da autorização de residência de que trata o § 5º não implicará a emissão automática do visto temporário de que trata o caput . … Art. 16. O visto temporário poderá ser concedido com prazo de validade de até um ano, e, exceto se houver determinação em contrário do Ministério das Relações Exteriores, permitirá múltiplas entradas no País enquanto o visto estiver válido. Parágrafo único. O prazo de validade do visto temporário não se confunde com o prazo da autorização de residência. … Art. 22. O prazo inicial de estada dos portadores de vistos temporários, diplomáticos, oficiais e de cortesia será igual ao seu prazo de validade. … § 5º O visto de visita emitido para atividades artísticas e desportivas não dispensará o seu portador da obtenção de autorização e do registro junto ao Ministério do Trabalho para realização de atividades artísticas.

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department, Short Term Work Permit
sources.said: Any non-Bahamian who desires to work in The Bahamas for a period ranging from 1 to 90 days must apply to the Department of Immigration for a Short Term Work Permit . The application should be submitted before the prospective employee arrives in The Bahamas. Short-term work permits are meant for emergencies only and should be a one-time application . … For a period of one (1) to thirty (30) days duration: $200.00 non-refundable processing fee … Letter of request addressed to the Director of Immigration … Copy of VALID business license , Certificate of Incumbency, or Certificate of Incorporation of Employer Copy of Employee/Employer’s NIB Card /Certificate … Entertainers must have a letter of authorization from The Bahamas Musician & Entertainers Union or United Artists Bahamas Union

sources.said: Effective Wednesday, 31st December 2025 , all short-term work permit applications for entertainers must be submitted at least thirty (30) days prior to the intended start date.

sources.said: Им утверждены регламенты админпроцедур по получению и однократному продлению срока действия спецразрешения на право занятия трудовой деятельностью в Республике Беларусь. … для получения спецразрешения наниматель Республики Беларусь должен представить в подразделение по гражданству и миграции … (госпошлина в размере 5 базовых величин). … Для этого последнее обращается в органы соцзащиты по местонахождению свободного рабочего места (вакансии) с соответствующим запросом … Как и ранее, сроки действия специального разрешения составляют … — 2 года — в отношении высококвалифицированных работников ; — 1 год — в отношении иных работников.

sources.title: Justice Laws, IRPR s. 299 (current to 2026-09-30)
sources.said: A fee of $155 is payable for processing an application for a work permit. … If three or more persons who are part of the same group of performing artists and those artists’ staff make their applications for a work permit at the same time, the total amount of fees payable under subsection (1) is $465 for all applications together.

sources.title: Justice Laws, IRPR s. 315.2 (current to 2026-09-30)
sources.said: A fee of $1,000 is payable for the provision of services in relation to an assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development that is requested by an employer or group of employers under subsection 203(2) for each offer of employment in respect of which the request is made.

sources.title: Justice Laws, IRPR s. 303.1 (current to 2026-09-30)
sources.said: A fee of $230 is payable by an employer who has made an offer of employment to … The total amount of fees payable under subsection (1) by an employer who has made offers of employment to a group of three or more foreign nationals, consisting of performing artists and their staff, is $690, if those offers are made at the same time.

sources.title: Justice Laws, IRPR s. 205 (current to 2026-09-30)
sources.said: would create or maintain significant social, cultural or economic benefits or opportunities for Canadian citizens or permanent residents;

sources.title: Justice Laws, IRPR s. 203 (current to 2026-09-30)
sources.said: the wages set out in the offer of employment are not consistent with the prevailing wage rate for the occupation; or

sources.title: Justice Laws, IRPR s. 186 (current to 2026-09-30)
sources.said: as a performing artist appearing alone or in a group in an artistic performance — other than a performance that is primarily for a film production or a television or radio broadcast —

sources.title: IRCC Help Centre, How long can I work in Canada as a temporary worker?
sources.said: There is no set maximum amount of time you can work in Canada as a temporary worker. The length of time you can work depends on: the job offer from your employer the length of time listed on your Labour Market Impact Assessment, if your employer needed to get one to hire you how long your passport is valid for

sources.title: IRCC Help Centre, How long will it take to process my work permit application?
sources.said: Processing times vary, depending on the type of application you submit. Information on processing times is available online for applications submitted inside and outside of Canada. This information is updated frequently, so check often.

sources.said: Tout employeur qui se propose d’engager un travailleur expatrié doit au préalable déposer l’offre d’emploi à l’Office National de l’Emploi « ONEM » ; L’employeur devra également déposer les dossiers du candidat expatrié à la Commission Nationale de l’Emploi des Etrangers en vue de permettre à ladite Commission de statuer sur la demande d’engagement et le renouvellement des cartes de travail pour étrangers. … Le taux ainsi que les modalités de la perception de cette taxe sont fixés par arrêté interministériel n°013/95 du 31/01/1995. … Equivalent de 700 $ au taux du jour (Entreprises de construction, Production de l’Energie, Production et constructions Métallurgiques, Industries Manufacturières, Transport et Communication, Entreprises de Service) ; … Equivalent de 200 $ (Frais de dépôt des dossiers) : Frais de fonctionnement de la Commission Nationale de l’Emploi des Etrangers.

entries.sought: The work permit a foreign performer needs in Central African Republic: who applies, its fees, processing, term, union consultation, eligibility, pay and exemption

sources.title: Loi n° 09.004 portant Code du travail de la République Centrafricaine, Journal officiel de la République Centrafricaine, édition spéciale du 7 septembre 2010 (FAOLEX copy)
sources.said: Art.100 : Les travailleurs non centrafricains doivent être titulaires d’un contrat de travail ou d’une lettre d’embauche visée par le Ministre en charge de l’Emploi sur un formulaire établi à cet effet. … La réglementation des conditions de recrutement et des frais d’établissement du formulaire de visa du contrat de travail des personnes non centrafricaines est établie par arrêté du Ministre en charge de l’Emploi. … La demande de visa incombe à l’employeur. Si le visa n’est pas accordé, le contrat est nul de plein droit. … L’autorité compétente pour accorder le visa doit faire connaître sa décision dans les trente (30) jours qui suivent la réception du contrat. … Art.98 : Le salaire convenu ne doit, en aucun cas, être inférieur au salaire minimum conventionnel de la classification. … Art.101 : L’employeur qui recrute un étranger, de même que le travailleur expatrié lui-même, ont l’obligation de respecter la réglementation sur les conditions d’admission et de séjour d’étrangers en République Centrafricaine.

sources.title: Newland Chase, Congo (Brazzaville) Immigration Services
sources.said: A Work Permit … issued initially for two years and renewable, is the standard immigration process for foreign nationals working in Congo Brazzaville. Note that in all cases, an employment contract is needed with the local entity, and must be approved and registered with ACPE (Agence Congolaise pour l'Emploi ). A Temporary Employment Authorisation (l'autorisation de travail temporaire) is issued to applicants intending to work in Congo Brazzaville for up to six months and is non-renewable.

sources.title: Kanton Zürich, Migrationsamt, Weisung «Künstler» (15. Februar 2022), following the SEM's directives
sources.said: besteht die Möglichkeit, ohne Kontingentierung im Rahmen von Engagements bis zu 8 Monaten innerhalb von 12 Monaten in der Schweiz erwerbstätig zu sein. … Für die Erwerbstätigkeit mit Stellenantritt gilt die Bewilligungspflicht ab dem ersten Tag. … Die Agentur oder der Arbeitgeber haben dem Migrationsamt spätestens sechs Wo- chen vor Einreise des Künstlers das im Original unterzeichnete und mit Stempel ver- sehene Aufenthaltsgesuch (Formular A7/M8//K9) zusammen mit einem von allen Parteien unterzeichneten Original-Arbeitsvertrag einzureichen … Die Aufenthaltsdauer beträgt insgesamt höchstens 8 Monate innerhalb von 12 Mona- ten … Bewilligungen an Künstler können nur erteilt werden, wenn weder auf dem inländi- schen Arbeitsmarkt (Ausländer mit einer Aufenthalts- oder Niederlassungsbewilli- gung und Schweizer) noch aus EU/EFTA-Staaten geeignete Personen zur Verfü- gung stehen (Inländervorrang). Der Lohn- und die Arbeitsbedingungen müssen orts- und branchenüblich … Es können nur fachlich sehr gut qualifizierte Musikerinnen und Musiker sowie Künst- lerinnen und Künstler oder solche mit einem nachgewiesenen Bekanntheitsgrad im In- oder Ausland zugelassen werden. … Bei der Mindest-Tagesgage wird der Richtlinientarif, welcher vom Schweizerischen Musikerverband (SMV) und dem Verband Schweizerischer Konzertlokale, Cabarets, Dancings und Discotheken (ASCO) ausgearbeitet wurde, angewendet … Eine Bewilligung ist erforderlich, wenn eine sol- che Tätigkeit während mehr als acht Tagen innerhalb eines Kalenderjahres ausgeübt

sources.title: Verordnung über die Gebühren zum Ausländer- und Integrationsgesetz (GebV-AIG, SR 142.209), Stand am 11. Juni 2024, Fedlex filestore
sources.said: 1 Die kantonalen Höchstgebühren im Zusammenhang mit ausländerrechtlichen Bewilligungen betragen: Fr. a. für die Ermächtigung zur Visumerteilung oder für die Zusicherung einer Bewilligung 95 b. für die Erteilung oder Erneuerung einer Kurzaufenthalts‑, Aufenthalts- oder Grenzgängerbewilligung 95 … Art. 9 Gebührenfestlegung durch die Kantone Die Kantone können für andere nicht in Artikel 8 vorgesehene ausländerrechtliche Verfügungen und Dienstleistungen sowie für die in der Verordnung vom 24. Oktober 2007 12 über Zulassung, Aufenthalt und Erwerbstätigkeit vorgesehenen arbeitsmarktlichen Verfügungen die Gebühren festlegen.

sources.title: Décret n° 2026-197 du 15 avril 2026 relatif au contrat de travail (text as given by loidici.biz); rests on Décret n° 2026-197 du 15 avril 2026 relatif au contrat de travail, Journal officiel de la République de Côte d'Ivoire (no official text online found; the Ministry of Employment's home page given)
sources.said: ARTICLE 8 Sauf disposition contraire expressément prévue par les conventions et les engagements internationaux souscrits par la Côte d’Ivoire, notamment ceux régissant la CEDEAO et I’UEMOA, tout travailleur d’une autre nationalité doit être titulaire d’un contrat de travail ou d’une lettre d’embauche soumis au visa préalable du Ministre chargé du Travail, sur un formulaire établi à cet effet. Le visa doit être délivré dans un délai maximum de huit (08) jours suivant le dépôt du formulaire. L’employeur s’acquitte des frais d’établissement du formulaire de visa dont le montant est fixé par arrêté interministériel du Ministre chargé du Travail et du Ministre chargé des Finances. ARTICLE 9 Lorsqu’au terme du délai mentionné au précédent article, le Ministre n’a pas fait connaître sa décision, le visa est réputé refusé. ARTICLE 10 Sauf clauses particulières mentionnées dans son contrat, le travailleur d’une autre nationalité bénéficie de l’égalité de traitement avec les travailleurs nationaux, occupant le même emploi ou ayant la même qualification que l’intéressé.

sources.title: Proimágenes Colombia, Comisión Fílmica Colombiana, Instructivo ingreso extranjeros: solicitud visas, certificación de obra audiovisual (FC-IN-1 v5, 9 February 2026); rests on Resolución 5477 de 2022, art. 61
sources.said: Cuando el personal extranjero ingresa a Colombia por un período inferior a noventa (90) días, no se requiere visa. No obstante, es obligatorio tramitar el Permiso para Otras Actividades (POA) a través del formulario de Migración Colombia, seleccionando la opción “Conciertos, eventos o actividades artísticas”. Es importante tener en cuenta que este trámite solo puede ser realizado por empresas colombianas y debe gestionarse de manera individual para cada extranjero que lo requiera. … La solicitud del permiso debe radicarse con una anticipación mínima de cinco (5) días hábiles a la llegada del extranjero al territorio colombiano. … Si hay un vínculo laboral entre una empresa colombiana y el extranjero que ingresa al país. En este caso deberá tramitar una visa de trabajo directamente con la Cancillería. … El valor será de 1 SMMLV por solicitud.

sources.title: Reglamento de Extranjería (Decreto Ejecutivo 37112-G), Tribunal Supremo de Elecciones copy, art. 129
sources.said: Artículo 129.- La Dirección General mediante la Gestión de Extranjería otorgará autorización de categoría especial para Artistas, deportistas e integrantes de espectáculos públicos, profesionales y técnicos destacados o personas invitadas para que realicen actividades de importancia para el país, por un periodo de un año prorrogable … Comprobante de pago a favor del Gobierno por concepto de especies fiscales (¢ 125 + ¢ 2,50 por cada folio) … Carta del Ministerio de Cultura y Juventud o de la UNAFUT, o de quien este delegue para estos efectos, tratándose de artistas, deportistas e integrantes de espectáculos públicos … En caso de espectáculos públicos, deberá aportar las autorizaciones expedidas por la Oficina de Espectáculos Públicos del Ministerio de Justicia y Paz y por la Fiscalía de Espectáculos Públicos del Teatro Nacional … Original y copia o copia certificada del contrato suscrito entre los artistas, deportistas o integrantes de espectáculos públicos y el responsable del evento. … Artículo 27.- Una vez que la persona extranjera cumpla con todos los requisitos de conformidad con la categoría migratoria pretendida, la Dirección General por medio de la Gestión de Extranjería, resolverá la solicitud en un periodo máximo de tres meses.

sources.said: Artigo 34º. Visto temporário 1. O visto temporário destina-se a permitir a entrada em Cabo Verde ao estrangeiro para: … c) Exercício de uma actividade profissional, subor- dinada ou independente, cuja duração não ul- trapasse um ano, em especial como artista ou desportista, técnico, professor ou actividade qualificada de outra categoria, sob regime de contrato ao serviço do Estado de Cabo Verde ou de outras entidades públicas ou privadas; … 3. O visto ordinário é válido para uma entrada no ter- ritório nacional e habilita o seu titular a nele permanecer por um período de cento e oitenta dias ou o correspon- dente à duração prevista da estadia. … 5. sources.said: Die Zustimmung kann mit Vorrangprüfung für Personen erteilt werden, die 1. eine künstlerische oder artistische Beschäftigung oder eine Beschäftigung als Hilfspersonal, das für die Darbietung erforderlich ist, ausüben oder 2. zu einer länger als 90 Tage dauernden Beschäftigung im Rahmen von Gastspielen oder ausländischen Film- oder Fernsehproduktionen entsandt werden.

sources.title: Gesetze im Internet, § 22 BeschV Besondere Berufsgruppen
sources.said: Personen, die im Rahmen von Festspielen oder Musik- und Kulturtagen beschäftigt oder im Rahmen von Gastspielen oder ausländischen Film- und Fernsehproduktionen entsandt werden, wenn die Dauer der Tätigkeit 90 Tage innerhalb eines Zeitraums von zwölf Monaten nicht übersteigt, 3. Personen, die in Tagesdarbietungen bis zu 15 Tage im Jahr auftreten,

sources.title: Gesetze im Internet, § 36 BeschV Erteilung der Zustimmung
sources.said: Die Zustimmung zur Ausübung einer Beschäftigung gilt als erteilt, wenn die Bundesagentur für Arbeit der zuständigen Stelle nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Übermittlung der Zustimmungsanfrage mitteilt, dass die übermittelten Informationen für die Entscheidung über die Zustimmung nicht ausreichen oder dass der Arbeitgeber die erforderlichen Auskünfte nicht oder nicht rechtzeitig erteilt hat.

sources.title: Gesetze im Internet, § 39 AufenthG Zustimmung zur Beschäftigung
sources.said: Die Bundesagentur für Arbeit kann der Ausübung einer Beschäftigung durch einen Ausländer unabhängig von einer Qualifikation als Fachkraft zustimmen, wenn 1. der Ausländer nicht zu ungünstigeren Arbeitsbedingungen als vergleichbare inländische Arbeitnehmer beschäftigt wird,

sources.title: Gesetze im Internet, § 19c AufenthG Sonstige Beschäftigungszwecke
sources.said: Einem Ausländer kann unabhängig von einer Qualifikation als Fachkraft eine Aufenthaltserlaubnis zur Ausübung einer Beschäftigung erteilt werden, wenn die Beschäftigungsverordnung oder eine zwischenstaatliche Vereinbarung bestimmt, dass der Ausländer zur Ausübung dieser Beschäftigung zugelassen werden kann.

sources.title: Gesetze im Internet, § 18 AufenthG Grundsatz der Fachkräfteeinwanderung
sources.said: Aufenthaltstitel gemäß den §§ 18a, 18b, 18g und 19c werden für die Dauer von vier Jahren oder, wenn das Arbeitsverhältnis oder die Zustimmung der Bundesagentur für Arbeit auf einen kürzeren Zeitraum befristet sind, für diesen kürzeren Zeitraum zuzüglich sechs Monate, nicht jedoch für länger als vier Jahre, erteilt.

entries.sought: The work permit a foreign performer needs in Denmark: who applies, its fees, processing, term, union consultation, eligibility, pay and exemption

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), Special individual qualifications – artist and performers (last updated 2 September 2026)
sources.said: If you have been offered work as a creative or performing artist, you can apply for a residence and work permit in Denmark. Normal processing time 2 months If further information is needed, the processing time can be up to 3 months Processing fee DKK 6,810,- … It is a condition that you have special individual qualifications that mean that others cannot immediately take on the artistic work offered. … It is a condition that your job offer is with a company that performs artistic work. This could be in an orchestra, an opera house, a theatre, a circus or a ballet company. … Your salary and terms of employment must correspond to Danish standards. … If SIRI has any doubts on whether your terms of employment correspond to Danish standards, we can ask one of the Regional Employment Councils to assess your terms of employment. … You can be granted a residence and work permit that is valid for 1 year at a time during the first 2 years of your stay – however, the validity cannot exceed the length of your job contract. Hereafter, you can be granted a permit valid for a maximum of 2 years, and after 4 years, valid for a maximum of 3 years at a time. … If your employment contract is extended, you must apply for an extension of your residence and work permit. … Your employer must start by completing the first part of the application. … If you have granted your employer power of attorney to handle the application on your behalf, your employer must use the AR6 application. … You must have your biometric features recorded no later than 14 days after you have submitted your application.

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), New practice regarding the requirement of a work permit for artists, musicians, performers, etc. (27 October 2022)
sources.said: This means that the event in which the artist, musician etc. will be participating must now be short-term in order for the artist to be exempt from the requirement of a work permit. As a rule, the event must therefore last no longer than 14 days.

entries.sought: The work permit a foreign performer needs in Algeria: who applies, its fees, processing, term, union consultation, eligibility, pay and exemption

sources.title: Journal officiel de la République algérienne no. 28, 14 July 1981 (French translation), Loi no. 81-10 du 11 juillet 1981 relative aux conditions d'emploi des travailleurs étrangers, pp. 683-684 (transcribed from page images; no text layer)
sources.said: Une autorisation de travail temporaire est délivrée aux travailleurs étrangers appelés à exercer une activité salariée d'une durée inférieure ou égale à trois mois, sur demande motivée de l'organisme employeur après consultation des représentants des travailleurs. … Elle ne peut être renouvelée plus d'une fois dans l'année. … le poste de travail à occuper ne peut, en aucun cas, être pourvu par un travailleur national, que ce soit par voie de promotion interne ou par voie de recrutement externe, y compris la main-d'œuvre nationale émigrée, … Le dossier du permis de travail ne saurait être reçu par les services compétents du ministère du travail s'il n'est pas accompagné du rapport motivé de l'organisme employeur et assorti de l'avis des représentants des travailleurs. … Sont exclus de l'obligation de l'autorisation de travail temporaire prévue à l'article 8 ci-dessus, les travailleurs étrangers appelés, à titre exceptionnel, pour effectuer des travaux n'excédant pas quinze (15) jours et sans que le total cumulé des durées de présence n'excède trois (3) mois dans l'année. … La durée du permis de travail ne peut être supérieure à deux (2) ans. … La délivrance du permis de travail ou de l'autorisation de travail temporaire donne lieu à l'apposition d'un timbre fiscal à la charge du bénéficiaire. … Le travailleur étranger régi par la présente loi perçoit un salaire afférent à l'indice de poste auquel peut prétendre son homologue algérien de même niveau

sources.title: Journal officiel n° 40 (23 juillet 2015), Ordonnance n° 15-01 portant loi de finances complémentaire pour 2015, art. 30 (Code du timbre, art. 142 bis)
sources.said: La délivrance de l'autorisation de travail temporaire et du permis de travail, institués dans le cadre de la loi n° 81-10 du 11 juillet 1981 relative aux conditions d'emploi des travailleurs étrangers, sont assujettis, pour la durée de leur validité, au paiement à la recette des impôts, d'une taxe de 10.000 DA. … Une majoration de 50 % est applicable à ces différents tarifs en cas de renouvellement de ces titres … les travailleurs étrangers intervenant dans le cadre d’un détachement ou d’une mission de courte durée de trois (3) mois dans l’année au maximum).

sources.title: Journal officiel n° 56 (28 décembre 1982), Décret n° 82-510 du 25 décembre 1982 fixant les modalités d'attribution du permis de travail et de l'autorisation de travail temporaire aux travailleurs étrangers, pp. 1917-1919
sources.said: La notification de la suite réservée par les services de l'emploi compétents, à la demande prévue à l'article 8 ci-dessus, est faite à l'organisme employeur dans les quarante cinq (45) jours qui suivent le dépôt de cette demande. Passé ce délai, l'avis favorable des services de l'emploi est réputé acquis. … Le permis de travail est délivré conformément aux dispositions de l'article 6 ci-dessus, dans les quinze jours qui suivent l'avis favorable.

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board, Registration of short-term employment
sources.said: Submit the application to the Police and Border Guard Board through the self-service portal . What documents are required for the application of short term employment registration? copy of foreigners Passport compliant photo of a foreigner copy of employment contract or binding job offer proof of payment of the state fee, such as a payment order. … As a rule, short-term employment is registered, or registration is refused, within 15 working days from the day following the acceptance of the application for processing, or from the day the deficiencies in the application are remedied.

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board, State fee amounts: Registration of short-term employment (from 1 January 2025)
sources.said: State fees from the 1st of January 2025 At a service office (including by post or e-mail) At the self-service portal At a foreign representation Registration of short-term employment 140 € 130 € -

sources.title: Riigi Teataja, Aliens Act (English translation, in force from 1 January 2026), §§ 105–107
sources.said: An alien who has a legal basis for temporary stay in Estonia and whose employment has been registered with the Police and Border Guard Board before the employment commences, may take employment in Estonia for a short term. … the alien has would comply with the requisite qualifications, training, state of health, work experience and the necessary professional skills and knowledge to assume such position; … Short-term employment in Estonia is permitted for up to 365 days within 455 consecutive days unless otherwise provided for in this Act. … An employer is obliged to pay an alien whose short-term employment in Estonia has been registered a remuneration in the amount equal to at least the annual average gross monthly salary last published by Statistics Estonia. … employment in a performing arts institution as person engaged in creative activities for the purposes of the Performing Arts Institutions Act; … who has a legal basis for the stay in Estonia, whose employment is of temporary nature and whose term of employment does not exceed five days within the period of 30 days;

sources.title: BOE, Real Decreto 1155/2024, de 19 de noviembre, Reglamento de la Ley Orgánica 4/2000 (texto consolidado), arts. 72 a 77
sources.said: 4. La autorización inicial de residencia temporal y trabajo por cuenta ajena tendrá una duración igual a la de la actividad a desarrollar, con el máximo de un año … a) Que la situación nacional de empleo permita la contratación de la persona trabajadora extranjera en los términos previstos en el artículo 75 … b) Que el empleador presente un contrato de trabajo firmado por la persona trabajadora y por él mismo … c) Que las condiciones fijadas en el contrato de trabajo se ajusten a las establecidas por la normativa vigente y el convenio colectivo aplicable para la misma actividad, categoría profesional y localidad. … f) Que la persona trabajadora tenga la capacitación y, en su caso, la cualificación profesional legalmente exigida para el ejercicio de la profesión. … Artículo 77. Procedimiento. 1. El empleador, personalmente o a través de quien válidamente tenga atribuida la representación, deberá presentar la correspondiente solicitud de autorización inicial de residencia temporal y trabajo por cuenta ajena ante la oficina de extranjería de la provincia donde esté ubicado el centro de trabajo. … resolverá y notificará de forma motivada en el plazo máximo de tres meses … Transcurrido el plazo de tres meses sin haber obtenido respuesta, se entenderá que la solicitud ha sido desestimada. … Artículo 80. Renovación de las autorizaciones de residencia temporal y trabajo por cuenta ajena. 1. La renovación de las autorizaciones de residencia temporal y trabajo por cuenta ajena deberá solicitarse, en modelo oficial, durante los dos meses previos a la fecha de expiración de la vigencia de su autorización.

sources.said: A work permit is ordinarily valid for the length of the individual’s contract and is job and employer specific. To satisfy the Customs & Immigration Service that there are no ‘Falkland Islands Status holders’ or ‘Falkland Islands Permanent Residence Permit holders’ suitable and available to fill such vacancy. Be prepared and to signify sponsorship and responsibility for full repatriation costs of the individual

sources.title: Falkland Islands Customs & Immigration, Form 3: Application for Work Permit (September 2025)
sources.said: An application fee is payable. A fee will be charged for an extension of an existing permit. All applications should be submitted via email to permits@customs.gov.fk … We aim to process complete applications within eight working days.

sources.title: Falkland Islands Government, Customs and Immigration: FAQ & General Information
sources.said: Ordinarily no, in the first instance work permits must be applied for from outside of the Falklands. Visitors cannot apply for work permits from within the Falklands. However, where it is obvious that there are no permanent residents available to fill a vacancy, the Principal Immigration Officer may authorise a visitor to work under the authority of a “short term work permission”. Current rules only allow a visitor to work in the Islands for a maximum of three months in aggregate in any period of twelve months.

sources.title: Service Public (DILA), Carte talent : carte de séjour pluriannuelle d'un étranger en France — Profession artistique et culturelle (vérifié le 1er juin 2026)
sources.said: Dans le cadre de votre activité salariée, votre employeur n'a pas à demander d'autorisation de travail et est exonéré du paiement de la taxe pour l’emploi d’un ressortissant étranger. … Vous pouvez obtenir une carte de séjour «talent-profession artistique et culturelle» si vous êtes artiste-interprète ou auteur d'œuvre littéraire ou artistique et si vous remplissez les conditions suivantes : Justifier de ressources au moins égales à 70 % du SMIC brut à temps plein par mois de séjour en France, soit 1 306,91 € dont au moins 51 % provenant de votre activité d'artiste-interprète ou d'auteur d'une œuvre littéraire ou artistique Si vous exercez une activité salariée : justifier d’1 ou plusieurs contrats de travail pour une durée totale cumulée de 3 mois ou plus sur une période de 12 mois, conclus avec 1 ou plusieurs entreprises ou établissements dont l’activité principale est la création ou l’exploitation d’œuvres de l’esprit. … Si la durée de votre séjour est inférieure à 12 mois , le consulat vous délivre un visa de long séjour valant titre de séjour portant la mention "talent". … Si la carte de séjour vous est attribuée, vous devez régler 350 € (droit de timbre de 50 € + taxe de 300 € ) par timbres fiscaux . … La carte est valable pour une durée identique à celle du contrat de travail dans la limite d'une durée maximale de 4 ans. … Vous devez déposer votre demande de titre de séjour sur internet au plus tôt 4 mois et au plus tard 2 mois avant la fin de validité de votre document de séjour si vous êtes titulaire d’un visa long séjour valant titre de séjour (VLS-TS) ou d’un titre de séjour … Si la préfecture n'a pas répondu au bout de 4 mois , il s'agit d'un refus implicite.

sources.title: Code du travail de la République de Guinée, Loi L/2014/072/CNT, arts. 131.1-131.4 (FAOLEX copy)
sources.said: Lorsqu’un employeur envisage d’embaucher un travailleur étranger, en dehors de l’espace de la Communauté Economique des Etats de l’Afrique de l’Ouest (CEDEAO), il doit obtenir l’autorisation préalable du Service public d’emploi dans les conditions déterminées par arrêté du ministre en charge de l’Emploi. … La durée du Contrat de travail conclu avec un travailleur étranger ne peut dépasser quatre ans renouvellement compris. … Le visa est tacitement accordé lorsque le service public d’emploi pour viser le contrat n’a pas fait connaître son avis dans les trente jours suivant la date de dépôt de la demande. … La délivrance d’un visa de séjour pour un travailleur étranger est subordonnée à l’obtention préalable d’un permis de travail délivré par le service public d’emploi.

sources.title: Service-Public.fr, Carte talent : carte de séjour pluriannuelle d'un étranger en France (vérifié le 1er juin 2026)
sources.said: La carte de séjour « talent-profession artistique et culturelle » vous autorise à séjourner en France. Elle vous autorise à exercer une activité professionnelle salariée et/ou non salariée. Dans le cadre de votre activité salariée, votre employeur n'a pas à demander d'autorisation de travail et est exonéré du paiement de la taxe pour l’emploi d’un ressortissant étranger. … Vous pouvez obtenir une carte de séjour «talent-profession artistique et culturelle» si vous êtes artiste-interprète ou auteur d'œuvre littéraire ou artistique et si vous remplissez les conditions suivantes : Justifier de ressources au moins égales à 70 % du SMIC brut à temps plein par mois de séjour en France, soit 1 306,91 € dont au moins 51 % provenant de votre activité d'artiste-interprète ou d'auteur d'une œuvre littéraire ou artistique Si vous exercez une activité salariée : justifier d’1 ou plusieurs contrats de travail pour une durée totale cumulée de 3 mois ou plus sur une période de 12 mois, conclus avec 1 ou plusieurs entreprises ou établissements dont l’activité principale est la création ou l’exploitation d’œuvres de l’esprit. … Si la carte de séjour vous est attribuée, vous devez régler 350 € (droit de timbre de 50 € + taxe de 300 € ) par timbres fiscaux . … La carte est valable pour une durée identique à celle du contrat de travail dans la limite d'une durée maximale de 4 ans. … Vous devez déposer votre demande de titre de séjour sur internet au plus tôt 4 mois et au plus tard 2 mois avant la fin de validité de votre document de séjour

sources.title: Service-Public.fr (Entreprendre), Autorisation de travail d'un salarié étranger en France (vérifié le 18 juin 2026)
sources.said: Séjour en France pour une durée inférieure ou égale à 3 mois Les règles sont différentes selon le motif du court séjour : Manifestations sportives, culturelles, artistiques et scientifiques L'étranger peut travailler. L'employeur est dispensé de demander une autorisation de travail. … Production et diffusion cinématographiques, audiovisuelles, du spectacle et de l'édition phonographique, en tant qu'artiste ou personnel technique L'étranger peut travailler. L'employeur est dispensé de demander une autorisation de travail.

sources.title: Government of South Georgia & the South Sandwich Islands, Entry Control Ordinance: Permit Application
sources.said: Applications can be made by an individual, or multiple applications can be made on behalf of a number of persons by an authorised person such as travel agent, cruise ship operator or a family member. … Applications should be received and paid for at least 8 days prior to the 1st intended date of arrival (disembarkation) in the Territories. … A work permit is valid for 6 months. Both visitor and work permits can be extended, where justified, for a period of an additional 30 days for visitors and 6 months for a work permit, respectively. … Applications for permits for work only – Details of the contract or other arrangement under which the applicant proposes to work in the Territories … Work Permits – No charge for a 6-month permit.

sources.said: in the case of a permit for work, 12 months from the expected date of the permit holder first entering the Territories or the period required to perform the contract or other agreement under which the work is to be done, whichever is the shorter … in the case of a permit for work, by up to 6 months

sources.title: eCFR, 8 CFR 214.2(o) and (p), Special requirements for admission, extension, and maintenance of status (O and P classifications), current as read (saved from the eCFR renderer API for the same section)
sources.said: An O-1 or O-2 petition may only be filed by a United States employer, a United States agent, or a foreign employer through a United States agent. … Extraordinary ability in the field of arts means distinction. Distinction means a high level of achievement in the field of arts evidenced by a degree of skill and recognition substantially above that ordinarily encountered to the extent that a person described as prominent is renowned, leading, or well-known in the field of arts. … Extraordinary achievement with respect to motion picture and television productions, as commonly defined in the industry, means a very high level of accomplishment in the motion picture or television industry evidenced by a degree of skill and recognition significantly above that ordinarily encountered to the extent that the person is recognized as outstanding, notable, or leading in the motion picture or television field. … ( A ) Consultation with an appropriate U.S. peer group (which could include a person or persons with expertise in the field), labor and/or management organization regarding the nature of the work to be done and the alien's qualifications is mandatory before a petition for an O-1 or O-2 classification can be approved. … In the case of an alien of extraordinary achievement who will be working on a motion picture or television production, consultation shall be made with the appropriate union representing the alien's occupational peers and a management organization in the area of the alien's ability. … approved petition for an alien classified under section 101(a)(15)(O)(i) of the Act shall be valid for a period of time determined by the Director to be necessary to accomplish the event or activity, not to exceed 3 years. … An extension of stay may be authorized in increments of up to 1 year for an O-1 or O-2 beneficiary to continue or complete the same event or activity for which he or she was admitted

sources.title: Zakon.hr, Zakon o strancima (NN 133/20 ... 40/25, 55/26), consolidated; rests on Narodne novine 133/20 and amendments to 55/26
sources.said: Ministarstvo, putem policijske uprave odnosno policijske postaje, može izdati dozvolu za boravak i rad državljaninu treće zemlje koji ispunjava uvjete iz članka 59. ovoga Zakona, a na temelju pozitivnog mišljenja Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje … Prije podnošenja zahtjeva za izdavanje dozvole za boravak i rad poslodavac je dužan zatražiti provedbu testa tržišta rada kod Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, osim u slučajevima iz članka 97. stavka 7., članka 101. i članka 110. ovoga Zakona. … Bez provedbe testa tržišta rada iz članka 98. ovoga Zakona i bez mišljenja Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje iz članka 99. ovoga Zakona, a na zahtjev državljanina treće zemlje ili poslodavca, Ministarstvo, putem policijske uprave odnosno policijske postaje, može izdati dozvolu za boravak i rad: … 8. umjetnicima za rad u ustanovama u kulturi, … 29. umjetniku, autoru, tehničkom i ostalom nužnom osoblju koje sudjeluje na snimanju zahtjevnih audiovizualnih djela … Dozvola za boravak i rad izdaje se: – na vrijeme na koje je sklopljen ugovor o radu, a najdulje do tri godine ako se odobrava na temelju članka 97. ovoga Zakona ili se produljuje … Na temelju potvrde o prijavi rada do 90 dana u kalendarskoj godini mogu raditi sljedeći državljani trećih zemalja: … 9. umjetnici i tehničko osoblje za operne, baletne, kazališne, koncertne, likovne i druge kulturne priredbe odnosno autori i izvođači na području filmske i televizijske umjetnosti … Bez potvrde o prijavi rada mogu raditi državljani trećih zemalja koji su državljani država pristupnica Konvenciji o Organizaciji za ekonomsku suradnju i razvoj od 14. prosinca 1960.: – umjetnici i tehničko osoblje za operne, baletne, kazališne, koncertne, likovne, multimedijalne i druge kulturne priredbe odnosno autori i izvođači na području filmske i televizijske umjetnosti

sources.title: Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova (Croatia), Uputa za elektroničko podnošenje zahtjeva za dozvole za boravak i rad (2025)
sources.said: Policijska uprava odnosno policijska postaja će Vas u roku od 5 radnih dana od podnošenja zahtjeva za dozvole za boravak i rad obavijestiti, ako je potrebno nadopuniti zahtjev. … Naplata upravne pristojbe za izdavanje dozvole za boravak i rad - poslodavac će policijskoj upravi/postaji kod preuzimanja dozvole za boravak i rad dostaviti dokaz

sources.title: Direktorat Jenderal Imigrasi, C7 Visa Kunjungan Penampilan Seni dan Budaya
sources.said: Dengan visa C7, anda dapat melakukan kegiatan seni dan budaya di Indonesia seperti memperlihatkan, menampilkan, atau mempertunjukkan (perform) suatu karya yang berhubungan dengan seni dan budaya, termasuk seni teater dan sirkus . … izin tinggal maksimal 30 hari, dihitung sejak tanggal kedatangan. Izin Tinggal ini tidak dapat diperpanjang ataupun dialihkan menjadi Izin Tinggal lainnya. … Masa tinggal 30hari : Rp. 1.500.000 Biaya visa C7 Rp 500.000 Biaya Verifikasi I Rp 1.000.000 … Penjamin (sponsor) harus memiliki akun di evisa.imigrasi.go.id sebelum mengajukan visa … surat pernyataan penjamin dari penyelenggara kegiatan … surat undangan dari penyelenggara kegiatan (bagi pelaku kegiatan seni dan budaya yang bersifat umum); atau surat permohonan visa dari impresariat dan kontrak kerja sama penampil dengan penyelenggara kegiatan (bagi penampil musik atau pendukung). … Orang Asing dengan izin tinggal dari visa ini diperkenankan menerima imbalan atau fasilitas atas atas aktivitasnya. Namun dilarang bekerja dalam hubungan kerja dengan perorangan atau korporasi di Indonesia … Waktu Proses lima hari kerja setelah pembayaran visa diterima.

sources.title: Isle of Man Government, Tier 5 – Temporary Workers
sources.said: A creative worker is someone who works in the creative industry, for example an actor, dancer, musician or film crew member. You must apply for a Tier 5 (Temporary Worker - Creative and sporting) visa if: You’ve been offered work in the UK as a sports person or creative worker … You need to have a certificate of sponsorship from a licensed sponsor before you can apply to come to the Isle of Man to work. … You can stay in the Isle of Man for up to 12 or 24 months (depending on the scheme you’re applying for) or the time given on your certificate of sponsorship plus 28 days, whichever is shorter. … You make an application for entry clearance to the Isle of Man at UK Visas and Immigration .

sources.title: Consulate General of India, San Francisco, Employment Visa (page last updated 31 October 2026)
sources.said: Applicant must submit proof of his/her employment or contract or engagement by the company/firm/organization in India. … Applicant should draw a gross salary in excess of Rs. 16.25 lakhs per annum. … However, this condition of annual floor limit on income will not apply to following: … Foreign artistes engaged to conduct regular performances for the duration of the employment contract given by Hotels, Clubs, other organizations; … The Employment Visa may be issued from the country of origin or from the country of domicile (except India) of the foreigner provided the period of permanent residence of the applicant in that particular country is more than 2 years.

sources.title: TaxGuru, Business Visa – Employment visa and FAQs (15 November 2009), reproducing the Ministry of Home Affairs' FAQs
sources.said: A foreign national coming to India for employment may initially be granted an Employment Visa by the Indian Missions abroad upto one year. Further extensions, if required, can be granted by concerned State Government/FRO upto maximum period of five years from the date of issue of the Visa.

sources.title: Legalmondo, Iran: work permit for foreigners (17 June 2016); rests on the Labour Law, arts. 120–129
sources.said: Expats require a work permit, or employment license, in Iran for any type of employment. The organ in charge is the “Department General for Employment of Foreign Nationals”, a division of the Ministry of Cooperative, Labor and Social Welfare. The requirements are set in articles 120-129 of Iran Labor Law. In general, a work permit will be issued to a foreign worker only if there are no Iranians having the same level of education or expertise. … Foreigners cannot apply for a work permit on their own, unless they establish an enterprise in Iran. Employers need to submit their request and documents … Prior to this stage, employers cannot enter into an employment contract with foreigners. Then, the documents are sent to the Technical Board for Employment of Foreign Nationals … Work permits are, in any case, valid for one year. Renewal requires an application by the employer.

sources.title: e-Gov法令API, 出入国管理及び難民認定法第七条第一項第二号の基準を定める省令（平成二年法務省令第十六号）, 興行
sources.said: 法別表第一の二の表の興行の項の下欄に掲げる活動 一 申請人が演劇、演芸、歌謡、舞踊又は演奏（以下「演劇等」という。）の興行に係る活動に従事しようとする場合は、次のいずれかに該当していること。 … （１） 外国人の興行に係る業務について通算して三年以上の経験を有する経営者又は管理者がいること。 … （ｉｉ） 二年以上の外国における経験を有すること。 （２） 申請人が次のいずれにも該当する本邦の機関との契約（当該機関が申請人に対して月額二十万円以上の報酬を支払う義務を負うことが明示されているものに限る。以下この号において「興行契約」という。） … 二 申請人が演劇等の興行に係る活動以外の興行に係る活動に従事しようとする場合は、日本人が従事する場合に受ける報酬と同等額以上の報酬を受けて従事すること。 三 申請人が興行に係る活動以外の芸能活動に従事しようとする場合は、申請人が次のいずれかに該当する活動に従事し、かつ、日本人が従事する場合に受ける報酬と同等額以上の報酬を受けること。 イ 商品又は事業の宣伝に係る活動 ロ 放送番組（有線放送番組を含む。）又は映画の製作に係る活動

sources.title: e-Gov法令API, 出入国管理及び難民認定法施行規則（昭和五十六年法務省令第五十四号）, 別表第二
sources.said: 興行 三年、一年、六月、三月又は三十日 … 法第七条の二第二項に規定する代理人は、当該外国人が本邦において行おうとする別表第四の上欄に掲げる活動に応じ、それぞれ同表の下欄に掲げる者とする。 … 興行契約機関（興行契約機関がないときは、本人を招へいする本邦の機関）又は本人が所属して芸能活動を行うこととなる本邦の機関の職員

sources.title: e-Gov法令API, 出入国管理及び難民認定法施行令（平成十年政令第百七十八号）, 手数料

sources.title: Tilleke & Gibbins, Cambodia Sets New Work Permit Rules for Foreign Employees (12 January 2024) — quoting MLVT Notification No. 110/23 of 28 December 2023; Prakas 195 of 20 August 2014; the instruments' own text is on the MLVT's prakas list (https://www.mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/ប្រកាស.html, saved KH-mlvt-prakas.html) but no file for them was found there by title (2026-11-01)
sources.said: A foreign employee whose name is stated in an enterprise’s patent tax certificate must hold a foreign work permit and an employment card. Self-employed individuals must hold a foreign work permit and an employment card. Applications for work permits and employment cards can be submitted through the MLVT’s online portal
sources.quotes: https://www.mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/ប្រកាស.html

sources.title: ASEAN Briefing (Dezan Shira & Associates), A Guide to Employment Permits for Foreign Workers in Cambodia — quoting Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training, Prakas 195 of 2014 on work permits and employment cards; the instruments' own text is on the MLVT's prakas list (https://www.mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/ប្រកាស.html, saved KH-mlvt-prakas.html) but no file for them was found there by title (2026-11-01)
sources.said: In addition to an E-visa, a foreign worker must also obtain a work permit and employment card. This is the responsibility of the employer who will apply through the MVLT. … A work permit is issued for one year, and regardless of when it was issued during the year, it is valid up to December 31 of the year of issuance. The application for its renewal must be made at the MLVT between January 1 and March 30, each year. … Foreign employee quota approval; … The MLVT imposes a maximum 10 percent quota of an employer’s total workforce for the use of foreign employees.
sources.quotes: https://www.mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/ប្រកាស.html

entries.sought: The work permit a foreign performer needs in Saint Kitts and Nevis: who applies, its fees, processing, term, union consultation, eligibility, pay and exemption

sources.title: SKNIS, Ministry of National Security reminds employers of work permit procedures (28 September 2020)
sources.said: As per Section 17 of the Immigration Act, an application for a work permit can only be made for a specialized position while the applicant resides outside of the Federation of St. Kitts and Nevis. … The position must first be advertised in the local media for three consecutive weeks. Additionally, the employer must also show that they have consulted with the Labour Department and provide evidence of trying to fill the vacant post locally. … Request for renewal of a work permit must be made no later than two weeks before the expiration of the current work permit.

sources.title: Law Commission of St Kitts and Nevis, Immigration Act Cap. 6.02 with its regulations (Revised Laws to 31 December 2020), regs. 22-23
sources.said: an application for a Work Permit shall be made by the prospective employer on behalf of the prospective employee; … he or she shall advertise the job in a local newspaper and over the local Radio Station for a period of at least one month … such renewal should be sought at least three months prior to the expiration of such Work Permit; … (a) For a calendar year $ 1,600.00 (b) For a period of one month or less $ 250.00 (c) Temporary permits for each additional month not exceeding two months $ 250.00 (d) Entertainers(5 or more persons) $ 900.00 (e) Entertainers (1 to 4 persons) $ 175.00 each (f) For variation or replacement of a Work Permit $ 25.00

sources.title: General Security, Artistic Enterprises
sources.said: The artists that wish to work in Lebanon, have to have an entry visa in hand that has been delivered by the general security – artist department. The latter is renewable every month, upon agreement of both parties. A 3 months visa can be granted according to the contract if the fees have been paid. … International orchestras groups, ballet dancers, sport show artists, water-skiing artists, figure skating artists, theater, are not considered artists and are exempted from artist taxes. They are granted a touristic visa

sources.title: Ausländergesetz (AuG), LGBl. 2008 Nr. 311, Fassung 12.06.2026 (gesetze.li)
sources.said: Eine Kurzaufenthalts- oder Aufenthaltsbewilligung zur Ausübung einer unselbständigen Erwerbstätigkeit kann nur an Führungskräfte, Spezialisten und andere qualifizierte Arbeitnehmer mit abgeschlossener Berufslehre oder langjähriger Berufserfahrung erteilt werden. … Ausländer können zur Ausübung einer unselbständigen … nur zugelassen werden, wenn die orts-, berufs- und branchenüblichen Lohn- und Arbeitsbedingungen eingehalten werden. … in Liechtenstein nur zugelassen werden, wenn nachgewiesen wird, dass auf dem bewilligungsfreien Arbeitsmarkt keine geeigneten … oder Arbeitnehmer gefunden werden können. … Über vollständige Gesuche wird in der Regel entschieden: a) innert zwei Wochen ab Eingang bei Gesuchen um Erteilung einer … oder Kurzaufenthaltsbewilligung; … Die Kurzaufenthaltsbewilligung kann für befristete und unmittelbar aneinander gereihte Aufenthalte insgesamt bis zu einem Jahr erteilt werden. … Sie kann bei Nachweis eines ausserordentlichen Bedürfnisses einmalig um höchstens sechs Monate verlängert werden. … während einer Frist von höchstens acht Tagen innerhalb eines Zeitraums von 90 Tagen eine grenzüberschreitende Dienstleistung erbringen. … Die Aufnahme der Erwerbstätigkeit darf erst nach Erhalt der Zusicherung oder des Visums erfolgen.

sources.said: Si vous êtes ressortissant d’un pays tiers et que vous souhaitez exercer une activité salariée lors de votre court séjour (moins de 90 jours) au Luxembourg, vous devez demander au préalable une autorisation de travail .
