sources.title: Inspectoratul General pentru Migrație, Cuantumurile taxei de stat (2026)
sources.said: Pentru acordarea dreptului de ședere provizorie în scop de muncă 3600 lei … Pentru eliberarea permisului de ședere provizorie sau a permisului 150 lei … Examinarea cererii privind acordarea dreptului de 10 zile 169 lei

sources.title: Inspectoratul General pentru Migrație, Lista documentelor necesare (lucrător imigrant)
sources.said: Lista documentelor necesare pentru acordarea dreptului de ședere în scop de muncă lucrătorului imigrant 1. Demersul tipizat 2. Paşaportul naţional al străinului 3. Contractul individual de muncă cu indicarea salariului lunar al străinului

sources.title: Law No. 165 of 20 July 2017 amending Law 180/2008 on labour migration, art. 7 (Monitorul Oficial 356-359, art. 597; copy on the National Employment Agency's site, anofm.md)
sources.said: LEGE Nr. 165 din 20.07.2017 pentru modificarea şi completarea unor acte legislative Publicat : 06.10.2017 în Monitorul Oficial Nr. 356-359 art Nr : 597 … (1) Pentru acordarea dreptului la muncă şi a dreptului de şedere provizorie în scop de muncă străinului, beneficiarul solicitant depune la ghişeul unic următoarele documente: a) copia de pe anunţul publicitar de angajare, publicat în presă, şi oferta locurilor de muncă vacante; … c) proiectul contractului individual de muncă cu indicarea salariului lunar al străinului, stabilit în mărime nu mai mică decît salariul mediu lunar pe economie prognozat pentru anul de gestiune … (5) Dreptul la muncă şi dreptul de şedere provizorie în scop de muncă se acordă pentru o perioadă de pînă la un an, cu posibilitatea de a fi prelungită pentru un nou termen.

sources.title: Zakon o strancima ("Službeni list CG", 12/2018 … 3/2026), arts. 69, 70, 76, 79, 80, 82 and 85 (Zavod za zapošljavanje Crne Gore's consolidated copy)
sources.said: Dozvola za privremeni boravak i rad radi zapošljavanja i sezonskog zapošljavanja izdaje se strancu koji ispunjava uslove iz člana 43 ovog zakona, a kao dokaz o opravdanosti zahtjeva priloži: 1) pisanu ponudu poslodavca za zapošljavanje stranca na određenom radnom mjestu; 2) dokaz o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti. … Dozvola za privremeni boravak i rad radi zapošljavanja stranca izdaje se sa rokom važenja do jedne godine. Dozvola iz stava 1 ovog člana može se produžiti … Godišnji broj dozvola za privremeni boravak i rad stranaca (u daljem tekstu: godišnja kvota) utvrđuje Vlada … Zahtjev za izdavanje dozvole za privremeni boravak i rad stranac podnosi lično Ministarstvu u mjestu boravka, na propisanom obrascu. … Izuzetno, zahtjev za izdavanje dozvole za privremeni boravak i rad može podnijeti i poslodavac u mjestu namjeravanog boravka … O zahtjevu za izdavanje dozvole za privremeni boravak i rad odlučuje se u roku od 15 dana od dana predaje urednog zahtjeva. … Na osnovu izdate potvrde o prijavi rada u Crnoj Gori mogu boraviti i raditi do 90 dana, u vremenskom periodu od jedne godine, stranci: … 10) autori i izvođači na području filmske, televizijske, muzičke, muzičko-scenske, plesne i baletske umjetnosti, kao i prateće tehničko osoblje, ako u Crnoj Gori ne borave duže od 30 dana, odnosno tri mjeseca godišnje sa prekidima

sources.title: Government of Montenegro, Point of Single Contact (psc.gov.me): Privremeni boravak i rad (radna dozvola), Ministry of Interior (26 April 2024)
sources.said: Naknade: 60 EUR taksa 5 EUR za obrazac dozvole 2 EUR za zahtjev … Rok: 15 dana

sources.title: Service-Public.gouv.fr (DILA), Carte talent : carte de séjour pluriannuelle d'un étranger en France (vérifié le 01 juin 2026), Profession artistique et culturelle
sources.said: La carte de séjour « talent-profession artistique et culturelle » vous autorise à séjourner en France. Elle vous autorise à exercer une activité professionnelle salariée et/ou non salariée. Dans le cadre de votre activité salariée, votre employeur n'a pas à demander d'autorisation de travail et est exonéré du paiement de la taxe pour l’emploi d’un ressortissant étranger. … Vous pouvez obtenir une carte de séjour «talent-profession artistique et culturelle» si vous êtes artiste-interprète ou auteur d'œuvre littéraire ou artistique et si vous remplissez les conditions suivantes : Justifier de ressources au moins égales à 70 % du SMIC brut à temps plein par mois de séjour en France, soit 1 306,91 € dont au moins 51 % provenant de votre activité d'artiste-interprète ou d'auteur d'une œuvre littéraire ou artistique Si vous exercez une activité salariée : justifier d’1 ou plusieurs contrats de travail pour une durée totale cumulée de 3 mois ou plus sur une période de 12 mois, conclus avec 1 ou plusieurs entreprises ou établissements dont l’activité principale est la création ou l’exploitation d’œuvres de l’esprit. … Si la carte de séjour vous est attribuée, vous devez régler 350 € (droit de timbre de 50 € + taxe de 300 € ) par timbres fiscaux . … La carte est valable pour une durée identique à celle du contrat de travail dans la limite d'une durée maximale de 4 ans. … Si la préfecture n'a pas répondu au bout de 4 mois , il s'agit d'un refus implicite. … Vous devez déposer votre demande de titre de séjour sur internet au plus tôt 4 mois et au plus tard 2 mois avant la fin de validité de votre document de séjour si vous êtes titulaire d’un visa long séjour valant titre de séjour (VLS-TS) ou d’un titre de séjour

sources.said: Le demandeur ayant pénétré dans le pays avec un visa touristique ne sera pas autorisé à travailler à Maurice ! … Seules les entreprises mauriciennes ou étrangères incorporées à l’île Maurice sont habilitées à déposer une demande de permis de travail et permis de séjour pour un étranger. La demande ne peut être déposée que pour un travailleur qualifié exerçant un travail spécifique, à temps plein et pour une durée déterminée. La demande de permis de travail et de permis de séjour se fait en même temps. L’entreprise doit commencer par faire une demande préalable auprès du ministère du Travail. … le permis de travail ne peut excéder 4 ans, sauf en zone franche où il peut aller jusqu’à 5 ans.

sources.title: Maldives Immigration, Work Visa Service
sources.said: The employer or authorized representative must apply for and obtain the Work e-Visa within fifteen (15) days of the employee's arrival in the Maldives on a valid Entry Pass (Work Permit) issued by the Ministry of Homeland Security and Technology. … The validity of the Work e-Visa will correspond directly to the validity of the approved Work Permit. … Renewed Work Visas will be issued with a maximum validity of one (1) year.

entries.sought: The work permit a foreign performer needs in Malawi: who applies, its fees, processing, term, union consultation, eligibility, pay and exemption

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services (Malawi), Temporary Employee Permit
sources.said: This permit is issued to persons before they enter Malawi for the purpose of taking up specified employment in Malawi. … The organisation has the responsibility to apply for the permit on behalf of the applicant . … The TEP application form and supporting documents are submitted at the Immigration Headquarters or Regional Immigration Offices for processing upon payment of the processing fees . … The application will be submitted to the TEP Approval Committee for consideration, then the Minister for decision. … If approved one will be required to pay the appropriate fees within 30 days from date of notification. … A TEP can be renewed twice through submission of a TEP Renewal Application Form … All applicants for new TEP are required by law to wait outside Malawi until the application has been approved.

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services (Malawi), Notice on Temporary Employment Permits
sources.said: It is a requirement that vacancies in Malawi should first be offered to qualified Malawians. Only in cases where there is demonstrated shortage of skills within Malawi can the position be offered to an expatriate. All applications should show that the post was advertised locally and that it was not possible to identify a suitably qualified person locally TEP applications should include details of a qualified Malawian who will understudy the expatriate and will eventually take over the post. … a TEP except one for a key post may only be renewed twice and it is not automatic. … A Temporary Employment Permit authorizes such person, together with his wife and children under the age of eighteen years and dependent relatives, and subject to such conditions as may be prescribed, to reside within that area for the purpose of engaging in that occupation for a period of not less than six months or more than two years. A Temporary Employment Permit may be renewed after two years if the holder of the permit is still engaged in the employment for which the permit was issued at the date of expiry of such Permit.

sources.said: II. VISITANTE CON PERMISO PARA REALIZAR ACTIVIDADES REMUNERADAS. sources.title: Décret n° 2017-682/PRN/MET/PS du 10 août 2017 portant partie réglementaire du Code du Travail (FAOLEX), arts. 121–132
sources.said: Article 121 : Les contrats de travail des travailleurs étrangers sont, en outre, obligatoirement soumis au visa du service public de l’emploi ou de ses représentants locaux. … Article 125 : La demande de visa incombe à l’employeur. … Article 126 : L’autorité dispose d’un délai d’un (1) mois à compter de la date de dépôt du dossier complet pour accorder le visa. Passé ce délai, le visa est réputé avoir été accordé de plein droit. … Tout employeur qui a recours à la main-d’œuvre étrangère est tenu de requérir le visa préalable du Ministre chargé du Travail avant l’entrée du travailleur étranger en territoire nigérien. … Article 129 : L’apposition du visa au contrat de travail des travailleurs étrangers, ainsi que le renouvellement de ce visa donnent lieu à une rétribution au profit du service public de l’emploi. Le taux et les modalités de perception de cette rétribution sont fixés par arrêté conjoint des ministres chargés des Finances et du Travail. … Article 131 : La durée du visa du contrat des travailleurs étrangers ne peut excéder deux (2) ans, renouvelable une seule fois.

sources.title: UDI, Artist, musician or performer
sources.said: You must have received a concrete offer of employment as a performer, musician or artist, or as a member of their necessary accompanying support staff. … The main rule is that you must have received an offer of full-time employment. Normally, this constitutes 37.5 hours per week. For musicians or dance bands, 21 hours per week is sufficient. … The pay and working conditions must not be poorer than is normal in Norway. This means that you must receive pay in accordance with the collective agreement for the industry in question. If no collective agreement applies to the industry, your pay cannot be poorer than is normal for someone in your occupation in the place you are to work. For example, musicians, circus performers and their necessary accompanying support staff must have a salary of at least … NOK 341 373 per year pre-tax … You can be granted a permit for a maximum of one year at a time. You must have stayed outside of Norway for three months before you can be granted a new permit. … If you are to change jobs, assignments or employers, you must apply for a new permit.

sources.title: Préfecture de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Travailleurs étrangers (publié le 6 mars 2025)
sources.said: Pour exercer une activité professionnelle à Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon tout intervenant étranger doit préalablement à son arrivée sur le territoire obtenir une autorisation de travail. Cette obligation concerne les salariés, les prestataires de service ainsi que les travailleurs indépendants étrangers y compris les ressortissants de l’Union Européenne. Une autorisation provisoire de travail peut être accordée à un étranger qui ne dispose pas de titre de séjour autorisant le travail à Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon. Sa durée ne peut excéder 9 mois renouvelable. Attention : Les autorisations de travail délivrées hors de l’archipel ne sont pas recevables à Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon

sources.title: Préfecture de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Travailleurs étrangers : Emploi direct (mis à jour le 6 mars 2025)
sources.said: L’employeur doit déposer une offre auprès de France Travail pendant au minimum 3 semaines. Le critère de la situation de l’emploi pour certaines professions est inopérant (professions artistiques et culturelles … ). Dès lors, afin de déterminer si le dépôt d’une offre d’emploi est nécessaire, l’entreprise pourra saisir, à cette fin, les services de la préfecture. … au moins 15 jours avant la date d’arrivée du travailleur étranger : une demande d’autorisation de travail via le formulaire ci-dessous une copie de l’attestation de France Travail justifiant que le poste n’a pu être pourvu sur le marché local de l’emploi une copie du projet de contrat de travail

sources.title: Préfecture de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Dispense d'autorisation de travail (mis à jour le 6 mars 2025)
sources.said: La personne de nationalité étrangère qui entre à Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, afin d’y exercer une activité pour une durée inférieure ou égale à 3 mois dans les domaines suivants, n’est pas soumise à la condition d’une autorisation de travail : 1° Les manifestations sportives, culturelles, artistiques et scientifiques ; … 3° La production et la diffusion cinématographiques, audiovisuelles, du spectacle et de l'édition phonographique, lorsqu'il est artiste du spectacle ou personnel technique attaché directement à la production ou à la réalisation

sources.title: Code du travail, art. R5523-14 (Code du travail numérique, Ministry of Labour; updated 01/05/2008)
sources.said: Pour accorder ou refuser l'autorisation de travail sollicitée, le préfet de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon prend notamment en considération : … 3° Les conditions d'emploi et de rémunération offertes au travailleur étranger, qui doivent être identiques à celles dont bénéficient les travailleurs français ;

sources.title: Code du travail, art. R5523-9 (Code du travail numérique)
sources.said: A Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, une autorisation provisoire de travail peut être délivrée à l'étranger qui ne peut prétendre ni à la carte de séjour temporaire portant la mention "salarié", ni à la carte de résident et qui est appelé à exercer chez un employeur déterminé, pendant une période dont la durée initialement prévue n'excède pas un an, une activité présentant, par sa nature ou les circonstances de son exercice, un caractère temporaire. La durée de validité de cette autorisation, dont les caractéristiques sont fixées par arrêté du ministre chargé des travailleurs immigrés, ne peut dépasser neuf mois. Elle est renouvelable.

sources.title: gov.pt, Pedir um visto de residência ou estada temporária para o exercício de atividade profissional de espetáculos (atualizado em 27.03.2026)
sources.said: Os vistos para o exercício de atividade profissional de espetáculos podem ser pedidos por artistas (atores, músicos ou bailarinos, por exemplo) ou trabalhadores de empresas promotoras ou organizadoras de espetáculos. O visto de estada temporária permite a permanência em Portugal até um ano. O visto de residência permite a permanência em Portugal por um período superior a um ano. Se quiser permanecer em Portugal apenas até 90 dias pode pedir um visto Schengen para efeitos de curta duração … que queira permanecer em Portugal para exercer uma atividade artística (atores, músicos ou bailarinos, por exemplo) … Através do portal E-Visa . Presencialmente, em: Postos consulares portugueses (Embaixadas e Consulados) Prestadores de Serviços Externos … O prazo para decisão sobre pedido de visto é de 30 dias (para vistos de residência e vistos de estada temporária). … A validade do visto de residência é definida de acordo com o objetivo e duração prevista da estadia em Portugal, pode ser definido com base num contrato de trabalho, por exemplo. Visto de residência - 90€ Visto de estada temporária - 75€

sources.title: Lei n.º 23/2007, de 4 de julho (consolidated, Procuradoria-Geral Regional de Lisboa), artigo 54.º

sources.title: Biblioteca y Archivo Central del Congreso Nacional, Ley N° 6984 de Migraciones (2022), arts. 45, 49, 56
sources.said: Artículo 45.- Residencia Espontánea u Ocasional. La Residencia Espontánea u Ocasional es la autorización que otorga la Dirección Nacional de Migraciones, a aquellos extranjeros que ingresan al país, con ánimo de desarrollar actividades ocasionales lícitas bajo las condiciones que establezcan la presente Ley y su reglamentación. Será otorgado por un plazo de hasta 90 (noventa) días prorrogables por el mismo período en el año, … Artículo 49.- Requisitos para obtener la Residencia Espontánea u Ocasional. A fin de obtener la Residencia Espontánea u Ocasional, el extranjero que desee residir en el país, deberá presentar las siguientes documentaciones: 1. Pasaporte o documento de identidad vigente. 2. Visa consular y su verificación por el Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores, en los casos que se requieran. 3. Constancia de ingreso al país. 4. Declaración Jurada ante la Dirección Nacional de Migraciones de su profesión, actividad u oficio que desarrollará en el país y del domicilio temporal fijado en el territorio nacional. 5. Pago del arancel correspondiente. … Artículo 56.- Carnet de Residencia Espontánea u Ocasional. La Dirección Nacional de Migraciones otorgará un carnet de Residencia Espontánea u Ocasional para aquellos extranjeros cuyas labores estacionales u ocasionales, como integrantes de espectáculos públicos, o como invitados por entes públicos o privados en razón de su arte y/o profesión, obliguen a permanecer en el país, por no más de 90 (noventa) días.

sources.title: Service Public (DILA), Carte talent : carte de séjour pluriannuelle d'un étranger en France — Profession artistique et culturelle (vérifié le 1er juin 2026) — national rules, applying in Réunion as an overseas department
sources.said: Dans le cadre de votre activité salariée, votre employeur n'a pas à demander d'autorisation de travail et est exonéré du paiement de la taxe pour l’emploi d’un ressortissant étranger. … Vous pouvez obtenir une carte de séjour «talent-profession artistique et culturelle» si vous êtes artiste-interprète ou auteur d'œuvre littéraire ou artistique et si vous remplissez les conditions suivantes : Justifier de ressources au moins égales à 70 % du SMIC brut à temps plein par mois de séjour en France, soit 1 306,91 € dont au moins 51 % provenant de votre activité d'artiste-interprète ou d'auteur d'une œuvre littéraire ou artistique Si vous exercez une activité salariée : justifier d’1 ou plusieurs contrats de travail pour une durée totale cumulée de 3 mois ou plus sur une période de 12 mois, conclus avec 1 ou plusieurs entreprises ou établissements dont l’activité principale est la création ou l’exploitation d’œuvres de l’esprit. … Si la durée de votre séjour est inférieure à 12 mois , le consulat vous délivre un visa de long séjour valant titre de séjour portant la mention "talent". … Si la carte de séjour vous est attribuée, vous devez régler 350 € (droit de timbre de 50 € + taxe de 300 € ) par timbres fiscaux . … La carte est valable pour une durée identique à celle du contrat de travail dans la limite d'une durée maximale de 4 ans. … Vous devez déposer votre demande de titre de séjour sur internet au plus tôt 4 mois et au plus tard 2 mois avant la fin de validité de votre document de séjour si vous êtes titulaire d’un visa long séjour valant titre de séjour (VLS-TS) ou d’un titre de séjour … Si la préfecture n'a pas répondu au bout de 4 mois , il s'agit d'un refus implicite.

sources.said: Visa de long séjour (plus de 3 mois) valable pour la France 99 €

sources.title: Migrationsverket, Arbetstillstånd för artister
sources.said: Du behöver inte ansöka om arbetstillstånd om du har blivit inbjuden av en etablerad arrangör för att arbeta i högst 14 dagar under en tolvmånadersperiod. … Du ska ha ett anställningsavtal eller kontrakt Anställningsavtalet eller kontraktet ska innehålla eventuell turnéplan, gage, tidpunkt och plats för engagemanget, och ska vara underskrivet av både dig och arrangören. Du ska ha rätt anställningsvillkor Din lön och andra anställningsvillkor ska vara på minst samma nivå som svenska kollektivavtal eller vad som är brukligt inom yrket eller branschen. Din arbetsgivare ska ha tecknat försäkringar för dig Arbetsgivaren ska ha tecknat sjukförsäkring, livförsäkring, trygghetsförsäkring och tjänstepensionsförsäkring för dig när du påbörjar anställningen. … För att uppfylla lönekravet ska du ha en månadslön på minst 34 470 kronor . Det motsvarar 90 procent av den aktuella medianlönen som SCB publicerar i juni varje år. … Du kan få arbetstillstånd för högst två år, men inte för längre tid än anställningen varar. Du kan aldrig få tillstånd för längre tid än ditt pass är giltigt. Tillståndet går att förlänga. … Vad kostar det att ansöka? Arbetstagare: 1 500 kronor … Hur länge måste jag vänta på beslut? Vi kan inte säga exakt hur länge du måste vänta på beslut. … Det är din arbetsgivare som påbörjar ansökan i e-tjänsten. Fackförbundet får möjlighet att yttra sig Arbetsgivaren skickar information om anställningen till det fackförbund som är relevant för den bransch som anställningen gäller. entries.sought: The work permit a foreign performer needs in Senegal: who applies, its fees, processing, term, union consultation, eligibility, pay and exemption

sources.title: Journal officiel de la République du Sénégal n° 7931 du 17 septembre 2026 (numéro spécial), Loi n° 2026-18 du 3 septembre 2026 portant Code du Travail, article 105 (copy on vie-publique.sn)
sources.said: Article 105. - Formalités administratives … préalables à l'emploi … d'un travailleur étranger … Sous réserve du respect des accords et engagements … internationaux souscrits par le Sénégal, l'embauche d'un … travailleur étranger est précédée d'un contrat de travail … écrit et visé par le Directeur général du Travail et de la … Sécurité sociale. Le … visa est requis avant le commencement de l'exé- … cution du contrat de travail. La demande de visa incombe … à l'employeur. … Le Directeur général du Travail et de la Sécurité sociale … dispose d'un délai de sept (07) jours francs pour … viser ce contrat. Passé ce délai, son silence vaut appro- … Le Directeur général du Travail et de la Sécurité sociale vérifie : … - l'identité du travailleur et son profil professionnel ; - … la conformité du contenu du contrat de travail à … la règlementation en vigueur au Sénégal ; … Le visa d'embauche, de renouvellement ou de prolon- … gation de la durée du contrat de travail du travailleur … étranger est assujetti à l'acquittement de frais selon les … modalités prévues par arrêté conjoint du Ministre chargé … des Finances et du Ministre chargé du Travail.

sources.title: Le Soleil (Dakar), 30 September 2026, Nouveau Code du travail au Sénégal : la réforme entre désormais dans sa phase d'application
sources.said: Le texte est ensuite devenu la loi n°2026-18 du 3 septembre 2026 portant Code du Travail, date à laquelle il a été promulgué par le Président de la République, Bassirou Diomaye Diakhar Faye. La publication est intervenue dans le Journal officiel de la République du Sénégal, année 171e, n°7931, numéro spécial, daté du jeudi 17 septembre 2026.

sources.title: El Diario de Hoy (elsalvador.com), Requisitos y costos para traer artistas extranjeros al país
sources.said: Según la Dirección de Migración y Extranjería, este proceso permite autorizar la entrada al país de artistas que participarán en actividades como música, teatro, danza, locución o animación de eventos culturales y comerciales. … La solicitud se realiza en línea, cumpliendo los requisitos establecidos por la normativa vigente, e incluye el envío de documentación al correo … junto con el pago de la tasa correspondiente. … A este documento se le debe adjuntar la resolución y constancia emitida por la Dirección General de Espectáculos Públicos, requisito indispensable para validar la actividad. … También es necesario presentar una nómina detallada de los artistas extranjeros, que incluya nombre completo, nacionalidad, número de pasaporte vigente y fecha de vencimiento. … el trámite contempla el pago de una tasa migratoria diferenciada: $60.00 para artistas centroamericanos y $100.00 para no centroamericanos. … Posteriormente, la entidad evalúa el trámite y, en un plazo de cinco días hábiles, comunica la resolución correspondiente a través del correo electrónico proporcionado por el solicitante.

sources.said: (2) An application for a Work Permit, except a Freelancer’s work permit and temporary work permit, may be made to the Board in the prescribed form. … (a) the employer has provided the Board with— (i) details of the job description and salary package; … (f) the person in respect of whom the work permit is sought is proficient in written and spoken English; … (2) The application shall be lodged by the employer on behalf of the person he is employing. … (5) An application under this regulation shall be processed after completion of the labour clearance process and the Labour Clearance has been issued under regulation 53. … (a) in respect of a skilled worker, for such period not exceeding five years as the Board may determine; or (b) in respect of an unskilled worker, for such period not exceeding three years, as the Board may determine. sources.title: Journal officiel de la République togolaise, 18 juin 2021: loi n° 2021-012 du 18 juin 2021 portant Code du travail, arts. 52–53 (FAOLEX copy)
sources.said: Sous réserve de réciprocité et des conventions et traités ratifiés par le Togo, le recrutement d’un travailleur de nationalité étrangère est précédé d’une autorisation d’embauchage et faire l’objet d’un contrat de travail conclu par écrit et visé par le directeur général du travail. … Art. 53 : La demande d’autorisation d’embauchage et la demande de visa faites par lettre recommandée et avis de réception incombent à l’employeur. Le visa est valable pour une durée maximale de deux (2) ans, renouvelable une fois. … Si l’autorité compétente pour accorder le visa n’a pas fait connaître sa décision dans les quinze (15) jours ouvrables qui suivent la réception de la demande de visa, celui-ci est réputé avoir été accordé. … l’autorisation d’embauchage et l’octroi de visa du contrat de travail donnent lieu à la perception d’une taxe dont le montant, à la charge de l’employeur, est fixé par arrêté conjoint du ministre chargé du travail et du ministre chargé des finances.

sources.title: Правила выдачи разрешений на работу иностранным гражданам и лицам без гражданства (Постановление Правительства РТ от 31.10.2008 № 529), base.spinform.ru; rests on Постановление Правительства Республики Таджикистан от 31 октября 2008 года № 529
sources.said: Разрешение на работу выдается сроком до 1 года … Решение о выдаче или об отказе в выдаче разрешения на работу принимается уполномоченным органом в течение 15 дней со дня подачи заявителем документов … Сумма оплаты за выдачу разрешений на работу для иностранных граждан и лицам без гражданства определить в размере 60 показателей для расчетов на один год … Разрешение на работу получает каждый иностранный гражданин, а также с его согласия работодатель или иное лицо которое предоставит доверенность о выдаче данного документа … копии приглашений или договоров между работодателями Республики Таджикистан, идентификационный номер налогоплательщика (ИНН) … продления разрешения на работу … прибывшие в командировки, в том числе: спортсмены, прибывшие на соревнования, артисты, прибывшие на гастроли по официальному приглашению государственных органов и организаций

sources.title: Asia-Plus, Размер показателя для расчетов в Таджикистане увеличивается (24 November 2025), quoting the Law on the State Budget for 2026 — Закон Республики Таджикистан «О государственном бюджете Республики Таджикистан на 2026 год» (No. 2203 of 1 December 2025), article 24
sources.said: «С 1 января 2026 года показатель для исчисления налогов, пошлин, других обязательных платежей, штрафных санкций, социальных выплат, а также для расчёта соответствующих предельных (нижних или верхних) стоимостных величин, применяемых в соответствии с законодательством Республики Таджикистан, установить в размере 78 сомони»

sources.title: Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga in Beijing, Employment Visa
sources.said: An Employment Visa is required for a person or group who wants to work in Tonga, either in the Public Service or Private Sector for any length of time. … Letter of Support from Ministry of Labour, Commerce & Industries (MLCL). USD$230 money order payable to Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga, Beijing, PRC; or USD$230 Cash. Application form must be fully completed and signed (one application per family). For renewed applications, a letter of support from the Inland Revenue Department on history of tax payment(s) is required. The following documents are also required if you are going to be employed in Tonga up to 2 or more years: Offer of employment from a company in Tonga. … If not, Immigration may require a TOP$1,000 bond per person; … Letter of support from Secretary for Labour, Commerce & Industries on whether the applicant’s professional skill is required in Tonga (labour check) … An Employment Visa normally takes one month to process.

sources.title: Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı, Uluslararası İşgücü Genel Müdürlüğü: Harç ve Değerli Kâğıt Bedelinin Ödenmesi (2026 amounts)
sources.said: 492 sayılı Harçlar Kanunu gereğince; yabancılara verilecek çalışma izni ve çalışma izni muafiyeti belgesi harca tabidir. … Bildirim tarihinden itibaren 30 gün içinde istenilen harç ve değerli kâğıt bedelinin yatırılmaması halinde çalışma izni / muafiyeti başvurusu reddedilmektedir. … Süreli / 1 yıla kadar (1 yıl dahil) Çalışma İzni / Muafiyeti Belgesi 12.574,90 … Süreli / 1 yıldan fazla ve 2 yıl süreli Çalışma İzni / Muafiyeti Belgesi 25.149,80 … DEĞERLİ KÂĞIT BEDELİ 2026 YILI 964.00TL

sources.title: Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı, Çalışma İzni Muafiyeti tablosu (art. 48 categories and maximum periods)
sources.said: Madde 48/a Bilimsel, kültürel ve sanatsal faaliyetler kapsamında çalışacak yabancılar 1 Ay

sources.title: Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı, Çalışma İzni Değerlendirme Kriterleri
sources.said: 3. Ücret kriteri 3.1. Yabancıya ödenecek ücret, çalışma izni başvurusu tarihi itibariyle yürürlükte bulunan brüt asgari ücret tutarı dikkate alınmak suretiyle; a) Üst düzey yöneticiler ve pilotlar için asgari ücretin 5 katından, b) Mühendis ve mimarlar için asgari ücretin 4 katından, c) Diğer yöneticiler için asgari ücretin 3 katından, ç) Uzmanlık ve ustalık gerektiren işlerde çalışacaklar için asgari ücretin 2 katından, d) Ev hizmetleri ve diğer mesleklerde/işlerde çalışacak yabancılar için asgari ücret düzeyinden az olamaz.

sources.title: Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı, Work Permit Exemption Application Guide (22 September 2026)
sources.said: Application Roadmap — in this step, the process advances by selecting whether the foreign national is applying on their own behalf or through an employer. … No fee is charged for work permit exemption applications with a validity period of less than three months. Only Valuable Paper Fee is paid if printed document is requested.

sources.title: Advice.uz, Получение подтверждения на право осуществления трудовой деятельности на территории Республики Узбекистан; rests on Закон «О занятости населения» and Постановление Кабинета Министров от 22 февраля 2022 года № 86
sources.said: Для работы иностранного гражданина по трудовому договору на территории Республики Узбекистан необходимо получить подтверждение на право осуществления трудовой деятельности, кроме случаев, прямо предусмотренных законодательством. Заявителем может быть: юридическое лицо — работодатель ; физическое лицо — работодатель или иностранный гражданин . Заявление подается через информационную систему «Лицензия» либо Единый портал интерактивных государственных услуг . … За рассмотрение заявления уплачивается сбор в размере 1 БРВ . За выдачу подтверждения взимаются следующие сборы: с высококвалифицированных специалистов … с остальных иностранных граждан — 30 БРВ . … Заявление рассматривается в течение 15 рабочих дней . … Остальным иностранным гражданам подтверждение выдается на срок трудового договора, но не более чем на 1 год . Для продления подтверждения необходимо обратиться не позднее чем за 20 рабочих дней до окончания срока его действия.

sources.title: 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(38), definition of United States (GovInfo, 2023 edition)
sources.said: The term "United States", except as otherwise specifically herein provided, when used in a geographical sense, means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.

sources.title: eCFR, 8 CFR 214.2(o) Aliens of extraordinary ability or achievement
sources.said: An O-1 or O-2 petition may only be filed by a United States employer, a United States agent, or a foreign employer through a United States agent. … is mandatory before a petition for an O-1 or O-2 classification can be approved. … who will be working on a motion picture or television production, consultation shall be made with the appropriate union representing the alien's occupational peers and a management organization in the area of the alien's ability. … Consultation with a peer group in the area of the alien's ability (which may include a labor organization), or a person or persons with expertise in the area of the alien's ability, is required in an O-1 petition for an alien of extraordinary ability. … Consultations are advisory and are not binding on the Service. … Extraordinary ability in the field of arts means distinction. Distinction means a high level of achievement in the field of arts evidenced by a degree of skill and recognition substantially above that ordinarily encountered to the extent that a person described as prominent is renowned, leading, or well-known in the field of arts. … shall be valid for a period of time determined by the Director to be necessary to accomplish the event or activity, not to exceed 3 years. … An extension of stay may be authorized in increments of up to 1 year for an O-1 or O-2 beneficiary to continue or complete the same event or activity

sources.title: eCFR, 8 CFR 106.2 USCIS fees
sources.said: Petition for O Nonimmigrant Worker with 1 to 25 named beneficiaries: $1,055. … Cross Reference Link to an amendment published at 91 FR 61984 , Sept. 30, 2026. … Filed by a small employer as defined in § 106.1(f) : $300.

sources.said: Petition for classification of a nonimmigrant described in section 101(a)(15)(O)(i) or (ii) of the INA—$2,965. … Petition for classification of a nonimmigrant described in section 101(a)(15)(O)(i) or (ii) of the Act: 15 business days.

sources.title: LuatVietnam, Nghị định 219/2025/NĐ-CP quy định về người lao động nước ngoài làm việc tại Việt Nam (full text; in force 7 August 2025)
sources.said: Ủy ban nhân dân cấp tỉnh có thẩm quyền cấp, cấp lại, gia hạn, thu hồi giấy phép lao động và giấy xác nhận không thuộc diện cấp giấy phép lao động đối với người lao động nước ngoài làm việc cho người sử dụng lao động … Thời hạn của giấy phép lao động, giấy xác nhận không thuộc diện cấp giấy phép lao động được cấp theo thời hạn của một trong các trường hợp sau đây nhưng không quá 02 năm … chỉ được gia hạn một lần với thời hạn tối đa là 02 năm. … Trong thời hạn 60 ngày nhưng không ít hơn 10 ngày tính đến ngày người lao động nước ngoài dự kiến làm việc, người sử dụng lao động nộp hồ sơ đề nghị cấp giấy phép lao động … Trong thời hạn 10 ngày làm việc, kể từ ngày nhận đủ hồ sơ đề nghị cấp giấy phép lao động, cơ quan có thẩm quyền xem xét chấp thuận nhu cầu và thực hiện cấp giấy phép lao động … Giấy chứng nhận thành tích cao, bằng cấp, kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực văn hóa, thể thao đối với nghệ sĩ, huấn luyện viên, vận động viên theo hướng dẫn của Bộ trưởng Bộ Văn hóa, Thể thao và Du lịch;

sources.title: LuatVietnam, Decree No. 393/2026/ND-CP on foreign workers working in Vietnam issued
sources.said: takes effect on December 5, 2026, and replaces Decree No. 219/2025/ND-CP.

sources.title: VOV, Các trường hợp người lao động nước ngoài không thuộc diện cấp giấy phép lao động (21 October 2026)
sources.said: Phó Thủ tướng Chính phủ Phạm Thị Thanh Trà ký Nghị định số 393/2026/NĐ-CP ngày 20/10/2026 quy định về người lao động nước ngoài làm việc tại Việt Nam.

sources.title: Công báo (Official Gazette) No. 567 of 30 October 2026, Nghị định số 393/2026/NĐ-CP quy định về người lao động nước ngoài làm việc tại Việt Nam (in force 5 December 2026), signed PDF
sources.said: Trước ít nhất 10 ngày làm việc nhưng không quá 60 ngày tính đến ngày người lao động nước ngoài dự kiến làm việc, người sử dụng lao động nộp hồ sơ đề nghị cấp giấy phép lao động … Trong thời hạn 10 ngày làm việc, kể từ ngày nhận đủ hồ sơ đề nghị cấp giấy phép lao động, cơ quan có thẩm quyền xem xét chấp thuận nhu cầu và thực hiện cấp giấy phép lao động … Thời hạn của giấy phép lao động được cấp theo thời hạn của một trong các trường hợp sau đây nhưng không quá 02 năm … chỉ được gia hạn một lần với thời hạn tối đa là 02 năm. … nhưng tổng thời gian cộng dồn không quá 90 ngày trong 01 năm, tính từ ngày 01 tháng 01 đến ngày cuối cùng của năm. … Vào Việt Nam làm việc ngắn hạn. Trường hợp có phát sinh quan hệ thuê mướn, sử dụng lao động, trả lương phải thực hiện đề nghị cấp giấy phép lao động theo hình thức hợp đồng lao động quy định tại Điều 19 Nghị định này; … Chuyên gia trong lĩnh vực điện ảnh gồm: nhà sản xuất phim, đạo diễn, biên kịch, quay phim … diễn viên … Có bằng đại học trở lên trong ngành, chuyên ngành phù hợp với vị trí công việc dự kiến làm việc tại Việt Nam và có ít nhất 02 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực điện ảnh. … Có ít nhất 05 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực điện ảnh và tham gia ít nhất 03 tác phẩm điện ảnh hoặc dự án điện ảnh tại vị trí công việc phù hợp với vị trí công việc dự kiến làm việc tại Việt Nam.

entries.sought: The work permit a foreign performer needs in Wallis and Futuna: who applies, its fees, processing, term, union consultation, eligibility, pay and exemption

sources.title: Préfecture de Wallis-et-Futuna, Entrée et séjour des étrangers
sources.said: Les ressortissants de l'Union Européenne sont dispensés de visas, qu'il s'agisse de court ou de long séjour. Toutefois, s'ils désirent occuper un emploi salarié, ils doivent en obtenir l'autorisation du Préfet, Administrateur supérieur des îles Wallis et Futuna. … 2. Demande de visa de long séjour avec autorisation de travail : Demande à déposer auprès du consulat de France (à l'étranger) ou à la préfecture (en France) du lieu de résidence du requérant : formulaires à remplir (avec photographies d'identité); contrat de travail ou promesse d'embauche précisant la profession, le salaire, la durée hebdomadaire du travail, le lieu effectif d'emploi et les références de l'employeur; un certificat médical d'aptitude au travail établi par le médecin agrée par le consulat; un extrait de casier judiciaire.

sources.title: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (Samoa), Employment services: Foreign Employment Employee Permit
sources.said: Any non-citizen wishing to work in Samoa must hold a valid Foreign Employment Employee Permit (FEEP). Employers must apply for the permit before the employee commences work. Each permit is tied to the specific employer and role. … Permit conditions: Valid for up to 3 years, subject to conditions deemed appropriate by the CEO. … We review the application against local labour market demand and supply analysis. … The employee must also hold a valid Residence Permit

sources.title: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (Samoa), FEEP Brochure 2025 (image-only PDF; quoted from a transcription saved beside it, page images in WS-feep-brochure-2025-png/)
sources.said: 5 -10 working days (However, depending on the need for additional info/further investigation, etc, the process may take longer) … There is 'NO' fee for FEEP … Up to 3 years, depending on Assessment … Eligibility of application assessed by EP Officer (MCIL) based on 6 Metric Point System.

entries.sought: The work permit a foreign performer needs in Kosovo: who applies, its fees, processing, term, union consultation, eligibility, pay and exemption

sources.title: Law No. 03/L-136 on Granting Permit for Work and Employment of Foreign Citizens in the Republic of Kosovo (copy held by the Kosovo Police)
sources.said: Natural persons, who are not citizens of Kosovo, when willing to work in the territory of Republic of Kosovo for a timeframe of less than three (3) months, shall be granted the employment permit issued by the Ministry of Labor and Social Welfare. … the work permit of type B go for a yearly period ; 1.4. this work permit type can be renovated for a yearly period … The request for getting a work permit shall be submitted in written form before starting the work … the situation of work in Kosovo market does not allow this employment regulated with sub- legal act … Together with the request for work permit, employer is obliged to submit: 1.1. the document for stay permit in the Republic of Kosovo, or proof for possessing official valid visa. … The deadline for approving or refusing request for work permit is no more than thirty (30) days since the complete documents are submitted to the competent body.

entries.why: The research quotes who applies, each fee's name and the eligibility in the authority's words; the engine needs a party, a service and a test. Each reading below is the game's own, so the player is told.

value.who_applies: the party the research's applies sentence names first: the engager (employer, engager, employing, engaging, hiring, organiser, promoter, producer, sponsor, petitioner, company, institution, entity, firm, hosting party, convener, referent) or the worker (worker, performer, foreigner, foreign national or citizen, artist, artiste, entertainer, applicant, person, alien, noncitizen, third-country national, employee, employed person, candidate); none where it names neither or says the law doesn't say. Every country's reading is in scratchpad/readers/permits-by.json; to check: SV ('the person or company organising' read as worker), VE ('the artist's representative', worker), SO and PS (the employer named only as checked by the ministry, engager).
value.premium_fee: a fee whose name says premium, priority, express, expedited, urgent, fast track, immediate, or a decision within N working or business days; a premium application records the first such fee listed (the UK's Priority, not Super priority).
value.renewal_fee: a fee whose name says renew, extension, extend or jatkolupa is a renewal's; with the first grant beside it ('application or renewal', 'also renewals', 'issued or renewed') both's. An application whose research names no fee for its grant (or its renewal) records its fees as unknown (null).
value.business_days: Monday to Friday, less the country's holidays (world.holidays); the Gulf's Friday-Saturday weekend not read.
value.tc_english: speaks English at C1 or better (identity's languages)
value.la_age: from the twentieth birthday, in Asia/Vientiane, read as 'more than 20 years old'
value.permit_scope: a permit granted is read as the person's to work in that country for its term, whoever engaged them
value.exemption: papers.work's days and within per passport (layer 3, the one copy): within a period, the days of the parts played there (daysWorked, counted on the day played) plus the engagement's; with no period, the engagement's alone.
value.roles: The roles whose work abroad takes a permit: actor, director, producer. A writer writes at home and travels only to the sale meeting, a business visit (papers.visits), so no permit is asked; no permit research says a screenwriter needs one to meet (Montserrat's Labour Code exempts writers, s. 128(2)(o); Greece's Z.3 names writers on contracts over three months, an engagement the game's writer doesn't take).
value.covers: Whom a rule covers, where the research names them: Kazakhstan's freedom (Decree 1041, item 11: artists and directors) actor and director; Armenia's (art. 23(1)(4): performers on tour) actor; Japan's 興行 status actor (directors and screenwriters not performing take other statuses, not modelled); Sweden's artist permit (singers, musicians, dancers, actors, directors, film-makers) actor and director; Egypt's syndicate permit (acting and cinema) actor and director. Elsewhere every role.
value.visit: A meeting is open where the person is home or a passport enters free, on an electronic authorisation, an e-visa or a visa on arrival; refused where every passport needs a visa applied for beforehand (the game holds none) or the destination's list isn't kept.
value.director_days: A director's engagement is prep, shoot and cut, all in the film's country; prep books it (as an audition books a part) and isn't refused, so the permit can be applied for on it; shoot and cut are refused without one.
value.producer_days: A producer's engagement is the scheduled shooting days in the market's country; the shoot is refused without a permit; applying to a fund or raising money isn't work there.
value.days_counted: A short engagement's days worked in a country within the law's period count every role's: parts played (on the day played), films (all their days, on the day prep began), projects shot (their days, on the day shot).

sources.title: BOE núm. 118, 16 May 2016, BOE-A-2016-4703: III Convenio colectivo estatal regulador de las relaciones laborales entre los productores de obras audiovisuales y los actores que prestan servicios en las mismas
sources.said: El presente Convenio se concluye entre la Confederación de Asociaciones de Productores Audiovisuales de España (FAPAE), Confederación de Artistas-Trabajadores del Espectáculo (ConArte), Unión de Actores y Actrices, la Federación de Servicios de la Unión General de Trabajadores (Fes-UGT) y la Federación de Servicios a la Ciudadanía (FSC-CC.OO.). … La duración del Convenio será 1 de enero de 2016 y se extenderá hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2018, prorrogándose con posterioridad en sus propios términos de año en año, siempre y cuando no se denuncie su vigencia por una de las partes firmantes del mismo. … El presente Convenio es de aplicación a los contratos de interpretación para la realización de obras audiovisuales que se celebren entre los productores de las mismas y los actores/actrices que en ellas intervengan, cualquiera que sea el tipo de actuación que se fije en las citadas obras audiovisuales, incluidas las de publicidad. … El presente convenio tiene ámbito estatal, por lo que su vigencia y obligatoriedad se extiende a la totalidad de los contratos de interpretación formalizados dentro del territorio del Estado español con independencia del lugar en que se presten los servicios. … La contratación se efectuará en función de su duración que será determinada en: a) Días o sesiones en número determinado. … La jornada laboral diaria de carácter continuo será de ocho horas, con una interrupción de 15 minutos. El productor podrá optar por la jornada partida con un total de nueve horas diarias, con una interrupción de sesenta minutos para descanso. … la jornada máxima semanal de 40 horas sea insuficiente por razones organizativas y de producción. Como consecuencia de lo cual y cuando se den estas circunstancias, las empresas podrán establecer un horario más prolongado, con 24 horas de preaviso, sin sobrepasar las 10 horas diarias de trabajo efectivo y las 44 semanales, respetando en todo caso el descanso entre jornadas. … y el comienzo de la siguiente no podrá ser inferior a trece horas, contando el mismo desde que el actor/actriz termina su jornada de trabajo hasta la hora de citación al día siguiente. El descanso semanal mínimo será de 36 horas continuadas para las obras cinematográficas y de 48 horas para el resto de obras. … – Actor/Actriz de reparto: Aquellos personajes que no superen las 20 líneas de texto, y con un máximo éstas de 60 espacios mecanografiados, por película u obra completa y que por su presencia escénica en tiempo o en peso específico, no llegan a las características del papel secundario. – Actor/Actriz de pequeñas partes: Aquellos personajes que no superen las 2 líneas de texto, y con un máximo estas de 60 espacios mecanografiados, por película u obra completa … Las partes firmantes del presente convenio harán todos los esfuerzos necesarios ante las diferentes administraciones públicas con el objetivo de armonizar las condiciones en las que los menores pueden realizar una prestación laboral en espectáculos públicos … el actor/actriz estará obligado, y es su derecho, a poner la voz al personaje que ha interpretado. Este derecho es extensible al doblaje posterior a las lenguas propias del actor/actriz oficiales en el estado español.

sources.title: FISTEL-CISL (signatory): CCNL per Interpreti, Attrici ed Attori del comparto di produzione del cineaudiovisivo, signed text of 20 December 2023 (scan, OCR checked against the page image), heading
sources.said: CCNL per Interpreti, Attrici ed Attori del comparto di produzione del cineaudiovisivo. … ambito di applicazione del presente, quindi, attiene al comparto della produzione e realizzazione di opere cineaudiovisive, aventi contenuto creativo, siano esse destinate alla distribuzione e proiezione in sala, ovvero anche su canali televisivi, siano essi privati, pubblici, streamer ecc. … Il presente Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro decorre dal 01 marzo 2024 e verrà applicato per i contratti sottoscritti dagli interpreti/attrici/attori da tale data. … Il presente contratto avrà durata triennale con scadenza al 28 febbraio 2027 … Interprete, Attrice e Attore, è colei/colui che sia in scena con almeno una battuta realizzi anche una sola interazione/battuta con altro personaggio e che non risulti nell’ambito di applicazione dei CCNL dei Generici e/o degli Stuntman. … I Gruppo: 1.100,00 € lordi omnicomprensivi per giornata di posa; 2 Gruppo: 850,00 € lordi omnicomprensivi per giornata di posa; 3 Gruppo: 650,00 € lordi omnicomprensivi per giornata di posa; … Per i compensi di cui ai gruppi 2 e 3, il medesimo verrà ridotto rispettivamente a 650,00 E e 450,00 € a partire dalla 8 posa. … Per la “Lunga serialità” a partire da 8 episodi da 50 minuti cad., a partire dalla 8 posa, i compensi di … I Gruppo: 900,00 € lordi omnicomprensivi per giornata di posa; 2 Gruppo: 650,00 € lordi omnicomprensivi per giornata di posa; … Per la cd. lunghissima serialità, con numero di episodi per stagione superiore a 40 da 25 minuti, i compensi di cui sopra, saranno rispettivamente pari a: I Gruppo: 550,00 € lordi omnicomprensivi per giornata di posa; … 1. Opere cinematografiche di registi debuttanti (opere prime e seconde), nonché con budget inferiore a € 2 milioni. 2. Cortometraggi con budget inferiore a € 750.000,00. 3. Documentari e docufiction con budget inferiore a € 500.000/h (per ciascuna ora di prodotto). … 1 Gruppo: 550,00 € lordi omnicomprensivi per giornata di posa; … 3 Gruppo: 325,00 € lordi omnicomprensivi per giornata di posa; … Le parti convengono che, comunque, anche per qualsiasi tipologia di prodotto cineaudiovisivo non rientrante nelle specifiche di cui sopra, purché industriale, il compenso minimo di ciascun attore non potrà essere inferiore ad € 325,00. … I compensi di cui al presente articolo debbono essere considerati comprensivi sia della quota, pari al 60% di compenso assoggettato a contribuzione e fiscalità, sia del compenso per eventuale cessione dei diritti, pari al 40% esente da contribuzione come da normativa allo stato vigente. … gruppo: i protagonisti (uno o più) e protagonisti di puntata; 2. gruppo: comprimari, personaggi fissi delle serie, non protagonisti secondo quanto fissato dal, punto precedente, camei; gruppo: tutti gli altri non previsti ai precedenti punti 1 e 2. … Le sole prove dell’Interprete/Attrice/Attore, quando richieste dalla produzione, verranno retribuite al 50% dei minimi tabellari per la categoria di contrattualizzazione. … la disponibilità sarà retribuita con un compenso forfettario per ogni settimana continuativa … in cui non sia effettuata alcuna posa, pari al 20% del minimo contrattuale di una posa riferito al gruppo … Le giornate di viaggio (non in periodo di disponibilità) per raggiungere la località delle riprese saranno retribuite con un compenso pari al 30% dei minimi della giornata di posa in relazione alla propria categoria di appartenenza … un compenso forfettario pari al 30% del compenso contrattuale. … All’accompagnatore di minore verrà erogata una indennità pari al minimo 94,00 euro, come previsto dal CCNL dei lavoratori Generici. … La normativa riguardante l’orario dovrà tener presente quanto previsto dalla L.66/03. Le parti ribadiscono la necessità di prevedere il riconoscimento di un riposo tra una prestazione e la successiva di almeno 11 ore continuative. … I tempi di trucco e vestizione fanno parte dell’orario giornaliero di lavoro. … sottoscrizione del contratto individuale, sarà pari almeno al 10% del compenso lordo pattuito … Per tutte le suddette figure è previsto il contratto subordinato a tempo determinato.

sources.title: 協同組合日本俳優連合（Japan Actors Union）: 活動内容
sources.said: 協同組合日本俳優連合は、日本放送協会、民放在京TV各社、中京TV各社、大阪TV各社と協議、俳優たちの出演条件や出演環境の整備に関して、中小企業等協同組合法による団体協約を交わしています。また、声の出演に関しても、一般社団法人日本音声製作者連盟と団体協約を交わし … 外画動画出演実務運用表(最新版[2017年4月1日])

sources.title: 協同組合日本俳優連合（Japan Actors Union）: 組織概要
sources.said: 「日俳連」は、協同組合法で認められている団体交渉権を生かして、NHK、民放、製作会社との間で出演条件や安全対策等の団体協約を締結しています。 … 協同組合日本俳優連合は、「日俳連（にっぱいれん）」と呼ばれ約2,600名の俳優が加入しています。 … 東京都新宿区西新宿　6-12-30　芸能花伝舎

sources.title: ライブドアニュース（FLASH 2021年4月13日号）: 『鬼滅の刃』花江夏樹、鬼頭明里も…ギャラ「推定8万6250円」 (4 April 2021) (quoting: an anime producer, and the Japan Actors Union's 外画動画出演実務運用表)
sources.said: 「日本俳優連合に加盟している事務所の場合は、事務所に所属して3年めまでは『ジュニアランク』。ギャラは固定で1本1万5000円。たとえ主役級に抜擢されても、拘束時間などは問わず、モブ役（群衆として扱われる通行人など）と同じ一律1万5000円です。 … 4年め以降は個人の人気や能力によって事務所や自身の査定が入り、いちばん低いのが『ランク15』で1万5000円。『ランク16』で1万6000円、『ランク17』で1万7000円とランクアップごとに1000円ずつ上がり、最高で『ランク45』の4万5000円となり、さらにその上にランクを持たない『ノーランク』があります。

sources.title: 文春オンライン: 「ギャラ配分は声優が8割、事務所が2割」それでも新人声優が「食っていく」のが難しすぎるワケ, p.3 (23 November 2023) (quoting: the voice-performance rank system under the Japan Actors Union's 外画動画出演実務運用表)
sources.said: 声優として仕事を始めてから数年間は「ジュニアランク」。30分枠のテレビアニメ1話当たりのギャランティーは1万5千円です。以降は経験年数とともに自動的にランクが上がり、最終的に「Aランク」になると1本当たりの出演料は4万5千円になります（実際はここに転用費など加わりますので、数字は変わります）。 … すごく人気のある声優になれば、交渉によってギャランティーを決めることもできなくはありません。こうした「ノーランク」と呼ばれる声優もいますが、極めて例外的です。

sources.title: 文化庁 文化芸術分野の適正な契約関係構築に向けた検討会議: 文化芸術分野の適正な契約関係構築に向けたガイドライン（検討のまとめ）概要 (27 July 2022)
sources.said: 関係者間の信頼関係や従来の慣習等により、口頭による契約が多い … 業務内容や専門性等に応じた適正な金額となるよう双方で十分に協議、諸経費も明確に … スタッフの制作や技術等に関する業務委託契約、実演家の出演に関する業務委託契約を対象として、契約書のひな型

sources.title: 協同組合日本俳優連合（Japan Actors Union）: 加入案内
sources.said: 日俳連は協同組合であるため、加入時に出資金（一口2,000円）が必要となります。また、加入事務手数料1,000円と賦課金（組合費、1ヶ月1,500円～）も併せてお支払い頂きます。前払いで頂く賦課金の総額については、加入月によって変動がございます。そして加入後は、4か月分の賦課金（6,000円）を1年に3回お支払い頂きます。 … ※出資金は、退会時に返却いたします。 … 日俳連が団体協約を締結している仕事先(NHK、民放、音声制作会社など)での仕事は、あなたが個別に契約を交わさなくても、団体協約の出演条件が最低限守られます。

sources.title: ANDA (Asociación Nacional de Actores): Guía Práctica del afiliado/a (uploaded August 2025)
sources.said: Es el documento en el que se establecen las condiciones generales de trabajo y tabuladores de salarios mínimos pactados entre la ANDA y cada empresa, en beneficio y representación de todos los compañeros y compañeras. Los tabuladores se negocian cada año … a) Contrato por día. b) Contrato por capítulo. c) Contrato por semana. d) Contrato por mes. (1) d) Contrato por Producción. e) Contrato por paquete. (2) (1) Este tipo de contrato solo aplica para el CCT celebrado con Televisa. … • Estelar. • Coestelar (no aplica en cine). • Primera parte. • Segunda parte. • Tercera Parte. • Bit. • Bit de acción (solo aplica en cine). • Coordinador de stunt. • Stunt. … En Televisión, es la empresa quien decide la clasificación de los personajes según los parámetros de cada una. En Cine es una Comisión Clasificadora autónoma la que se encarga de clasificar a los personajes de acuerdo a su importancia dentro de la historia. … a) En el caso de doblaje de películas para proyección en cine el pago a los actores y actrices será, como mínimo, de tres tantos y medio respecto a dicho tabulador. … El Sindicato negocia, de manera particular, con cada empresa y/o proyecto un salario mínimo o tabulador, por lo que no existe un solo tabulador para todas las especialidades. Cada CCT es diferente y te invitamos a consultar el que te corresponda. … Conocer tu CCT es un derecho y puedes solicitarlo a través del Comité de Fiscalización y Vigilancia. … a) Deberán tener jornadas laborales de 6 horas, divididas en periodos máximos de 3 horas. b) Entre estos periodos deberán disfrutar de un descanso de 1 hora, por lo menos. c) No podrán laborar horas extras, y en los casos en los que se laboren, cada hora extra se pagará al triple. … La jornada de trabajo es de 8 horas máximo, aunque difícilmente se cumplen jornadas completas en esta especialidad … a) Contrato Colectivo de Trabajo: cuando el productor teatral tiene un CCT y/o Convenio celebrado con el Sindicato y a través de un Comisionado/a Sindical se levanta la nómina de los actores/actrices ANDA. … aplica exclusivamente para producciones teatrales independientes o de variedades que no pueden pasar por ANDA, ya sea porque están subsidiadas o tienen algún apoyo gubernamental … Cuando te afilias a la ANDA obtienes la calidad de AGREMIADO/A TRANSITORIO/A … La cuota sindical que aportas a la ANDA es el 15 % … ∙ 10% de COTIZACIÓN: sirve para pagar los gastos administrativos y de operación del Sindicato … ∙ 5% de CUOTA EXTRAORDINARIA*: sirve como apoyo a Jubilación y/o Previsión Social. … Si cumples 2 años sin cotizar tu estatus cambia a NO VIGENTE (dado/a de baja). … b) Si no eres afiliado/a, en cuanto quedes seleccionado/a en un proyecto, antes de mencionar que no perteneces a la ANDA; te recomendamos ponerte en contacto con la Secretaría de Trabajo de manera inmediata

sources.title: Mail & Guardian: Acting up for fair pay bears fruit (21 March 2025)
sources.said: People in the film and television and the performing arts industries are independent contractors, not employees, and are covered under contract law, and not labour law, in South Africa … “Producers will go to actors and hand them a contract and say: ‘These are the conditions of work. This is the rate. Take it or leave it.’” … Saga, which supports actors’ and artists’ rights to fair pay, working conditions and benefits, has more than 500 members.

sources.title: SAGA: A New Dawn for South African Actors: Victory at the Competition Commission (12 March 2025, update 6 June 2025)
sources.said: Classified as independent contractors, we have been denied the basic worker rights that many take for granted, including the right to form a union and to engage in collective bargaining. … Our efforts to provide guidance on fair compensation through a recommended minimum rate card were challenged by the Competition Commission … UPDATE (6 June 2025): Barely five months after filing their appeal at the Competition Tribunal, the two parties have withdrawn their case, leaving the exemption in force.

sources.title: SAGA: Legal report, 2025 AGM
sources.said: Under competition law we could not even discuss issues like standardized contracts, minimum rates and certain employment conditions within the industry. Now with the exemption we can! We can begin to draft contracts and present them to industry to be standardized. We can meet with productions and producers to negotiate minimum rates guidelines. … We cannot negotiate with productions on your behalf, but we can advise you on what clauses mean and what the current trends are.

entries.sought: How the actor's engine reads the eighteen markets' research where the research leaves a choice to the game
entries.why: The research gives each agreement's minimums by tiers the game must read from a part and a life (an actor's years, a role, a medium, a contract's length); where it names none of these exactly, or gives several agreements in a market, the reading is the game's own and the player is told so (acting.model). The world round (2026-11-01, every country beyond the first markets): The research names no city for many countries, gives several languages or none, sets minimums by the production's form or the actor's grade where a part has no such field, and dates some rates only by the agreement or the upload; the engine needs one zone, one language and a part's role, so these readings are the game's own and the player is told so (acting.model).

value.experience: an actor's years in the work are the whole years since the first part they played (any market), counted on the day the work starts; none before a first part

unitDays.basis: the Virke TV-drama agreement's basis (NO.json figure 5: monthDays 21, yearDays 220), read for every agreement

languages.AU: en (blocked: no source states the casting language)
languages.IE: en (the Constitution makes ga first official and en second; no source gives the share)
languages.NO: no (the research's ISO 639-1; a person who speaks nb is not read as speaking it)

zones.BR: America/Sao_Paulo (Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo)

value.roles: a part names its role where its agreement sets minimums by role: ES lead/supporting/featured (reparto, 20 lines or fewer)/small (2 lines or fewer); BR Sao Paulo lead/supporting/small; IT lead (group 1)/supporting (group 2)/other (group 3); MX lead/co-lead/first/second/third; KR the grade as the part's (the standard contract writes the fee as 'equivalent to grade N'); NL lead (Acteur II)/other (Acteur I); NZ Court lead/ensemble/supporting/featured/chorus; DE guest principal/smaller
value.media: a part names its medium where its agreement covers more than one (film, television, stage); otherwise its agreement's only one
value.minutes: an episode's running time chooses the column of MX's and KR's tables exactly (15, 30, 60 ... minutes); any other is refused

lengthTiers.FR TV single day's engagement: 1 day; 2 or more at the rehearsal-or-recording day
lengthTiers.FR subsidised under four months: 1 to 3 months; 4 or more at the permanent-or-over-four-months rate
lengthTiers.FR subsidised under one month, 1 or 2 pe: 1 or 2 performances; 3 or more at the lower (the engagement's performances read as in one month)

budgetTiers.ES low budget: a film of EUR 750,000 or less
budgetTiers.IT low budget: a film under EUR 2,000,000 (first and second films, shorts, documentaries not read)

chosen.DE NV Buehne: the TV-L/TV-H houses' dated minimums (the TVoeD line is undated)
chosen.DK Copenhagen theatres: a type-1 actor at step 27, sats VI
chosen.FR film: the branch-wide (extended) grid of 2023, not the SPI/UPC members' grid of 5 October 2026
chosen.ES: the state screen convenio and Madrid's stage convenio (the market's city); Catalonia's left out
chosen.BR: Rio de Janeiro's television and stage agreements and Sao Paulo's audiovisual one; a Sao Paulo week at its discounted weekly minimum
chosen.NZ: both Equity theatre agreements (Christchurch and Auckland, one zone)
chosen.MX TV Azteca: co-lead, first and second parts known only from 8 December 2023

value.pastTerm: an agreement's last minimum is kept past its term (BR Rio TV after 31 October 2026, NZ Court after 25 April 2026, ATC after 2024, NRK's 2019 table), as acting's existing shortcut keeps SAG-AFTRA's
value.none: where the research says no agreement sets an actor's pay (IN screen, JP live-action film and stage, MX beyond Televisa and TV Azteca, NG screen, NL screen, NZ screen, ZA all), no minimum: the pay is the parties' to agree, as under SAG-AFTRA's Micro-Budget
value.zoneWithoutCity: where the research names no market city (AI BG BL BN BW CC CU CX GF GP GR MF MS NC NF PM PN RE TR VA VG), the zone of the country's most populous place on the map (GeoNames population; the first of equals), checked by the compile
value.zoneWithCityNoTz: AR America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires (Buenos Aires), FI Europe/Helsinki (Helsinki): the named city's zone
value.languageOfSeveral: the first language the research lists: BE nl, FI fi, KE sw, MT mt, HK zh (Chinese, the Basic Law's; Cantonese not named), AX sv

rolesForTiers.AR stage: category-a, -b, -c, and the house by seats (200 or more, under 200)

undatedFrom.BG foreign film: 2018-12-01, the month the guild's file was uploaded (the document is undated; the guild lists it as current on 2026-11-01)
undatedFrom.IL screen: 2019-02-01, the date the 2019 addendum applies to contracts from (the CPI-indexed later tables not found)

value.follows: a territory follows its sovereign only where its research's source says the sovereign's labour code or labour law reaches it: BL GF GP MF PM RE (Code du travail L1521-1, L2621-1; GP and RE also L2222-1 and the agreements' own scopes, IDCC 3097, 2642, 3090, 1285) and YT (loi 2016-1088, ordonnance 2017-1491) under France's agreements; CC CX NF (Fair Work Act applied) under Australia's; AX (Autonomy Act §27: labour law the Finnish state's) under Finland's. Each is engaged as its own market (id the territory's code before the agreement's), its permit asked in the territory
value.keptRule: past an agreement's last step its last rate is kept (R-5114), so IL's 2019 day rates and BG's 2018 guild rates stand until later ones are read
value.languageWithoutFigure: where the research names no language, the country's most spoken official language by CLDR 49 (src/person/identity/languages.json territories, R-4618): the official one with the greatest share, alone at it and speakable; where CLDR doesn't settle it the market isn't compiled and the language is told unknown. It gives AU en, JP ja, CL es, GR el, NC fr, PH en (64% to Filipino's 60%), SH en, TH th, TR tr, VA it, VG en, MS en, BW en (81% to Setswana's 62%), BL GF MF fr, CC en (the only official one), CX en, NF en; the compile refuses any other (spokenOf)

sources.title: Fair Work Ombudsman, Broadcasting, Recorded Entertainment and Cinemas Award 2020 [MA000091], clauses 4.1, 13.2, 13.3 and Schedule G
sources.said: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the broadcasting, recorded entertainment and cinema industry and their employees in the classifications set out in this award to the exclusion of any other modern award. … 13.3 Adult rates [13.3 varied by PR729350 , PR740777 ; PR749974 ; PR749974 ppc 30Jan23, PR762200 , PR773980 , PR786630 , PR799371 ppc 01Jul26] … An employer must pay adult entertainment employees in the classifications in clause 13.2 the following minimum rates for ordinary hours worked by the employee (subject to the provisions of clause 13.8 ): Classification level Minimum weekly rate (full-time employee) Minimum hourly rate … Grade 17 1548.80 40.76 Grade 18 1619.30 42.61 … (q) Grade 17 entertainment employee includes the following classifications: Motion Picture Production Employee Level 9. (r) Grade 18 entertainment employee includes the following classifications: Motion Picture Production Employee Level 10. … G.1.9 Level 9 A level 9 employee will demonstrate advanced industry skills as a Director working in series or serials, documentaries, animated productions or similar productions. … G.1.10 Level 10 A level 10 employee will demonstrate advanced industry skills as a Director working in feature film, mini-series and one shot drama/telemovie productions.

sources.title: ADG Scripted Series Rate Card 2025-26
sources.said: This document sets out recommended minimum standards of pay and conditions for Screen Directors in Australia. … Band 1: Low Budget Under $900 K Under $1.8 M $4,000 Band 2: Mid Budget $900 - $1.5 M $1.8 M to $2.5 M $6,000 Band 3: High Budget over $1.5 M Over $2.5 M $8,000 … approximately 3% of a production’s budget, bringing episodic directors’ fees into parity with the rates and conditions accorded to screenwriters … i.e. A director on an 8 week shoot will have a minimum of 8 weeks of formal pre-production. A setup or pilot director is entitled to an additional 2 weeks of pre-production, … A director is entitled to a minimum of 3 days unimpeded editing time per half-hour episode, and 5 days per one-hour episode, to prepare a ‘Director’s Cut’.

sources.title: Convenção Coletiva de Trabalho 2025/2026, SINDCINE and SIAESP (scan, São Paulo, 13 October 2025), cover and clauses 41-42
sources.said: PARTE 2 EMPREGADOS COM CONTRATO DE TRABALHO POR PRAZO DETERMINADO, INTERMITENTE, TEMPORÁRIOS E EVENTUAIS … inclusive, quanto à obrigatoriedade do registro dos contratos no SINDCINE e pagamento da taxa … CLÁUSULA 42º - PISO SALARIAL, As empresas quando contratarem os profissionais para exercerem as funções abaixo mencionadas, em caráter transitório, na produção de fimes de média, curta, longa metragem, minisséries, sérios e novelas ou produtos audiovisuais de produção independente destinados a qualquer mídia que exista ou que venha a existir, documentários, filmes e vídeos publicitários … CLÁUSULA 82º- VIGÊNCIA: Acordam as partes que todas as cláusulas negociadas nessa Convenção Coletiva de Trabalho vigorarão de 1º de maio de 2025 a 30 de abril de 2027, a exceção das cláusulas de natureza econômica, que vigorarão de 1º de maio de 2025 a 30 de abril de 2026. … São Paulo, 13 de outubro de 2025. … Parágrafo Primeiro - Sobre os valores contidos nas tabelas, vigentes em 30 de abril de 2025, aplicar-se-á o reajuste de 6% (seis por cento), como resultado da negociação para … Parágrafo Segundo — Os técnicos cinematográficos poderão negociar livremente seus valores, desde que não sejam inferiores aos pisos salariais fixados nas tabelas desta convenção. PISOS SALARIAIS PARA FILMES PUBLICITÁRIOS 2025/2026 TABELA REFERENTE A 8 (OITO) HORAS DE TRABALHO DIÁRIOS, SENDO UMA HORA DE ALMOÇO E 44 HORAS SEMANAIS … PISOS SALARIAIS PARA LONGA, MEDIA, CURTA METRAGEM E DOCUMENTARIOS 2025/2026 … PISOS SALARIAIS PARA TELEFILMES, SERIES, MINISSERIES, NOVELAS E CONTEUDO DE PRODUÇÃO INDEPENDENTE 2025/2026

sources.title: SINDCINE, Registro Profissional (DRT)
sources.said: A profissão de técnico em espetáculos de diversões nas funções de cinema e audiovisual é regulamentada (art. 6° Lei 6533/78 e art.7° Decreto 82385/78) , e para exercê-la é preciso ter registro profissional, o chamado DRT. O Registro Profissional é emitido pela Superintendência Regional do Trabalho, subordinada ao Ministério da Economia. COMO OBTER O DRT - O Sindcine, como entidade representativa dos trabalhadores do audiovisual, pode conceder um atestado de capacitação profissional para técnicos(as) que comprovem três anos de experiência na área e não tenham diploma de faculdade de Cinema / Audiovisual . … O Sindcine não emite DRT. … DIPLOMADOS - Se você tem diploma universitário em cinema ou audiovisual, pode obter seu registro profissional com ele

sources.title: Nova associação defende os direitos autorais de diretores de cinema e audiovisual (Agência de Notícias da Indústria, 11 November 2015), reporting the association's launch and its president first-hand
sources.said: Os diretores de cinema e audiovisual ganharam uma associação, a DBCA (Diretores Brasileiros de Cinema e do Audiovisual), criada por um grupo de cineastas brasileiros, com o objetivo de realizar a gestão coletiva dos direitos autorais de diretores do audiovisual no Brasil, bem como fomentar e manter trabalho de assistência social para os seus afiliados. Para Sylvio Back, o presidente do Conselho Diretivo pelos próximos três anos

sources.title: DBCA, FAQ – Perguntas frequentes (items 08-10)
sources.said: 08 Quem pode aderir ao DBCA? Todos os diretores de filmes e obras audiovisuais, bem como seus herdeiros, com domicílio fiscal no Brasil e cujas obras gerem direitos, ou seja, tenham sido lançadas comercialmente. 09 Como cadastro minha obra? Entre no site (dbca.declaraciondeobra.org/dbca) e siga as instruções. Em caso de dúvida envie um e-mail para (obras@diretoresbrasil.org). Importante que, no cadastramento de sua obra você conheça o Estatuto Social da DBCA, disponível na íntegra neste site. 10 Há algum custo para cadastrar minha obra? Não. Registrar a sua obra audiovisual na DBCA, seja de cinema seja de televisão, não custa nada. Igualmente, não há pagamento de mensalidade alguma por associar-se à DBCA.

sources.said: Le montant total des aides publiques (dont « l’avance sur recettes ») ne pourra pas dépasser 50 % du coût de production du film. … dans la limite de 60 % et sur demande motivée de l'entreprise de production, pour les œuvres cinématographiques "difficiles" ou "à petit budget". Une œuvre difficile est la première ou la deuxième œuvre d'un réalisateur. Une œuvre à petit budget est celle dont le budget total est inférieur ou égal à 1 250 000 € ; … dans la limite de 70 % pour les œuvres cinématographiques difficiles ou à petit budget qui ne bénéficient pas du crédit d’impôt pour les dépenses de production déléguée. … L’aide se rembourse sur le soutien généré par le film, après application d’une franchise fixée à 50 000 €. Le remboursement s’effectue dans une proportion qui ne peut être inférieure à 25 % des sommes calculées et dans la limite de 80 % de l’aide attribuée. … d’être représenté par une société de production au capital minimum de 45 000 € pour passer devant le comité de chiffrage.

sources.title: CNC: Crédit d'impôt cinéma
sources.said: Le crédit d’impôt est égal à 30 % du montant total des dépenses éligibles qui ne peuvent représenter plus de 80 % du budget de production et, en cas de coproduction internationale, plus de 80 % de la part française. … Le crédit d'impôt est égal à 20 % du montant total des dépenses éligibles pour les films réalisés dans une langue étrangère justifiée par des raisons artistiques tenant au scénario. … Son montant est plafonné à 30 000 000 € … ne peuvent avoir pour effet de porter à plus de 50 % du budget de production le montant total des aides publiques … Ce seuil est porté à 60 % pour les films difficiles (1er ou 2ème film du réalisateur) ou à petit budget (inférieur ou égal à 1,25 million d'euros).

sources.said: Ai produttori indipendenti, in possesso dei requisiti di cui all’articolo 2, commi 2 e 4 del presente decreto, il credito di imposta è concesso nella misura del 40 30 per cento del costo eleggibile di produzione, nel rispetto dei limiti previsti all’articolo 5. … 35 25 per cento per la parte del costo eleggibile superiore a euro 5.000.000 e fino a euro 10.000.000; … opere cinematografiche di cui al Capo II, documentari cinematografici di cui al Capo IV e opere di animazione cinematografiche di cui al Capo V, fino all’ammontare massimo di euro 4.000.000 per opera e fino all’ammontare massimo annuo di euro 7.000.000 per impresa … concorrano, per almeno il 40 per cento, risorse provenienti da Paesi al di fuori dell’Italia, l'ammontare massimo del credito d'imposta è così rideterminato: fino a euro 6.000.000 per le opere cinematografiche di cui al Capo II … I crediti d'imposta e le altre misure di sostegno pubblico non possono superare, complessivamente, la misura del 50 per cento del costo dell'opera audiovisiva. … non sono eleggibili il compenso per la produzione (“producer fee”) e le spese generali dell’impresa; ciascuna delle due voci è imputabile nel costo complessivo di produzione nella misura massima del 7,5 per cento del medesimo costo; … sono eleggibili, nella misura massima del 30 25 per cento del costo complessivo di produzione, innalzato al 30 per cento per le opere con un costo inferiore a euro 3.500.000, i costi relativi alle voci “Soggetto e sceneggiatura”, “Direzione”, “Attori principali”

sources.title: ANICA: Chi siamo
sources.said: ANICA (Associazione Nazionale Industrie Cinematografiche Audiovisive e Digitali) è l’Associazione di Settore che in Confindustria rappresenta le imprese che operano nella filiera cinematografica, audiovisiva e digitale. Fondata il 10 luglio 1944 … ANICA discute e firma direttamente sei Contratti Collettivi Nazionali di Lavoro della Filiera Cineaudiovisiva (Cineaudiovisivo, Troupes, Doppiaggio, Interpreti e Attori/Attrici, Generici, Stuntmen)

sources.said: ３億円以上 ○ 6,000 万円 （7,800 万円） 6,000 万円 … ２億円以上 ○ 4,000 万円 （5,200 万円） 4,000 万円 １億円以上 ○ 2,000 万円 （2,600 万円） 2,000 万円 5,000 万円 以上 1,000 万円 （1,300 万円） 1,000 万円 5,000 万未満 ～2,000 万円 400 万円 … 「日本映画制作適正認定制度（作品認定制度）」の認定を受けて活動を実施する場合、助成金額の 上限を３０％引き上げることとします。 … 本募集案内でいう「日本映画」とは、「日本国民、日本に永住を許可された者又は日本の法令により設 立された法人により製作された映画（テレビ用作品を除く）」 … ・映画館又はホール等において連続して１週間以上かつ３館以上有料で上 映すること（配信のみは不可） … 助成を受けた映画を公開した日から５年の間に、「相当の収益」が生じた場合には、原則として、その 収益に相当する額の全部または一部を振興会に納付いただく必要があります … 収益納付額 ＝（配分金総額 - 出資金等総額）×（助成金の額 / 出資金等総額） … 劇映画 40 13 222,864 64 9 172,749 記録映画 30 5 27,770 17 4 24,730 アニメーション映画 1 1 1,070 4 2 44,500 合 計 71 19 251,704 85 15 241,979 … 下表に掲げる経費については「活動の収支予算に記入できない経費」となります。これらの経費は、外部に 委託した場合についても活動の収支予算に記入できません。 （ア） 事務運営管理に関する経費 ○事務所維持費 ○事務所電話代 ○会議室使用料 ○修理・メンテナンス費 ○製作管理費 ○予備費 ○医療費 ○振込手数料 ○ホームページ運用費 ○事務運営管理に関する職員給与 等 … 令和５年３月に一般社団法人日本映画製作者連盟、協同組合日本映画製作者協会、協同組合日本映画監 督協会ほか各職能団体によって、映画制作現場の就業環境改善や取引の適正化等を図ることを目的に、「映 画制作の持続的な発展に向けた取引ガイドライン」が定められました。

一般社団法人日本映画製作者連盟: 映連とは
sources.said: 映連とは 映画製作配給大手四社の団体。 映画製作事業の健全なる発展を目的とし、会員間の不公正防止、海外輸出の促進、 国際映画祭の参加、国内外資料の蒐集作成及び公的機関、関連団体との折衝などを行う。

sources.said: 대통령령 으로 정하는 내국인이 2028년 12월 31일까지 … 가. 기본공제 금액: 해당 영상콘텐츠 제작비용의 100분의 10(중소기업의 경우에는 100분의 15)에 상당하는 금액 나. 추가공제 금액: 국내에서 발생한 제작비용이 총 제작비에서 차지하는 비율 등을 고려하여 대통령령 으로 정하는 요건을 충족하는 영상콘텐츠의 경우 그 제작비용의 100분의 10(중소기업의 경우에는 100분의 15)에 상당하는 금액

sources.said: 재정경제부령 으로 정하는 촬영제작에 든 비용 중 국내에서 지출한 비용이 차지하는 비율이 100분의 80 이상일 것 2. 다음 각 목의 요건 중 3개 이상의 요건을 충족할 것 가. 재정경제부령 으로 정하는 작가 및 주요 스태프에게 지급한 인건비 중 내국인에게 지급한 인건비가 차지하는 비율이 100분의 80 이상일 것 나. 재정경제부령 으로 정하는 배우 출연료 중 내국인에게 지급한 출연료가 차지하는 비율이 100분의 80 이상일 것 다. 재정경제부령 으로 정하는 후반제작에 든 비용 중 국내에서 지출한 비용이 차지하는 비율이 100분의 80 이상일 것 라. 「저작권법」 에 따른 복제권, 공연권, 방송권, 전송권, 배포권 및 2차적저작물작성권 중 영상콘텐츠 제작자가 보유한 권리의 수가 3개 이상일 것.

sources.title: DOF 16/02/2026 (edición vespertina): Decreto por el que se otorga un estímulo fiscal a la producción cinematográfica y audiovisual (SIDOF nota 5780237)
sources.said: Que el proyecto o proceso de producción cinematográfica o audiovisual cuente con al menos el 70% de proveeduría nacional. … Proyecto de producción de largometraje narrativo o de animación y por capítulo de serie narrativa o de animación Al menos 40 millones de pesos Proyecto de producción de largometraje documental o serie documental Al menos 20 millones de pesos … El estímulo fiscal consiste en un crédito fiscal de hasta el 30% del costo total del proyecto o proceso de producción cinematográfica o audiovisual, realizado en territorio nacional, sin que en ningún caso exceda de 40 millones de pesos por producción y por sujeto beneficiado. … el monto total anual del estímulo fiscal que el Comité Técnico autorice a los contribuyentes no excederá de 400 millones de pesos

sources.said: los contribuyentes que aporten recursos en efectivo a proyectos cinematográficos en México pueden obtener un crédito fiscal, equivalente al monto de su aportación, para ejercerlo contra el Impuesto Sobre la Renta (ISR) que generen a partir del ejercicio en el que se determine dicho crédito. … En ningún caso, el estímulo podrá exceder del 10% del ISR causado en el ejercicio inmediato anterior al de su aplicación.
